body.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra
body.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, First Chapter

children.text: kailāsaśikhare ramye nānāratnopaśobhite /
children.translated_text: On the beautiful peak of <s>Kailāsa</s>, adorned with various gems,

children.text: papraccha parayā bhaktyā bhairavaṃ parameśvaram // MBhT_1.1
children.translated_text: she asked with supreme devotion <s>Bhairava</s>, the supreme lord.

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: tripurāpūjanaṃ nātha svarṇaratnair viśeṣataḥ /
children.translated_text: O Lord, the worship of <s>Tripurā</s> requires gold and gems especially;

children.text: kalikāle svarṇarūpyaṃ guptabhāvaṃ tathā maṇim // MBhT_1.2
children.translated_text: in the <s>Kali</s> age, gold, silver, hidden substances, and gems as well —

children.text: kenopāyena deveśa svarṇarūpyādi labhyate /
children.translated_text: by what means, O Lord of Gods, can gold, silver, and the like be obtained?

children.text: tad vadasva viśeṣeṇa yathā ratnādikaṃ bhavet // MBhT_1.3
children.translated_text: Tell me in detail how gems and such may come to be.

body.text: yan noktaṃ sarvatantreṣu tad vadasva dayānidhe // MBhT_1.4
body.translated_text: That which has not been told in all the <s>tantras</s>, tell me that, O treasury of compassion.

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṅkara</s> spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yathā ratnādikaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: Listen, O Goddess, I shall tell you how gems and such may come to be;

children.text: mattejasā pāradena kiṃ ratnaṃ na hi labhyate // MBhT_1.5
children.translated_text: with <s>pārada</s> (mercury) empowered by my radiance, what gem cannot be obtained?

children.text: tathā sāmudrakeṇaiva suśubhralavaṇena ca /
children.translated_text: Likewise with sea salt and bright white salt,

children.text: sambalasya prakāraṃ hi śṛṇu devi prayatnataḥ // MBhT_1.6
children.translated_text: listen carefully, O Goddess, to the method of <s>sambala</s> (the reagent).

children.text: cīnatantrānusāreṇa pūjayet siddhakālikām /
children.translated_text: Following the <s>Cīnatantra</s> (Chinese Tantra), one should worship <s>Siddhakālikā</s>,

children.text: athavā pūjayed devīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kālikāṃ parām /
children.translated_text: or else one should worship the Goddess, the supreme <s>Dakṣiṇā Kālikā</s>,

children.text: kālītantroktavidhinā saptāhaṃ japapūjanam // MBhT_1.7
children.translated_text: according to the procedure prescribed in the <s>Kālītantra</s>, with <s>japa</s> (recitation) and worship for seven days.

children.text: satye caikaṃ tu tretāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ dvāpare trayam /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Satya</s> age one round, in <s>Tretā</s> double, in <s>Dvāpara</s> triple,

children.text: evaṃ sarvatra jānīyāc caturguṇajapaḥ kalau // MBhT_1.8
children.translated_text: thus one should know everywhere — in <s>Kali</s> age the <s>japa</s> is fourfold.

children.text: ānīya bahuyatnena sambalaṃ toladvayam /
children.translated_text: Having obtained with great effort two <s>tolas</s> of <s>sambala</s> (the reagent),

children.text: vasur ādyaṃ śivaṃ cādyaṃ māyābinduvibhūṣitam /
children.translated_text: the first <s>Vasu</s> <s>bīja</s>, the first <s>Śiva</s> <s>bīja</s>, adorned with <s>Māyā</s> and <s>bindu</s> —

children.text: bījatrayaṃ cāṣṭaśataṃ prajapet sambalopari // MBhT_1.9
children.translated_text: these three <s>bījas</s> (seed-syllables) one should recite one hundred and eight times over the <s>sambala</s>.

children.text: aśītitolakaṃ mānaṃ kṛṣṇadhenusamudbhavam /
children.translated_text: Eighty <s>tolas</s> in measure, produced from a black cow,

children.text: dugdham ānīya yatnena cāṣṭottaraśataṃ japet // MBhT_1.10
children.translated_text: having carefully obtained the milk, one should recite one hundred and eight times.

children.text: vastrayuktena sūtreṇa dugdhamadhye vinikṣipet /
children.translated_text: Wrapped in cloth and thread, one should immerse it in the milk;

children.text: uttāpaṃ janayed dhīmān mandamandena vahninā // MBhT_1.11
children.translated_text: the wise one should generate heat with a gentle, slow fire.

children.text: bindu vedāntaparyantam ardhaśoṣaṃ bhaved yadā /
children.translated_text: From <s>bindu</s> to <s>vedānta</s> — when it is reduced to half,

children.text: tadaivottolya tad dravyaṃ toyamadhye vinikṣipet // MBhT_1.12
children.translated_text: at that very moment, lifting out that substance, one should immerse it in water.

children.text: tataḥ parīkṣā kartavyā pradadyāt pāvakopari /
children.translated_text: Then a test should be performed — one should place it upon fire;

children.text: nirdhūmaṃ vāvake dravyaṃ dṛṣṭvā utthāpya yatnataḥ // MBhT_1.13
children.translated_text: seeing that the substance is smokeless in the flame, one should carefully remove it.

children.text: tatraiva prajapen mantraṃ sarvavandyanavātmakam /
children.translated_text: Right there one should recite the mantra composed of all-venerable nine syllables;

children.text: ānīya bahuyatnena śuddhaṃ tāmraṃ manoharam // MBhT_1.14
children.translated_text: having obtained with great effort pure and beautiful copper,

children.text: sārdhena tolakaṃ tāmraṃ vahnimadhye vinikṣipet /
children.translated_text: one and a half <s>tolas</s> of copper one should place in the fire;

children.text: yathā vahnis tathā tāmraṃ dṛṣṭvā utthāpya yatnataḥ // MBhT_1.15
children.translated_text: when the copper matches the fire in heat, seeing this, one should carefully remove it.

children.text: guñjāpramāṇaṃ tad dravyaṃ tatkṣaṇād yadi yojayet /
children.translated_text: If one applies that substance in the amount of a <s>guñjā</s> (berry-weight) at that very instant,

children.text: satyaṃ satyaṃ hi girije raupyaṃ bhavati niścitam // MBhT_1.16
children.translated_text: truly, truly, O <s>Girijā</s>, it becomes silver without doubt.

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: kāraṇaṃ dugdharūpaṃ vā kena rūpeṇa śaṅkaraḥ /
children.translated_text: What is the cause, the form of the milk — by what means, O <s>Śaṅkara</s>?

children.text: tatprakāraṃ mahādeva kṛpayā vada śaṅkara // MBhT_1.17
children.translated_text: Tell me that procedure with compassion, O <s>Mahādeva</s>, O <s>Śaṅkara</s>.

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṅkara</s> spoke:

children.text: ṭaṅkanam ānayed dhīmān tolakaṃ tu catuṣṭayam /
children.translated_text: The wise one should obtain <s>ṭaṅkaṇa</s> (borax), four <s>tolas</s> in measure;

children.text: vahniyogena girije lājarūpaṃ cakāra ha // MBhT_1.18
children.translated_text: by application of fire, O <s>Girijā</s>, it is made into a puffed form.

children.text: āmrapuṣpaṃ tad dviguṇaṃ piṣṭvā milanam ācaret /
children.translated_text: Twice that amount of <s>āmrapuṣpa</s> (mango blossom) — grinding it, one should perform the mixing;

children.text: tasyopari japen mantraṃ mahāmāyāṃ hi caṇḍike // MBhT_1.19
children.translated_text: over that one should recite the mantra of <s>Mahāmāyā</s>, O <s>Caṇḍikā</s>.

children.text: etat tu guṭikāṃ kṛtvā melanaṃ kārayed yadi /
children.translated_text: Having made this into a pill, if one performs the combination,

children.text: tadaiva dugdharūpaṃ syāt satyaṃ satyaṃ hi śailaje // MBhT_1.20
children.translated_text: at that very moment it becomes milk-like — truly, truly, O <s>Śailajā</s> (mountain-born one).

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: gandhahīnaṃ bhaven madyaṃ kenopāyena śaṅkara /
children.translated_text: By what means, O <s>Śaṅkara</s>, can liquor be made free of odor?

children.text: tat sarvaṃ śrotum icchāmi yadi sneho 'sti mā prati // MBhT_1.21
children.translated_text: I wish to hear all of that, if you have affection for me.

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṅkara</s> spoke:

children.text: śivaṃ vahnisamārūḍhaṃ vāmanetravibhūṣitam /
children.translated_text: The <s>Śiva</s> <s>bīja</s> mounted upon <s>Vahni</s> (fire), adorned with the left eye,

children.text: bindunādasamāyuktaṃ gandham ādāya saṃlikhet // MBhT_1.22
children.translated_text: conjoined with <s>bindu</s> and <s>nāda</s> — taking the fragrant substance, one should write it.

children.text: uhyatāṃ padam uccāryaṃ cāṣṭottaraśataṃ yadi /
children.translated_text: The unspoken <s>pada</s> (word) to be uttered — if one hundred and eight times

children.text: prajapet sādhakaśreṣṭho durgandhādivināśanam // MBhT_1.23
children.translated_text: the best of practitioners recites it, it destroys foul odor and the like.

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Second Chapter

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> spoke:

children.text: vada īśāna sarvajña sarvatattvavidāṃ vara /
children.translated_text: Tell me, O <s>Īśāna</s>, omniscient one, best among knowers of all principles;

children.text: yat tvayā kathitaṃ nātha mama saṅge vihārataḥ // MBhT_2.1
children.translated_text: that which you have told me, O Lord, in the course of our intimate union —

children.text: kathaṃ vā jāyate putraḥ śukrasya katra saṃsthitiḥ /
children.translated_text: how is a son born? Where does <s>śukra</s> (semen) reside?

children.text: vardhamānaṃ sadā liṅgaṃ praveśo vā kathaṃ bhavet // MBhT_2.2
children.translated_text: The <s>liṅga</s> (phallus) that grows constantly — how does penetration occur?

body.text: bhītiyuktā hy ahaṃ nātha trāhi māṃ duḥkhasaṅkaṭāt // MBhT_2.3
body.translated_text: I am filled with fear, O Lord; save me from this painful distress.

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṅkara</s> spoke:

children.text: maṇipūraṃ mahāpadmaṃ suṣumṇāmadhyasaṃsthitam /
children.translated_text: <s>Maṇipūra</s> (the jewel-city cakra) is a great lotus situated in the middle of the <s>suṣumnā</s>;

children.text: tasya nālena deveśi nābhipadmaṃ manoharam // MBhT_2.4
children.translated_text: by its stalk, O Queen of Gods, there is the beautiful <s>nābhipadma</s> (navel lotus).

children.text: vakratrayasamāyuktaṃ sadā śukravibhūṣitam /
children.translated_text: Endowed with three bends, always adorned with <s>śukra</s> (seminal fluid),

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ nālaṃ sahasrāre ataḥ śukravibhūṣitam // MBhT_2.5
children.translated_text: the upper stalk reaches the <s>sahasrāra</s> — therefore it is adorned with <s>śukra</s>.

body.text: tasmād eva stanadvandvaṃ vardhamānaṃ dine dine // MBhT_2.6
body.translated_text: From that very place the pair of breasts grows day by day.

children.text: madhyanālaṃ suṣumṇāntaṃ vṛntākāraṃ suśītalam /
children.translated_text: The middle stalk ends in the <s>suṣumnā</s>, eggplant-shaped and very cool;

children.text: āyonyagram adhonālaṃ sadānandamayi śive // MBhT_2.7
children.translated_text: the lower stalk extends to the opening of the <s>yoni</s> (womb), O ever-blissful <s>Śivā</s>.

children.text: śṛṇu cārvaṅgi subhage tanmadhye liṅgatāḍanāt /
children.translated_text: Listen, O beautiful-limbed, fortunate one — from the striking of the <s>liṅga</s> in that middle region,

children.text: yad rūpaṃ paramānandaṃ tan nāsti bhuvanatraye // MBhT_2.8
children.translated_text: the supreme bliss that arises — that does not exist elsewhere in the three worlds.

children.text: nābhipadmaṃ tu yad rūpaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: The form of the navel lotus, hear that attentively:

children.text: bindusthānaṃ madhyadeśe sadā padmavirājitam // MBhT_2.9
children.translated_text: the <s>bindu</s> place in the central region, always resplendent with a lotus.

children.text: bāhyadeśe cāṣṭapatraṃ caturasraṃ tu tadbahiḥ /
children.translated_text: On the outer side it has eight petals, and beyond that a square;

children.text: caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ savṛttakam // MBhT_2.10
children.translated_text: endowed with four doors, golden in appearance, with a circular form.

children.text: tatpatreṇa bhavet puṣpaṃ vṛntayuktaṃ tripattrakam /
children.translated_text: From that petal arises a flower with a stalk and three leaves;

children.text: praphulle tu tripatrāre bāhye rudhiradarśanam // MBhT_2.11
children.translated_text: when the three-petalled one blossoms, on the outside blood becomes visible.

children.text: etanmadhye maheśāni yadi syāl liṅgatāḍanam /
children.translated_text: In the midst of this, O Great Goddess, if the striking of the <s>liṅga</s> occurs,

children.text: padmamadhye gate śukre saṃtatis tena jāyate // MBhT_2.12
children.translated_text: when <s>śukra</s> (semen) enters the lotus, offspring is thereby produced.

children.text: puruṣasya tu yac chukraṃ śakteraktādhiko bhavet /
children.translated_text: If the man's <s>śukra</s> (semen) is exceeded by the woman's <s>rakta</s> (blood, the female element),

children.text: tadā kanyā bhaved devi viparītaḥ pumān bhavet // MBhT_2.13
children.translated_text: then a daughter is born, O Goddess; if the reverse, a male is born.

body.text: ubhayos tulyaśukreṇa klībaṃ bhavati niścitam // MBhT_2.14
body.translated_text: When both have equal <s>śukra</s>, a <s>klība</s> (intersex person) is certainly produced.

children.text: śṛṇu cārvaṅgi subhage puṣpamāhātmyam uttamam /
children.translated_text: Listen, O beautiful-limbed, fortunate one, to the supreme greatness of the flower:

children.text: madhye tacchukrasaṃyoge vardhate tad dine dine /
children.translated_text: in the middle, upon the union with <s>śukra</s>, it grows day by day;

children.text: evaṃ diṅmāsasamprāpte tatpuṣpaṃ vṛntasaṃyutam // MBhT_2.15
children.translated_text: thus when ten months are reached, that flower together with its stalk —

body.text: galite parameśāni vyakto bhavati saṃtatiḥ // MBhT_2.16
body.translated_text: when it falls, O Supreme Goddess, the offspring becomes manifest.

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> spoke:

children.text: kiṃcid rogādisambhūte kṛmikīṭādisambhave /
children.translated_text: When some disease or such arises, when worms, insects, and the like are produced,

children.text: tasmajjīvaṃ praṇaśyanti sā nārī jīvyate katham // MBhT_2.17
children.translated_text: and the living being perishes thereby — how does that woman survive?

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṅkara</s> spoke:

children.text: asya puṣpasya māhātmyaṃ kiṃ vaktuṃ śakyate mayā /
children.translated_text: The greatness of this flower — how can I possibly describe it?

children.text: bindusthānaṃ sahasraṃ tu puṣpamadhye priyaṃvade // MBhT_2.18
children.translated_text: The <s>bindu</s> place contains a thousand within the flower, O dear one.

children.text: budbudā yatra tiṣṭhanti tatraiva saṃtatir bhavet /
children.translated_text: Where bubbles remain, there indeed offspring comes to be;

children.text: evaṃ krameṇa deveśi sahasraṃ saṃtatir yadi /
children.translated_text: thus in sequence, O Queen of Gods, if a thousand offspring were possible,

children.text: vardhamānaṃ mahāpuṣpaṃ pīḍā kiṃcin na jāyate // MBhT_2.19
children.translated_text: the great flower keeps growing, and not the slightest pain is produced.

children.text: mayā sārdhaṃ maheśāni vihāraṃ kuru yatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: Together with me, O Great Goddess, engage in union with care;

children.text: vihāre yo bhavet putro gaṇeśaḥ sa ca kīrtitaḥ // MBhT_2.20
children.translated_text: the son born from our union is celebrated as <s>Gaṇeśa</s>.

children.text: apare parameśāni tava putraprasādataḥ /
children.translated_text: Furthermore, O Supreme Goddess, by the grace of your son,

children.text: pṛthivyāṃ jāyate sṛṣṭir nirvighnena yathocitam // MBhT_2.21
children.translated_text: creation arises on earth without obstacles, as is fitting.

children.text: etac chrutvā tato devi madanānalavihvalā /
children.translated_text: Having heard this, the Goddess, overcome by the fire of desire,

children.text: śivenāliṅgitā devī śivākāreṇa vai tadā // MBhT_2.22
children.translated_text: was embraced by <s>Śiva</s> — the Goddess then assumed the form of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Third Chapter

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> spoke:

children.text: sarvatrāhaṃ śrutā nātha bhogaṃ cendriyapuṣṭidam /
children.translated_text: Everywhere I have heard, O Lord, that enjoyment nourishes the senses;

children.text: bhogena mokṣam āpnoti kathaṃ vadasi yogabhṛt // MBhT_3.1
children.translated_text: one attains liberation through enjoyment — how do you say this, O master of <s>yoga</s>?

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṅkara</s> spoke:

children.text: bhogena labhate yogaṃ bhogena kulasādhanam /
children.translated_text: Through enjoyment one obtains <s>yoga</s>, through enjoyment the practice of the <s>kula</s> (family/lineage),

children.text: bhogena siddhim āpnoti bhogena mokṣam āpnuyāt // MBhT_3.2
children.translated_text: through enjoyment one attains <s>siddhi</s> (perfection), through enjoyment one may attain <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation).

children.text: tasmād bhogaṃ sadā kāryaṃ bāhyapūjā yathecchayā /
children.translated_text: Therefore enjoyment should always be practiced; external worship may be done as one wishes.

children.text: bhojanasya vidhānaṃ yat tac chṛṇuṣva priyaṃvade // MBhT_3.3
children.translated_text: The procedure for eating — hear that, O dear one.

children.text: ādhāre tu yā śaktir bhujagākārarūpiṇī /
children.translated_text: In the <s>ādhāra</s> (base center), the <s>śakti</s> (power) who has the form of a serpent,

children.text: ātmā parameśāni tanmadhye vartate sadā // MBhT_3.4
children.translated_text: the <s>ātman</s> (self), O Supreme Goddess, always abides in that middle region.

children.text: bhojanecchā bhavet tasmān nirlipto jīvasaṃjñakaḥ /
children.translated_text: The desire for food arises from that; the one called <s>jīva</s> (individual soul) is unattached.

children.text: saiva sākṣād guṇamayo nirguṇo jīva ucyate // MBhT_3.5
children.translated_text: That very one, though appearing as if endowed with <s>guṇas</s> (qualities), is truly called the <s>nirguṇa</s> (qualityless) <s>jīva</s>.

children.text: jīvasya bhojanaṃ devi bhrāntir eva na saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: The eating of the <s>jīva</s>, O Goddess, is mere delusion, without doubt;

children.text: guṇayuktā kuṇḍalinī candrasūryāgnirūpiṇī // MBhT_3.6
children.translated_text: <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s>, endowed with <s>guṇas</s>, has the form of moon, sun, and fire.

children.text: mūlādhārāc ca tāṃ devīm ājihvāntāṃ vibhāvayet /
children.translated_text: One should visualize that Goddess from the <s>mūlādhāra</s> (root center) up to the tip of the tongue;

children.text: śodhitān matsyamāṃsādīn saṃmukhe sthāpayed budhaḥ // MBhT_3.7
children.translated_text: the wise one should place purified fish, meat, and other offerings before her.

children.text: mūlamantraṃ samuccārya juhomi kuṇḍalīmukhe /
children.translated_text: Uttering the <s>mūlamantra</s> (root mantra), 'I offer into the mouth of <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s>' —

children.text: anena manunā devi pratigrāsaṃ samāharet // MBhT_3.8
children.translated_text: with this mantra, O Goddess, one should make an offering with each morsel.

children.text: pratigrāse pareśāni evaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: With each morsel, O Supreme Goddess, thus should the discerning one act;

children.text: tadaiva brahmarūpo 'sau satyaṃ satyaṃ sureśvari // MBhT_3.9
children.translated_text: at that very moment he becomes the form of <s>Brahman</s> — truly, truly, O Queen of the Gods.

children.text: bhujyate kuṇḍalī devī iti cintāparo hi yaḥ /
children.translated_text: She who is <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s> Goddess is being fed — whoever maintains this contemplation,

children.text: mantrasiddhir bhavet tasya jñānasiddhir na cānyathā // MBhT_3.10
children.translated_text: <s>mantrasiddhi</s> (perfection of mantra) comes to him, and <s>jñānasiddhi</s> (perfection of knowledge) — not otherwise.

children.text: evaṃ kṛte brahmarūpaḥ śivarūpaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ /
children.translated_text: Having done thus, one becomes the form of <s>Brahman</s>, the form of <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Hari</s> himself;

children.text: yogasiddhir bhavet tasya cāṣṭasiddhir bhaviṣyati // MBhT_3.11
children.translated_text: <s>yogasiddhi</s> (perfection of yoga) comes to him, and the eight <s>siddhis</s> shall arise.

children.text: śatrubhir dīyate yat tu kṛtrimaṃ dāruṇaṃ viṣam /
children.translated_text: Even that which is given by enemies — artificial, terrible poison —

children.text: bhakṣaṇāt tat kṣaṇe devi hy amṛtaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_3.12
children.translated_text: upon eating it, in an instant, O Goddess, it becomes <s>amṛta</s> (nectar), without doubt.

children.text: mantreṇa śodhitaṃ dravyaṃ bhakṣaṇād amṛtaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: A substance purified by mantra, upon eating, becomes <s>amṛta</s>;

children.text: yadaiva kālakūṭaṃ tu samudramathane priye // MBhT_3.13
children.translated_text: just as the <s>kālakūṭa</s> (deadly poison) arose during the churning of the ocean, O beloved,

body.text: tadā cānena manunā tatkṣaṇāt khāditaṃ mayā // MBhT_3.14
body.translated_text: so by this very mantra it was instantly consumed by me.

children.text: sarpākārā kuṇḍalinī yā devī paramā kalā /
children.translated_text: The serpent-shaped <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s>, who is the Goddess, the supreme <s>kalā</s> (digit/power),

children.text: bhujyate sarparūpeṇa tatraiva dāruṇaṃ viṣam // MBhT_3.15
children.translated_text: in serpent form she consumes — therein even terrible poison is consumed.

children.text: iti te kathitaṃ kānte bhojanasya vidhānakam /
children.translated_text: Thus I have told you, O beloved, the procedure for eating;

children.text: etat sarvaṃ maheśāni goptavyaṃ paśusaṃkaṭe // MBhT_3.16
children.translated_text: all this, O Great Goddess, must be kept secret from the <s>paśu</s> (uninitiated, the bound one).

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu nātha parānanda parāparakulātmaka /
children.translated_text: Listen, O Lord, O supreme bliss, O one whose nature is the highest and lower <s>kula</s> (lineage);

children.text: vada me parameśāna homakuṇḍaṃ tu kīdṛśam // MBhT_3.17
children.translated_text: tell me, O Supreme Lord, what is the <s>homakuṇḍa</s> (fire-pit for oblation) like?

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śiva</s> spoke:

children.text: maṇipūrasya bāhye tu nābhipadmaṃ manoharam /
children.translated_text: Outside of <s>Maṇipūra</s> is the beautiful navel lotus,

children.text: aṣṭapatraṃ tathā vṛttaṃ tanmadhye kuṇḍadurlabham // MBhT_3.18
children.translated_text: eight-petalled and circular — in its middle is the rare <s>kuṇḍa</s> (fire-pit).

children.text: caturasrādikaṃ devi tat kuṇḍaṃ kāmarūpakam /
children.translated_text: Square and so forth, O Goddess, that <s>kuṇḍa</s> takes the form of desire;

children.text: sarvakuṇḍasya deveśi vipraḥ kartā vidhīyate // MBhT_3.19
children.translated_text: for all <s>kuṇḍas</s>, O Queen of Gods, a <s>vipra</s> (brahmin) is ordained as the maker.

body.text: vartulaṃ bāhujātasya vaiśyasya cārdhacandrakam // MBhT_3.20
body.translated_text: Circular is the <s>kuṇḍa</s> for the arm-born (<s>Kṣatriya</s>), and crescent-shaped for the <s>Vaiśya</s>.

children.text: trikoṇaṃ pādajātasya homakuṇḍaṃ sureśvari /
children.translated_text: Triangular is the <s>homakuṇḍa</s> for the foot-born (<s>Śūdra</s>), O Queen of the Gods;

children.text: evaṃ kuṇḍaṃ maheśāni nālatrayavibhūṣitam // MBhT_3.21
children.translated_text: thus the <s>kuṇḍa</s>, O Great Goddess, is adorned with three stalks.

children.text: ūrdhvanālaṃ sahasrāre parāmṛtavibhūṣitam /
children.translated_text: The upper stalk reaches the <s>sahasrāra</s>, adorned with supreme <s>amṛta</s> (nectar);

children.text: madhyanālaṃ nābhipadme mūlādhāre ca sundari // MBhT_3.22
children.translated_text: the middle stalk is at the navel lotus, and at the <s>mūlādhāra</s>, O beautiful one.

children.text: āliṅgāgram adhonālaṃ sadānandamayaṃ śive /
children.translated_text: The lower stalk extends to the tip of the <s>āliṅga</s> (embracing region), ever full of bliss, O <s>Śivā</s>;

children.text: homakuṇḍam idaṃ devi sarvatantre pariṣkṛtam // MBhT_3.23
children.translated_text: this is the <s>homakuṇḍa</s>, O Goddess, refined in all the <s>tantras</s>.

children.text: yena homaprasādena sākṣād brahmamayo bhavet /
children.translated_text: By the grace of this <s>homa</s> (fire offering), one directly becomes one with <s>Brahman</s>;

children.text: viprasya cāhutihomaṃ vijñātavyaṃ catuṣṭayam // MBhT_3.24
children.translated_text: for the <s>vipra</s> (brahmin), the <s>āhuti</s> (oblation) <s>homa</s> should be known as fourfold.

children.text: kṣatriyasya trayaṃ devi vaiśyasya cāhutidvayam /
children.translated_text: For the <s>Kṣatriya</s>, three, O Goddess; for the <s>Vaiśya</s>, two oblations;

children.text: śūdrasyaikāhutir devi muktiś cāpi caturvidhā // MBhT_3.25
children.translated_text: for the <s>Śūdra</s>, one oblation, O Goddess; and liberation is also fourfold.

children.text: mahāmokṣaṃ brāhmaṇasya sāyujyaṃ kṣatriyasya ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Mahāmokṣa</s> (great liberation) for the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, <s>sāyujya</s> (union with the divine) for the <s>Kṣatriya</s>,

children.text: sārūpyaṃ corujātasya sālokyaṃ śūdrajātiṣu // MBhT_3.26
children.translated_text: <s>sārūpya</s> (attaining divine form) for the thigh-born (<s>Vaiśya</s>), <s>sālokya</s> (dwelling in the divine realm) for the <s>Śūdra</s> castes.

children.text: bāhyakuṇḍaṃ bāhyahome eva hi suravandite /
children.translated_text: The external <s>kuṇḍa</s> is indeed for external <s>homa</s>, O one venerated by the gods;

children.text: jātibhede kuṇḍabhedaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ // MBhT_3.27
children.translated_text: the best of practitioners should make distinctions of <s>kuṇḍa</s> according to distinctions of caste.

children.text: bāhyahome kāmyasiddhir bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: In external <s>homa</s>, fulfillment of desires shall be achieved, without doubt;

children.text: jñānahome mokṣasiddhir labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_3.28
children.translated_text: in the <s>homa</s> of knowledge, the <s>siddhi</s> of <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation) is obtained, without doubt.

children.text: iti te kathitaṃ kānte tantrāṇāṃ sāram uttamam /
children.translated_text: Thus I have told you, O beloved, the supreme essence of the <s>tantras</s>;

children.text: na vaktavyaṃ paśor agre śapatho me tvayi priye // MBhT_3.29
children.translated_text: it must not be spoken before the <s>paśu</s> (uninitiated) — this is my oath to you, O beloved.

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> spoke:

children.text: madyapāne mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvatantre śrutaṃ mayā /
children.translated_text: Great merit in the drinking of <s>madya</s> (liquor) — I have heard this in all the <s>tantras</s>;

children.text: jātibhedaṃ na kathitam idānīṃ tat prakāśaya // MBhT_3.30
children.translated_text: the distinction by caste was not told — now reveal that.

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṅkara</s> spoke:

children.text: sarvayajñādhipo vipraḥ saṃśayo nāsti pārvati /
children.translated_text: The <s>vipra</s> (brahmin) is the lord of all sacrifices — there is no doubt, O <s>Pārvatī</s>;

children.text: sautrāmaṇyāṃ kulācāre catvāro brāhmaṇādayaḥ // MBhT_3.31
children.translated_text: in the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s> (Vedic soma sacrifice) and in <s>kulācāra</s> (family/tantric practice), the four castes beginning with <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> participate.

children.text: brāhmaṇasya mahāmokṣaṃ madyapāne priyaṃvade /
children.translated_text: <s>Mahāmokṣa</s> (great liberation) comes to the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> through the drinking of <s>madya</s>, O dear one;

children.text: brāhmaṇaḥ parameśāni yadi pānādikaṃ caret // MBhT_3.32
children.translated_text: if a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, O Supreme Goddess, engages in drinking and such practices,

body.text: tatkṣaṇāc chivarūpo 'sau satyaṃ satyaṃ hi śailaje // MBhT_3.33
body.translated_text: at that very instant he becomes the form of <s>Śiva</s> — truly, truly, O <s>Śailajā</s>.

children.text: toye toyaṃ yathā līnaṃ yathā tejasi tejasam /
children.translated_text: As water merges into water, as fire merges into fire,

children.text: ghaṭe bhagne yathākāśaṃ vāyau vāyur yathā priye // MBhT_3.34
children.translated_text: as space merges into space when a pot is broken, as wind merges into wind, O beloved —

children.text: tathaiva madyapānena brāhmaṇo brahmaṇi priye /
children.translated_text: so too through the drinking of <s>madya</s>, the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> merges into <s>Brahman</s>, O beloved;

children.text: līyate nātra saṃdehaḥ paramātmani śailaje // MBhT_3.35
children.translated_text: he dissolves — there is no doubt — into the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self), O <s>Śailajā</s>.

children.text: sāyujyādi mahāmokṣaṃ niyuktaṃ kṣatriyādiṣu /
children.translated_text: <s>Sāyujya</s> and other forms of <s>mahāmokṣa</s> are assigned to <s>Kṣatriyas</s> and others;

children.text: sā nārī mānavī madyapāne devi na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_3.36
children.translated_text: that woman, that human — in the drinking of <s>madya</s>, O Goddess, there is no doubt.

children.text: sūkṣmasūtre yathā vahnir dehamadhye tathā śivā /
children.translated_text: As fire exists in a fine thread, so <s>Śivā</s> exists within the body;

children.text: taporūpaṃ bṛhatsūtraṃ pūjārūpaṃ tathā hariḥ // MBhT_3.37
children.translated_text: the great thread is the form of <s>tapas</s> (austerity), and <s>Hari</s> is the form of worship.

children.text: saṃyuktaṃ kurute yatra vardhamāno mahāṅkuśaḥ /
children.translated_text: Where these are joined, there the great goad grows;

children.text: madyapānaṃ vinā devi tajjñānaṃ na hi labhyate /
children.translated_text: without the drinking of <s>madya</s>, O Goddess, that knowledge is not obtained.

children.text: ata eva hi vipreṇa madyapānaṃ sadā caret // MBhT_3.38
children.translated_text: Therefore indeed a <s>vipra</s> (brahmin) should always engage in the drinking of <s>madya</s>.

children.text: vedamātājapenaiva brāhmaṇo na hi śailaje /
children.translated_text: A <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> does not become so merely by reciting the <s>Vedamātā</s> (Gāyatrī), O <s>Śailajā</s>;

children.text: brahmajñānaṃ yadā devi tadā brāhmaṇa ucyate // MBhT_3.39
children.translated_text: when <s>brahmajñāna</s> (knowledge of Brahman) arises, O Goddess, then one is called a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

children.text: devānām amṛtaṃ brahma tad iyaṃ laukikī surā /
children.translated_text: The <s>amṛta</s> (nectar) of the gods is <s>Brahman</s>; this worldly <s>surā</s> (liquor) is its counterpart.

children.text: suratvaṃ bhogamātreṇa surā tena prakīrtitā // MBhT_3.40
children.translated_text: Divinity through the experience of enjoyment alone — therefore it is called <s>surā</s> (that which bestows divinity).

children.text: mantratrayaṃ sadā pāṭhyaṃ brahmaśāpādi mocanam /
children.translated_text: The three mantras should always be recited — they bring release from the curse of <s>Brahman</s> and the like.

children.text: prakuryāt tu dvijenaiva tadā brahmamayī surā // MBhT_3.41
children.translated_text: should be performed by a twice-born alone; then <s>surā</s> (liquor) becomes filled with <s>Brahman</s>-essence. // MBhT_3.41

children.text: havir āropamātreṇa vahnir dīpto yathā bhavet /
children.translated_text: Just as fire blazes merely by the offering of oblation,

children.text: śāpamocanamātreṇa surā muktipradāyinī // MBhT_3.42
children.translated_text: merely by the removal of the curse, <s>surā</s> (liquor) becomes the bestower of liberation. // MBhT_3.42

children.text: ata eva hi deveśi brāhmaṇaḥ pānam ācaret /
children.translated_text: Therefore indeed, O Goddess of the Gods, a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should partake of the drink;

children.text: sa brāhmaṇaḥ sa vedajñaḥ so 'gnihotrī sa dīkṣitaḥ // MBhT_3.43
children.translated_text: he is a true <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, he is a knower of the <s>Vedas</s>, he is a keeper of the sacred fire, he is one who has received <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation). // MBhT_3.43

body.text: bahu kiṃ kathyate devi sa eva triguṇātmakaḥ // MBhT_3.44
body.translated_text: What more can be said, O Goddess? He alone is of the nature of the three <s>guṇas</s>. // MBhT_3.44

children.text: muktimārgam idaṃ devi goptavyaṃ paśusaṃkaṭe /
children.translated_text: This path of liberation, O Goddess, must be kept secret in the midst of <s>paśus</s> (uninitiated beings);

children.text: prakāśāt kāyahāniḥ syān nindanīyo na cānyathā // MBhT_3.45
children.translated_text: from disclosure there would be destruction of the body, and one becomes censured — not otherwise. // MBhT_3.45

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Fourth Chapter

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: kāraṇena mahāmokṣaṃ nirmālyena śivasya ca /
children.translated_text: That through <s>kāraṇa</s> (ritual liquor) there is great liberation, and through the <s>nirmālya</s> (offerings) of <s>Śiva</s>,

children.text: śrutaṃ vede purāṇe ca tava vaktre sureśvara // MBhT_4.1
children.translated_text: I have heard in the <s>Vedas</s> and <s>Purāṇas</s>, and from Your own mouth, O Lord of the Gods. // MBhT_4.1

children.text: agrāhyaṃ tava nirmālyam agrāhyaṃ kāraṇaṃ vibho /
children.translated_text: His <s>nirmālya</s> is said to be unacceptable, <s>kāraṇa</s> (ritual liquor) is said to be unacceptable, O Lord;

children.text: mṛṣā vākyaṃ mahādeva kathaṃ vadasi yogabhṛt // MBhT_4.2
children.translated_text: are these false words, O <s>Mahādeva</s>? How do You, the bearer of <s>yoga</s>, speak thus? // MBhT_4.2

children.text: kāraṇena vinā devi mokṣajñānādikaṃ na hi /
children.translated_text: Without <s>kāraṇa</s>, O Goddess, there is no knowledge of liberation and the like;

children.text: mahāśaṅkhaṃ vinā devi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ // MBhT_4.3
children.translated_text: without <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> (the great conch rosary), O Goddess, no <s>mantra</s> is a bestower of <s>siddhi</s> (attainment). // MBhT_4.3

children.text: sākṣād brahmamayī mālā mahāśaṅkhākhyayā punaḥ /
children.translated_text: The rosary filled with <s>Brahman</s>-essence, known as <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s>,

children.text: śilāyantre ca vṛndāyāṃ gaṅgāyāṃ surapūjite /
children.translated_text: at the stone altar, at <s>Vṛndā</s> (Tulasī shrine), at the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, and at places of divine worship —

children.text: naiva spṛśen mahāśaṅkhaṃ sparśanāt kāṣṭhavad bhavet // MBhT_4.4
children.translated_text: one should never touch the <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> (there), for by such contact it becomes like wood. // MBhT_4.4

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: gaṅgā tu kāraṇaṃ vāri madyaṃ paramakāraṇam /
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṅgā</s> is the causal water, and <s>madya</s> (liquor) is the supreme <s>kāraṇa</s> (cause);

children.text: kāraṇasparśamātreṇa mālāḥ śuddhā bhavanti hi // MBhT_4.5
children.translated_text: merely by the touch of <s>kāraṇa</s>, rosaries become purified. // MBhT_4.5

children.text: gaṅgāsparśena deveśa kāṣṭhavan mālikā katham /
children.translated_text: By the touch of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, O Lord of the Gods, how does the rosary become like wood?

children.text: vada me parameśāna iti me saṃśayo hṛdi // MBhT_4.6
children.translated_text: Tell me, O Supreme Lord — this doubt resides in my heart. // MBhT_4.6

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: kāraṇaṃ devadeveśi mokṣadaṃ sarvajātiṣu /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāraṇa</s> (ritual liquor), O Goddess of Gods, bestows liberation upon all castes;

children.text: tathā svargādijanakaṃ gaṅgātoyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_4.7
children.translated_text: likewise, the water of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> produces heaven and the like — there is no doubt. // MBhT_4.7

children.text: kāraṇe nivased devi mahākālī parā kalā /
children.translated_text: In <s>kāraṇa</s> resides, O Goddess, <s>Mahākālī</s>, the supreme <s>kalā</s> (creative power);

children.text: mahāvidyā vasen nityaṃ surāyāṃ parameśvari // MBhT_4.8
children.translated_text: the <s>Mahāvidyā</s> (great wisdom goddess) eternally dwells in <s>surā</s> (liquor), O <s>Parameśvarī</s>. // MBhT_4.8

children.text: mahāśaṅkhe vasen nityaṃ pañcāśadvarṇarūpiṇī /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> eternally resides She who has the form of the fifty letters;

children.text: mahāvidyā vasen nityaṃ mahāśaṅkhe ca sarvadā // MBhT_4.9
children.translated_text: the <s>Mahāvidyā</s> eternally dwells in the <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> at all times. // MBhT_4.9

children.text: gaṅgāsparśanamātreṇa gaṅgāyāṃ līyate priye /
children.translated_text: Merely by the touch of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, it dissolves into the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, O Beloved;

children.text: kāṣṭhasparśanamātreṇa kāṣṭhe vahnis tṛṇe yathā // MBhT_4.10
children.translated_text: just as by the touch of wood, fire (dissolves) into the wood and grass. // MBhT_4.10

children.text: gaṅgāsparśe tathā devi gaṅgāyāṃ līyate priye /
children.translated_text: Similarly by the touch of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, O Goddess, it dissolves into the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, O Beloved;

children.text: tatkṣaṇe ca mahāśaṅkhaḥ kāṣṭhavan nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_4.11
children.translated_text: at that very moment the <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> becomes like wood — there is no doubt in this. // MBhT_4.11

body.text: śilāyantre tulasyādau tathaiva parameśvari // MBhT_4.12
body.translated_text: The same applies at the stone altar, at <s>Tulasī</s> shrines, and so forth, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>. // MBhT_4.12

children.text: mahāśaṅkhākhyamālāyāṃ yo japet sādhakottamaḥ /
children.translated_text: The best of <s>sādhakas</s> (practitioners) who performs <s>japa</s> (recitation) with the rosary called <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> —

children.text: aṣṭasiddhiḥ kare tasya sa eva śambhur avyayaḥ /
children.translated_text: the eight <s>siddhis</s> (attainments) are in his hand; he himself is the imperishable <s>Śambhu</s>.

children.text: maulau gaṅgā sthitā yasya gaṅgāsnānena tasya kim // MBhT_4.13
children.translated_text: He upon whose head the <s>Gaṅgā</s> is established — what need has he of bathing in the <s>Gaṅgā</s>? // MBhT_4.13

children.text: vārāṇasī kāmarūpaṃ haridvāraṃ prayāgakam /
children.translated_text: <s>Vārāṇasī</s>, <s>Kāmarūpa</s>, <s>Haridvāra</s>, <s>Prayāga</s>,

children.text: gaṇḍakī badarikā devi gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgamam // MBhT_4.14
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṇḍakī</s>, <s>Badarikā</s>, O Goddess, and the confluence of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> with the ocean — // MBhT_4.14

children.text: yasya bhaktir mahāśaṅkhe tasya darśanamātrataḥ /
children.translated_text: for one who has devotion to the <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s>, merely by its sight,

children.text: tīrthasnānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_4.15
children.translated_text: the fruit of bathing at all <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred fords) is obtained — there is no doubt. // MBhT_4.15

children.text: iti te kathitaṃ kānte sarvaṃ paramadurlabham /
children.translated_text: Thus I have told you, O Beloved, all that is supremely rare to obtain;

children.text: na vaktavyaṃ paśor agre prāṇānte parameśvari // MBhT_4.16
children.translated_text: it should not be spoken before a <s>paśu</s> (uninitiated person), even at the cost of one's life, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>. // MBhT_4.16

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Fifth Chapter

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: pāradaṃ bhasmanirmāṇaṃ kenopāyena śaṃkara /
children.translated_text: By what method, O <s>Śaṃkara</s>, is the preparation of <s>bhasma</s> (calcinated ash) from <s>pārada</s> (mercury) accomplished?

children.text: tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi yadi te 'sti kṛpā mayi // MBhT_5.1
children.translated_text: I wish to hear that, if You have compassion for me. // MBhT_5.1

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: pārade bhasmanirmāṇe nānāvighnāni pārvati /
children.translated_text: In the preparation of <s>bhasma</s> from <s>pārada</s> (mercury), there are many obstacles, O <s>Pārvatī</s>;

children.text: ata eva hi tatrādau śāntiṃ kuryād dvijottamaḥ // MBhT_5.2
children.translated_text: therefore, at the very outset, the best of twice-born should perform a pacification rite. // MBhT_5.2

children.text: varayet karmakartāraṃ vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥ /
children.translated_text: One should select the performer of the rite according to the procedure to be described;

children.text: pūjayet ṣoḍaśaliṅgaṃ pārthivaṃ parvatātmaje // MBhT_5.3
children.translated_text: one should worship sixteen <s>liṅgas</s> made of earth, O Daughter of the Mountain. // MBhT_5.3

children.text: ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa toḍaloktavidhānataḥ /
children.translated_text: With the sixteen <s>upacāras</s> (offerings), according to the procedure stated in the <s>Toḍala</s> (tantra),

children.text: bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ sureśvari // MBhT_5.4
children.translated_text: one should offer <s>madhuparka</s> (honey mixture) fit for enjoyment, O Goddess of the Gods. // MBhT_5.4

children.text: pañcāmṛtena deveśaṃ snāpayec chuddhavāriṇā /
children.translated_text: One should bathe the Lord of Gods with the five nectars (<s>pañcāmṛta</s>) and then with pure water;

children.text: puruṣasya yathāyogyaṃ yugmavastraṃ nivedayet // MBhT_5.5
children.translated_text: one should offer a pair of garments befitting the person. // MBhT_5.5

children.text: caturaṅgulivistāraṃ raupyanirmāṇapīṭhakam /
children.translated_text: A silver pedestal four fingers in breadth,

children.text: alaṃkāraṃ yathāyogyaṃ puruṣasya nivedayet // MBhT_5.6
children.translated_text: and ornaments befitting the person should be offered. // MBhT_5.6

children.text: alaktakayutaṃ vāpi dadyān malayajaṃ śive /
children.translated_text: One should also give lac-smeared (items) or sandalwood paste, O <s>Śiva</s>'s consort;

children.text: ṣaḍaṅgadhūpaṃ deveśi pradadyāc ca punaḥ punaḥ // MBhT_5.7
children.translated_text: one should offer the six-ingredient incense (<s>ṣaḍaṅgadhūpa</s>), O Goddess of Gods, again and again. // MBhT_5.7

children.text: ghṛtayuktaṃ tathā dīpaṃ dadyāt kalyāṇahetave /
children.translated_text: One should give a lamp with ghee for the sake of auspiciousness;

children.text: naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ ramyaṃ nānāphalasamanvitam // MBhT_5.8
children.translated_text: food offerings (<s>naivedya</s>) of various kinds, delightful, accompanied by various fruits. // MBhT_5.8

children.text: śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā pāyasaṃ vinivedayet /
children.translated_text: Having prepared <s>pāyasa</s> (rice pudding) mixed with sugar, one should offer it;

children.text: dadyāt toyaṃ maheśāni vijayāsaṃyutaṃ priye // MBhT_5.9
children.translated_text: one should give water, O Great Goddess, mixed with <s>vijayā</s> (cannabis), O Beloved. // MBhT_5.9

children.text: ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ gajāntakasahasrakam /
children.translated_text: The great six-syllabled <s>mantra</s>, one thousand times with the elephant-destroyer (suffix),

children.text: prajapet sādhakaśreṣṭhas tataḥ siddho bhaved dhruvam // MBhT_5.10
children.translated_text: the best of <s>sādhakas</s> should recite; then <s>siddhi</s> (attainment) will certainly be achieved. // MBhT_5.10

children.text: athavā parameśāni dhanadāṃ dhanadāyinīm /
children.translated_text: Alternatively, O Supreme Goddess, one should worship <s>Dhanadā</s> (the wealth-giving goddess),

children.text: pūjayed bahuyatnena ṣoḍaśenopacārataḥ // MBhT_5.11
children.translated_text: the bestower of wealth, with great effort, with the sixteen <s>upacāras</s>. // MBhT_5.11

children.text: dvādaśāhvaṃ yajed dhīmān diksahasraṃ tato japet /
children.translated_text: The wise one should worship for twelve days and then recite ten thousand times;

children.text: taddaśāṃśaṃ maheśāni homaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ // MBhT_5.12
children.translated_text: one-tenth of that, O Great Goddess, the discerning one should perform as <s>homa</s> (fire offering). // MBhT_5.12

children.text: homakarmādyaśaktaś ced dviguṇaṃ japam ācaret /
children.translated_text: If unable to perform the <s>homa</s> rites and so forth, one should perform double the <s>japa</s>;

children.text: yadi prītā bhavet sā hi tadā kiṃ vā na sidhyati // MBhT_5.13
children.translated_text: if she is pleased, then what indeed cannot be accomplished? // MBhT_5.13

children.text: pratyahaṃ parameśāni kubero dīyate vasu /
children.translated_text: Every day, O Supreme Goddess, <s>Kubera</s> (god of wealth) bestows riches;

children.text: bhasmanirmāṇakaṃ devi vicitraṃ tasya kiṃ śive // MBhT_5.14
children.translated_text: the preparation of <s>bhasma</s>, O Goddess — what wonder is that for him, O <s>Śiva</s>'s consort? // MBhT_5.14

children.text: gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ /
children.translated_text: One should give <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee) to the <s>guru</s> according to the extent of one's means;

children.text: tataḥ siddho bhaven mantrī nātra kāryā vicāraṇā // MBhT_5.15
children.translated_text: then the <s>mantra</s>-practitioner becomes accomplished — no deliberation is needed here. // MBhT_5.15

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: vidhānaṃ devadeveśa bhasmanirmāṇakarmaṇi /
children.translated_text: The procedure, O God of Gods, for the rite of preparing <s>bhasma</s> —

children.text: sakṛt kṛte yena rūpe bhasmasāj jāyate vibho // MBhT_5.16
children.translated_text: by which method, performed once, <s>bhasma</s> (calcinated ash) is produced, O Lord — // MBhT_5.16

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: ānīya pāradaṃ devi sthāpayet prastaropari /
children.translated_text: Having obtained <s>pārada</s> (mercury), O Goddess, one should place it upon a stone slab;

children.text: tasyopari japen mantraṃ sarvavandyanavātmakam // MBhT_5.17
children.translated_text: over it one should recite the <s>mantra</s> of the all-venerable nine-fold (deity). // MBhT_5.17

children.text: sāṣṭasahasraṃ deveśi prajapet sādhakāgraṇīḥ /
children.translated_text: Eight thousand times, O Goddess of Gods, the foremost of <s>sādhakas</s> should recite,

children.text: syayambhupuṣpasaṃyukte vastre cāruṇasaṃnibhe // MBhT_5.18
children.translated_text: while (the mercury is placed) upon a cloth of reddish hue combined with <s>svayambhu</s> flowers (first menstrual blood of a virgin). // MBhT_5.18

children.text: saṃsthāpya pāradaṃ devi mṛtpātrayugale śive /
children.translated_text: Having placed the <s>pārada</s> (mercury), O Goddess, in a pair of earthen vessels, O <s>Śiva</s>'s consort,

children.text: puṣpayuktena sūtreṇa badhnīyād bahuyatnataḥ // MBhT_5.19
children.translated_text: one should bind them with great effort using a thread endowed with flowers. // MBhT_5.19

children.text: muktidhārājalenaiva dhānyasya parameśvari /
children.translated_text: With the liquid stream of liberation-water, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>,

children.text: lepayed bahuyatnena raudre śuṣkaṃ ca kārayet // MBhT_5.20
children.translated_text: one should coat (the vessel) with grain (paste) with great effort and dry it in the fierce (sun). // MBhT_5.20

children.text: punaś ca lepayed dhīmān tato vahnau vinikṣipet /
children.translated_text: Again the wise one should coat it, then cast it into fire;

children.text: aṣṭamīnavamīrātrau kṣipen naiva sureśvari // MBhT_5.21
children.translated_text: on the eighth and ninth nights one should not cast it (into fire), O Goddess of the Gods. // MBhT_5.21

children.text: athavā parameśāni mṛtpātre sthāpayed rasam /
children.translated_text: Alternatively, O Supreme Goddess, one should place the <s>rasa</s> (mercury) in an earthen vessel;

children.text: vallīrasena taddravyaṃ śodhayed bahuyatnataḥ // MBhT_5.22
children.translated_text: with the juice of the creeper-plant, one should purify that substance with great effort. // MBhT_5.22

children.text: ghṛtanārīrasenaiva tathaiva śodhanaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: One should likewise perform purification with ghee and woman's secretion;

children.text: evaṃ kṛte tu guṭikā yadi syād dṛḍhabandhanam // MBhT_5.23
children.translated_text: when done thus, if the pellet (<s>guṭikā</s>) achieves a firm binding — // MBhT_5.23

children.text: dhusturaṃ ca samānīya madhye śūnyaṃ ca kārayet /
children.translated_text: one should obtain <s>dhustūra</s> (datura) and make the center hollow;

children.text: kṛṣṇākhyatulasīyoge tathā ghṛtakumārikā // MBhT_5.24
children.translated_text: combined with black <s>tulasī</s>, and likewise <s>ghṛtakumārikā</s> (aloe vera) — // MBhT_5.24

children.text: evaṃ kṛte vahniyoge bhasmasāj jāyate kila /
children.translated_text: when done thus with the application of fire, <s>bhasma</s> (calcinated ash) is indeed produced;

children.text: bhasmayoge bhavet svarṇaṃ dhanadāyāḥ prasādataḥ // MBhT_5.25
children.translated_text: with the application of <s>bhasma</s>, <s>svarṇa</s> (gold) is produced, by the grace of <s>Dhanadā</s> (the wealth-goddess). // MBhT_5.25

body.text: vivarṇaṃ jāyate dravyaṃ yadi pūjāṃ na cācaret // MBhT_5.26
body.translated_text: The substance becomes discolored if one does not perform the worship. // MBhT_5.26

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: svayambhu kīdṛśaṃ nātha kuṇḍagolaṃ tu kīdṛśam /
children.translated_text: What is <s>svayambhu</s> (self-born), O Lord? And what is <s>kuṇḍagola</s>?

children.text: svapuṣpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ nātha vajrapuṣpaṃ tu kīdṛśam /
children.translated_text: What is <s>svapuṣpa</s> (own-flower), O Lord? And what is <s>vajrapuṣpa</s> (diamond-flower)?

children.text: sarvakālodbhavaṃ nātha kīdṛśaṃ vada śaṃkara // MBhT_5.27
children.translated_text: And what is <s>sarvakālodbhava</s> (born at all times), O Lord? Tell me, O <s>Śaṃkara</s>. // MBhT_5.27

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: vivāharahitā kanyā prathamaṃ puṣpasaṃyutā /
children.translated_text: An unmarried virgin who has her first menstrual flow —

children.text: tacchoṇitaṃ maheśāni svayambhu nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_5.28
children.translated_text: that blood, O Great Goddess, is <s>svayambhu</s> (self-born) — there is no doubt. // MBhT_5.28

children.text: bhartari vidyamāne tu yā kanyā cānyajā śive /
children.translated_text: When the husband is living, a woman who has (a child) by another man, O <s>Śiva</s>'s consort —

children.text: tadudbhavaṃ kuṇḍapuṣpaṃ sarvakāryārthasādhakam // MBhT_5.29
children.translated_text: that which is produced from her is <s>kuṇḍapuṣpa</s> (kuṇḍa-flower), the accomplisher of all purposes. // MBhT_5.29

children.text: mṛte bhartari deveśi yā kanyā anyajā śive /
children.translated_text: When the husband has died, O Goddess of Gods, a woman who has (a child) by another man, O <s>Śiva</s>'s consort —

children.text: tadudbhavaṃ golapuṣpaṃ devavaśyakaraṃ param // MBhT_5.30
children.translated_text: that which is produced from her is <s>golapuṣpa</s> (gola-flower), supreme in bringing gods under control. // MBhT_5.30

children.text: vivāhitāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ prathame ṛtusambhave /
children.translated_text: Of a married woman, at the first occurrence of her menstrual cycle,

children.text: tacchoṇitaṃ maheśāni svapuṣpaṃ sarvamohanam // MBhT_5.31
children.translated_text: that blood, O Great Goddess, is <s>svapuṣpa</s> (own-flower), which enchants all. // MBhT_5.31

children.text: vivāhitāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ puruṣasya ca tāḍanāt /
children.translated_text: Of a married woman, from the striking by a man,

children.text: yadi puṣpaṃ samudbhūtaṃ vajraṃ tat parikīrtitam // MBhT_5.32
children.translated_text: if a flow is produced, that is declared to be <s>vajra</s> (diamond-flower). // MBhT_5.32

children.text: vivāhitāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ pratimāse ca yad bhavet /
children.translated_text: Of a married woman, that which occurs every month,

children.text: sarvakālodbhavaṃ puṣpaṃ kathitaṃ vīravandite // MBhT_5.33
children.translated_text: that is called <s>sarvakālodbhava</s> (born-at-all-times) flower, O one venerated by heroes. // MBhT_5.33

children.text: samakrośaṃ vahnimadhye sthāpayed bahuyatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: One should place it in the midst of fire at the same distance, with great effort;

children.text: tata utthāya tad dravyaṃ svarṇapātre nidhāya ca // MBhT_5.34
children.translated_text: then, having removed that substance, placing it in a golden vessel, // MBhT_5.34

children.text: prajapet parameśāni prāsādākhyaṃ mahāmanum /
children.translated_text: one should recite, O Supreme Goddess, the great <s>mantra</s> called <s>Prāsāda</s>;

children.text: tataḥ siddho bhaven mantrī nānyathā mama bhāṣitam // MBhT_5.35
children.translated_text: then the <s>mantra</s>-practitioner becomes accomplished — my word is not otherwise. // MBhT_5.35

children.text: etan mantraṃ maheśāni gajāntakasahasrakam /
children.translated_text: This <s>mantra</s>, O Great Goddess, with the elephant-destroyer (suffix) one thousand times,

children.text: japitvā pūjayet paścāt pārthivaṃ śivaliṅgakam // MBhT_5.36
children.translated_text: having recited it, one should then worship an earthen <s>Śivaliṅga</s>. // MBhT_5.36

children.text: tataḥ parīkṣā kartavyā śṛṇu matprāṇavallabhe /
children.translated_text: Then the test should be performed — hear, O my life's beloved:

children.text: śuddhatāmraṃ vahnimadhye mṛtpātre tolakaṃ mitam // MBhT_5.37
children.translated_text: pure copper, measured at one <s>tolaka</s> (unit of weight), in an earthen vessel in the midst of fire — // MBhT_5.37

children.text: dravībhūte ca tāmre ca guñjāmānaṃ kṣiped yadi /
children.translated_text: when the copper has become molten, if one casts in a <s>guñjā</s>-measure (of bhasma),

children.text: tatkṣaṇe parameśāni svarṇaṃ bhavati niścitam // MBhT_5.38
children.translated_text: at that very moment, O Supreme Goddess, it certainly becomes <s>svarṇa</s> (gold). // MBhT_5.38

children.text: guñjāpramāṇaṃ tad dravyaṃ bhojanaṃ kurute yadi /
children.translated_text: If one consumes that substance in a <s>guñjā</s>-measure as food,

children.text: sarvarogaparityakto jāyate madanopamaḥ /
children.translated_text: one becomes free from all diseases and becomes like <s>Madana</s> (the god of love);

children.text: mantrasiddhir bhavet tasya jāyate cirajīvitā // MBhT_5.39
children.translated_text: <s>mantra-siddhi</s> (perfection of mantra) is achieved by him, and long life is attained. // MBhT_5.39

children.text: pratyahaṃ parameśāni śatanārīṃ ramed yadi /
children.translated_text: Every day, O Supreme Goddess, even if one sports with a hundred women,

children.text: vīryādirahitaṃ na syāt tejovṛddhikaraṃ param // MBhT_5.40
children.translated_text: there would be no loss of virility and the like; it is supreme in increasing radiance. // MBhT_5.40

children.text: maraṇaṃ naiva paśyāmi yadi dhyānayuto bhavet /
children.translated_text: I see no death for one who is absorbed in meditation;

children.text: tasya vittaṃ vilokyaiva kubero 'pi tiraskṛtaḥ // MBhT_5.41
children.translated_text: seeing his wealth, even <s>Kubera</s> is put to shame. // MBhT_5.41

children.text: gānena tumburuḥ sākṣād dānena vāsavo yathā /
children.translated_text: In singing he is like <s>Tumburu</s> himself, in generosity like <s>Vāsava</s> (<s>Indra</s>);

children.text: maheśa iva yogīndro nirṛtir iva durdharaḥ // MBhT_5.42
children.translated_text: like <s>Maheśa</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) among the lords of <s>yogīs</s>, and irresistible like <s>Nirṛti</s>. // MBhT_5.42

children.text: mahābalo mahāvīryo mahāsāhasikaḥ śuciḥ /
children.translated_text: Of great strength, great prowess, great daring, and purity;

children.text: mahāsvaccho dayāvāṃś ca sarvaprāṇihite rataḥ /
children.translated_text: of great clarity, compassionate, and devoted to the welfare of all living beings —

children.text: bahu kiṃ kathyate devi sa eva gaṇanāyakaḥ // MBhT_5.43
children.translated_text: what more can be said, O Goddess? He himself is the Lord of the <s>Gaṇas</s>. // MBhT_5.43

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, ṣaṣṭaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Sixth Chapter

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: vada īśāna sarvajña sarvatattvavidāṃ vara /
children.translated_text: Speak, O <s>Īśāna</s>, omniscient one, best among knowers of all principles —

children.text: mahāroge mahāduḥkhe mahādāridryasaṃkaṭe // MBhT_6.1
children.translated_text: in great disease, great suffering, the affliction of great poverty, // MBhT_6.1

children.text: nānā vyādhigate vāpi nānāpīḍādisaṃkaṭe /
children.translated_text: when afflicted by various ailments, in the affliction of various torments,

children.text: rājyanāśe rājabhaye kārāgāragate punaḥ // MBhT_6.2
children.translated_text: in the destruction of a kingdom, in fear of the king, when cast into prison, // MBhT_6.2

children.text: rāyadaṇḍe ca deveśa tathā ca grahapīḍite /
children.translated_text: in royal punishment, O Lord of Gods, and likewise when afflicted by planetary influences —

children.text: kenopāyena deveśa mucyate vada śaṃkara // MBhT_6.3
children.translated_text: by what means, O Lord of Gods, is one liberated? Tell me, O <s>Śaṃkara</s>. // MBhT_6.3

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu cārvaṅgi subhage yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi /
children.translated_text: Listen, O beautiful-limbed one, O auspicious one, to what you ask me;

children.text: tat tat sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhāraya // MBhT_6.4
children.translated_text: I shall declare all of that — listen attentively and with care. // MBhT_6.4

children.text: yā cādyā paramā vidyā cāmuṇḍā kālikā parā /
children.translated_text: She who is the primordial, supreme <s>Vidyā</s> (wisdom goddess) — <s>Cāmuṇḍā</s>, the supreme <s>Kālikā</s> —

children.text: tasyāḥ prayogamātreṇa kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale // MBhT_6.5
children.translated_text: merely by the application (of her mantra), what does not become accomplished on earth? // MBhT_6.5

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: rāhuś caṇḍālo vikhyātaḥ sarvatra parameśvara /
children.translated_text: <s>Rāhu</s> is known everywhere as a <s>caṇḍāla</s> (outcaste), O <s>Parameśvara</s>;

children.text: puṇyakālaḥ kathaṃ deva tasya sparśe divākare // MBhT_6.6
children.translated_text: how then is his contact with the sun a meritorious time, O God? // MBhT_6.6

children.text: niśākare tathā nātha iti me saṃśayo hṛdi /
children.translated_text: Likewise with the moon, O Lord — this doubt resides in my heart;

children.text: kathayasva parānanda paścād anyat prakāśaya // MBhT_6.7
children.translated_text: explain this, O one of supreme bliss, and then reveal the rest. // MBhT_6.7

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu cārvaṅgi subhage grahaṇaṃ cottamottamam /
children.translated_text: Listen, O beautiful-limbed one, O auspicious one — <s>grahaṇa</s> (eclipse) is the highest of the high;

children.text: grahaṇaṃ trividhaṃ devi candrasūryāgnisaṃyutam // MBhT_6.8
children.translated_text: <s>grahaṇa</s> (eclipse) is threefold, O Goddess, associated with the moon, the sun, and fire. // MBhT_6.8

children.text: śakter lalāṭake netre vahnis tiṣṭhati sarvadā /
children.translated_text: On the forehead of <s>Śakti</s>, fire resides always upon her eye;

children.text: vāmanetre tathā candro dakṣe sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ // MBhT_6.9
children.translated_text: in the left eye is the moon, and in the right the sun is established. // MBhT_6.9

children.text: śambhunāthena deveśi ramaṇaṃ kriyate yadā /
children.translated_text: When Lord <s>Śambhu</s>, O Goddess of Gods, engages in lovemaking,

children.text: tadaiva grahaṇaṃ devi śaktiyukto yadā śivaḥ // MBhT_6.10
children.translated_text: that itself is the <s>grahaṇa</s> (eclipse), O Goddess — when <s>Śiva</s> is united with <s>Śakti</s>. // MBhT_6.10

children.text: vāmanetre cumbane tu śaśāṅkagrahaṇaṃ tadā /
children.translated_text: When there is kissing of the left eye, then that is the lunar eclipse;

children.text: dakṣanetre cumbane ca bhāskaragrahaṇaṃ tadā // MBhT_6.11
children.translated_text: when there is kissing of the right eye, then that is the solar eclipse. // MBhT_6.11

children.text: lalāṭe cumbane cāgnigrahaṇaṃ parameśvari /
children.translated_text: When there is kissing of the forehead, that is the fire-eclipse, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>;

children.text: śivavīryaṃ yato vahnirato 'dṛśyaḥ sureśvari // MBhT_6.12
children.translated_text: since <s>Śiva</s>'s seed is fire, therefore it is invisible, O Goddess of the Gods. // MBhT_6.12

children.text: rāhuḥ śivaḥ samākhyātas triguṇā śaktir īritā /
children.translated_text: <s>Rāhu</s> is declared to be <s>Śiva</s>, and the three-fold <s>guṇa</s> nature is called <s>Śakti</s>;

children.text: śivaśaktyoḥ samāyogo grahaṇaṃ parameśvari // MBhT_6.13
children.translated_text: the union of <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Śakti</s> is <s>grahaṇa</s> (eclipse), O <s>Parameśvarī</s>. // MBhT_6.13

children.text: śivaśaktisamāyogaḥ kālaṃ brahmamayaṃ priye /
children.translated_text: The union of <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Śakti</s> is a time filled with <s>Brahman</s>, O Beloved;

children.text: ata eva maheśāni rāśyādīn na vicārayet // MBhT_6.14
children.translated_text: therefore, O Great Goddess, one should not consider <s>rāśi</s> (zodiac signs) and the like. // MBhT_6.14

children.text: tithinakṣatrayogena yad yogaṃ parameśvari /
children.translated_text: By the conjunction of <s>tithi</s> (lunar day), <s>nakṣatra</s> (constellation), and <s>yoga</s> (astrological conjunction), O <s>Parameśvarī</s>,

children.text: tadaiva parameśāni rāśyādigaṇanaṃ caret // MBhT_6.15
children.translated_text: only then, O Supreme Goddess, should one calculate <s>rāśi</s> and similar things. // MBhT_6.15

children.text: śivaśaktisamāyogāt sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ jagat /
children.translated_text: From the union of <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Śakti</s>, the entire universe is pervaded by <s>Brahman</s>;

children.text: māsapakṣatithīnāṃ ca noccāryaṃ parameśvari // MBhT_6.16
children.translated_text: the month, fortnight, and <s>tithis</s> (lunar days) should not be uttered, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>. // MBhT_6.16

children.text: dṛṣṭimātreṇa japtavyaṃ tadā siddhir bhaved dhruvam /
children.translated_text: By mere sight (of the eclipse) one should perform <s>japa</s>; then <s>siddhi</s> (attainment) will certainly be achieved;

children.text: tatkālaṃ paramaṃ kālaṃ vijñeyaṃ vīravandite // MBhT_6.17
children.translated_text: that time is the supreme time — it should be recognized, O one venerated by heroes. // MBhT_6.17

children.text: tatra yad yat kṛtaṃ sarvam anantaphalam īritam /
children.translated_text: Whatever is performed then — all of it is declared to yield infinite fruit;

children.text: puraiva kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bahu kiṃ kathyate 'dhunā // MBhT_6.18
children.translated_text: all has been told before — what more can be said now? // MBhT_6.18

children.text: etat suguptabhedaṃ hi tava snehāt prakāśitam /
children.translated_text: This well-hidden secret has been revealed out of affection for you;

children.text: na vaktavyaṃ paśor agre na vaktavyaṃ sureśvari // MBhT_6.19
children.translated_text: it should not be spoken before a <s>paśu</s> (uninitiated person), it should not be spoken, O Goddess of the Gods. // MBhT_6.19

children.text: etat tattvaṃ prayatnena brahmā jānāti mādhavaḥ /
children.translated_text: This truth, with great effort, <s>Brahmā</s> knows, and <s>Mādhava</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>) knows;

children.text: pragoptavyaṃ prayatnena svayonir iva śailaje // MBhT_6.20
children.translated_text: it should be guarded with great effort, like one's own womb, O Daughter of the Mountain. // MBhT_6.20

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: cāmuṇḍāyā mahāmantraṃ kīdṛśaṃ parameśvara /
children.translated_text: What is the great <s>mantra</s> of <s>Cāmuṇḍā</s> like, O <s>Parameśvara</s>?

children.text: ārādhanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ vā tad vadasva dayānidhe // MBhT_6.21
children.translated_text: And what is her worship like? Tell me that, O treasury of compassion. // MBhT_6.21

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu cārvaṅgi subhage cāmuṇḍāmantram uttamam /
children.translated_text: Listen, O beautiful-limbed, O fortunate one, to the supreme <s>Cāmuṇḍā</s> <s>mantra</s>,

children.text: yasya vijñānamātreṇa punarjanma na vidyate // MBhT_6.22
children.translated_text: by the mere knowledge of which there is no rebirth. // MBhT_6.22

children.text: kālībījayugaṃ devi kūrcabījaṃ tataḥ param /
children.translated_text: A pair of <s>Kālī</s> <s>bījas</s>, O <s>Devī</s>, then the <s>kūrca</s> <s>bīja</s> after that,

children.text: tryakṣarī paramā vidyā cāmuṇḍā kālikā svayam // MBhT_6.23
children.translated_text: this three-syllabled supreme <s>vidyā</s> is <s>Cāmuṇḍā</s>, <s>Kālikā</s> herself. // MBhT_6.23

children.text: saptāhaṃ pūjayed devīm upacāraiś ca ṣoḍaśaiḥ /
children.translated_text: For seven days one should worship the <s>Devī</s> with the sixteen <s>upacāras</s> (offerings),

children.text: pūjānte prajapen mantraṃ trisahasraṃ varānane // MBhT_6.24
children.translated_text: and at the end of worship one should recite the <s>mantra</s> three thousand times, O beautiful-faced one. // MBhT_6.24

children.text: rātrau tu pañcatattvena pūjayet parameśvarīm /
children.translated_text: At night, with the <s>pañcatattva</s> (five substances), one should worship the Supreme Goddess,

children.text: tathā rātrau japen mantraṃ kulaśaktisamanvitam // MBhT_6.25
children.translated_text: and likewise at night one should recite the <s>mantra</s>, accompanied by the <s>kulaśakti</s>. // MBhT_6.25

children.text: yantranirmāṇayogyaṃ hi pīṭhaṃ dadyāt suvistaram /
children.translated_text: One should provide a broad seat suitable for the construction of the <s>yantra</s>,

children.text: bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ yathocitam // MBhT_6.26
children.translated_text: and one should offer <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-mixture) suitable for enjoyment, as is proper. // MBhT_6.26

children.text: śakter yathā vidheyaṃ syād yuvatyāḥ parameśvari /
children.translated_text: As is fitting for the <s>Śakti</s>, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>, for the young woman,

children.text: tathā vastraṃ pradātavyaṃ sarvakalyāṇahetave // MBhT_6.27
children.translated_text: so should garments be given, for the sake of all auspiciousness. // MBhT_6.27

children.text: alaṃkāraṃ yathāyogyaṃ tatra tatra niyojayet /
children.translated_text: Ornaments should be applied as appropriate in each place,

children.text: naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ ramyaṃ nānādravyasamanvitam // MBhT_6.28
children.translated_text: and <s>naivedya</s> (food offerings) of various kinds, delightful, composed of diverse substances. // MBhT_6.28

children.text: sāmiṣānnaṃ pradātavyaṃ paramānnaṃ saśarkaram /
children.translated_text: Food with meat should be offered, and the finest rice-pudding with sugar,

children.text: pūjayet parayā bhaktyā balidānaṃ tataḥ param // MBhT_6.29
children.translated_text: one should worship with supreme devotion, and then make the <s>balidāna</s> (sacrificial offering). // MBhT_6.29

children.text: pratyahaṃ parameśāni cādyante vā baliṃ haret /
children.translated_text: Every day, O <s>Parameśānī</s>, one should make the <s>bali</s> offering at the beginning and end,

children.text: sāṅge jāte maheśāni cāthavā balim āharet // MBhT_6.30
children.translated_text: or when the full rite is complete, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one should bring the <s>bali</s>. // MBhT_6.30

children.text: evaṃ kṛte mahāsiddhiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: When done thus, one obtains great <s>siddhi</s> (accomplishment) — there is no doubt in this.

children.text: dhanārthī dhanam āpnoti putrārthī putravān bhavet // MBhT_6.31
children.translated_text: One desiring wealth obtains wealth; one desiring a son becomes blessed with a son. // MBhT_6.31

children.text: vivāde jayam āpnoti rājadvāre jayī bhavet /
children.translated_text: In disputes one gains victory, at the king's court one becomes victorious,

children.text: sarvatra vijayī bhūtvā devīputra iva kṣitau // MBhT_6.32
children.translated_text: becoming triumphant everywhere, like a son of the <s>Devī</s> upon the earth. // MBhT_6.32

children.text: rogebhyo ghorarūpebhyaḥ pūjayitvā pramucyate /
children.translated_text: By worshipping, one is freed from terrible diseases,

children.text: icchāsiddhir bhavet tasya sarvasiddhir na cānyathā // MBhT_6.33
children.translated_text: fulfillment of desires becomes his, and all <s>siddhis</s> — it cannot be otherwise. // MBhT_6.33

children.text: kārāgāragate devi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Even one imprisoned, O <s>Devī</s>, is liberated — there is no doubt in this.

children.text: prayogaṃ parameśāni sāraṃ paramadurlabham // MBhT_6.34
children.translated_text: This practice, O <s>Parameśānī</s>, is the essence and supremely rare to obtain. // MBhT_6.34

children.text: atisnehena deveśi tava sthāne prakāśitam /
children.translated_text: Out of great affection, O Goddess of gods, it has been revealed in your presence.

children.text: athavā parameśāni paṭhec caṇḍīṃ sanātanīm // MBhT_6.35
children.translated_text: Alternatively, O <s>Parameśānī</s>, one should recite the eternal <s>Caṇḍī</s>. // MBhT_6.35

children.text: pūjayec caṇḍikāṃ devīṃ sugandhipuṣpasaṃyutaiḥ /
children.translated_text: One should worship the Goddess <s>Caṇḍikā</s> with fragrant flowers,

children.text: dhūpadīpena gandhena naivedyena sureśvari // MBhT_6.36
children.translated_text: with incense, lamp, sandal-paste, and <s>naivedya</s>, O Queen of the gods. // MBhT_6.36

body.text: avaśyaṃ pañcatattvena pūjayec caṇḍikāṃ parām // MBhT_6.37
body.translated_text: One must certainly worship the supreme <s>Caṇḍikā</s> with the <s>pañcatattva</s>. // MBhT_6.37

children.text: ādāv ṛṣyādisūktena cārghyānte parameśvari /
children.translated_text: First, with the <s>ṛṣyādi</s> <s>sūkta</s> (seer-declaration hymn), at the end of the <s>arghya</s>, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>,

children.text: pañcatattvaṃ samānīya śodhayec chāstravittamaḥ // MBhT_6.38
children.translated_text: having brought the <s>pañcatattva</s>, the one most learned in the scriptures should purify them. // MBhT_6.38

children.text: tarpaṇaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā cārghyapātre vinikṣipet /
children.translated_text: Then, having performed <s>tarpaṇa</s> (libation), one should place them in the <s>arghya</s> vessel,

children.text: arghyodakena saṃprokṣya pūjayet pīṭhadevatām // MBhT_6.39
children.translated_text: and sprinkling with the <s>arghya</s> water, one should worship the <s>pīṭhadevatā</s> (seat-deity). // MBhT_6.39

children.text: praṇavaṃ ca samuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ tataḥ param /
children.translated_text: Having extracted the <s>praṇava</s> (Oṃ) and then the <s>māyābīja</s>,

children.text: prabhāṃ māyāṃ jayāṃ sūkṣmāṃ viśuddhāṃ nandinīṃ tathā // MBhT_6.40
children.translated_text: <s>Prabhā</s>, <s>Māyā</s>, <s>Jayā</s>, <s>Sūkṣmā</s>, <s>Viśuddhā</s>, <s>Nandinī</s>, // MBhT_6.40

children.text: suprabhāṃ vijayāṃ sarvasiddhidāṃ paripūjayet /
children.translated_text: <s>Suprabhā</s>, <s>Vijayā</s>, and the giver of all <s>siddhis</s> — one should worship them.

children.text: vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya hūṃ phaḍ ityantatas tataḥ // MBhT_6.41
children.translated_text: "vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya hūṃ phaḍ" — thus ending, then // MBhT_6.41

children.text: namo 'ntena tu deveśi āsanaṃ ca samarcayet /
children.translated_text: with "namaḥ" at the end, O Goddess of gods, one should worship the seat.

children.text: gurupaṅktiṃ pūjayitvā punar dhyānaṃ samācaret // MBhT_6.42
children.translated_text: Having worshipped the <s>guru</s> lineage, one should again perform <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation). // MBhT_6.42

children.text: āvāhanaṃ tato mudrāṃ jīvanyāsaṃ prapūjanam /
children.translated_text: Then invocation, <s>mudrā</s>, <s>jīvanyāsa</s> (life-installation), and full worship,

children.text: ṣaḍaṅgena tu sampūjya parivārān prapūjayet // MBhT_6.43
children.translated_text: having worshipped with the six limbs, one should worship the retinue deities. // MBhT_6.43

children.text: śaṅkhanidhiṃ padmanidhiṃ tathā brāhmyādikaṃ yajet /
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkhanidhi</s> and <s>Padmanidhi</s>, and likewise <s>Brāhmī</s> and the others one should worship,

children.text: indrādīṃś caiva vajrādīn pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ // MBhT_6.44
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> and the others, and <s>Vajra</s> and the rest — the best of <s>sādhakas</s> should worship them. // MBhT_6.44

children.text: praṇavādinamo 'ntena pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ /
children.translated_text: Beginning with <s>praṇava</s> and ending with "namaḥ," the best of <s>sādhakas</s> should worship,

children.text: punar devīṃ maheśāni pañcatattvena pūjayet // MBhT_6.45
children.translated_text: and again, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one should worship the <s>Devī</s> with the <s>pañcatattva</s>. // MBhT_6.45

children.text: prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gurumantreṣṭadevatām /
children.translated_text: Then, having performed <s>prāṇāyāma</s> (breath-control), contemplating the unity of the <s>guru</s>, the <s>mantra</s>, and the <s>iṣṭadevatā</s> (chosen deity),

children.text: aikyaṃ vibhāvya deveśi mūlamantraṃ japec chatam // MBhT_6.46
children.translated_text: O Goddess of gods, one should recite the <s>mūlamantra</s> (root mantra) one hundred times. // MBhT_6.46

children.text: prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kāraṇādīn samāharet /
children.translated_text: Then, having performed <s>prāṇāyāma</s>, one should gather the <s>kāraṇa</s> (ritual wine) and the rest,

children.text: tasyai dattvā svayaṃ pītvā paṭhec caṇḍīṃ sureśvari // MBhT_6.47
children.translated_text: having given it to her and having drunk oneself, one should recite the <s>Caṇḍī</s>, O Queen of the gods. // MBhT_6.47

children.text: sāṅge jāte tu māhātmye punaḥ pānaṃ samācaret /
children.translated_text: When the full rite including the <s>Māhātmya</s> is complete, one should again partake of the drink,

children.text: tatas tu prapaṭhed dhīmān krameṇa pānam ācaret // MBhT_6.48
children.translated_text: then the wise one should recite further, taking the drink in due order. // MBhT_6.48

children.text: samāpte tu vilomena punar mantraṃ śataṃ japet /
children.translated_text: When completed, in reverse order one should again recite the <s>mantra</s> one hundred times.

children.text: yadi bhāgyavaśād devi śaktiyogaṃ labhen naraḥ // MBhT_6.49
children.translated_text: If by the grace of fortune, O <s>Devī</s>, a man obtains union with <s>Śakti</s>, // MBhT_6.49

children.text: tatkṣaṇe hi vijānīyāt sarvasiddhiḥ kare sthitā /
children.translated_text: at that very instant he should know that all <s>siddhis</s> rest in his hand.

children.text: evaṃ kṛtvā maheśāni yadi pāṭhaṃ samācaret // MBhT_6.50
children.translated_text: Having done thus, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, if one performs the recitation, // MBhT_6.50

children.text: māhātmyaṃ tasya pāṭhasya kiṃ vaktuṃ śakyate mayā /
children.translated_text: the greatness of that recitation — how can it be expressed by me?

children.text: śatavaktraṃ yadi bhavet tadā vaktuṃ na śakyate // MBhT_6.51
children.translated_text: Even if one had a hundred mouths, still it could not be told. // MBhT_6.51

children.text: pañcavaktreṇa deveśi kiṃ vaktuṃ śakyate 'dhunā /
children.translated_text: With five mouths, O Goddess of gods, what can now be spoken?

children.text: sakṛt pāṭhena deveśi kiṃ punar brahma kevalam // MBhT_6.52
children.translated_text: By a single recitation, O Goddess of gods, what then of <s>Brahman</s> alone? // MBhT_6.52

children.text: avaśyaṃ labhate śāntiṃ sarvatra parameśvari /
children.translated_text: One certainly obtains peace everywhere, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>,

children.text: yadi śāntiṃ na labhate mama vākyaṃ mṛṣā tadā // MBhT_6.53
children.translated_text: and if peace is not obtained, then my word is false. // MBhT_6.53

children.text: ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa prathamaṃ pūjanaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: First, one should perform worship with the sixteen <s>upacāras</s>,

children.text: dvitīye pañcatattvena pūjayec caṇḍikāṃ priye // MBhT_6.54
children.translated_text: and the second time, one should worship <s>Caṇḍikā</s> with the <s>pañcatattva</s>, O beloved. // MBhT_6.54

children.text: sahasrāvṛttipāṭhena yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥ /
children.translated_text: The fruit that a man obtains by recitation of a thousand repetitions,

children.text: sakṛt pāṭhasya deveśi kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm // MBhT_6.55
children.translated_text: a single recitation, O Goddess of gods, does not merit even one-sixteenth of it. // MBhT_6.55

body.text: dhyānam asyāḥ pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā paṭhen naraḥ // MBhT_6.56
body.translated_text: I shall now declare the <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation) for her, by meditating upon which one should recite: // MBhT_6.56

children.text: oṃ yā caṇḍī madhukaiṭabhādidaityadalanī māhiṣonmādinī yā dhūmrekṣaṇacaṇḍamuṇḍamathanī yā raktabījāśanī /
children.translated_text: Oṃ — She who is <s>Caṇḍī</s>, the crusher of the demons <s>Madhu</s> and <s>Kaiṭabha</s> and others, she who drove <s>Mahiṣa</s> to madness, she who destroyed the fierce <s>Caṇḍa</s> and <s>Muṇḍa</s> of terrible gaze, she who devoured <s>Raktabīja</s>,

children.text: śaktiḥ śumbhaniśumbhadaityadalanī yā siddhilakṣmīḥ parā sā devī navakoṭimūrtisahitā māṃ pātu viśveśvarī // MBhT_6.57
children.translated_text: the <s>Śakti</s> who crushed the demons <s>Śumbha</s> and <s>Niśumbha</s>, she who is the supreme <s>Siddhi-Lakṣmī</s> — may that <s>Devī</s>, accompanied by nine crore forms, <s>Viśveśvarī</s> (Sovereign of the Universe), protect me! // MBhT_6.57

body.text: dhyānam etac caṇḍikāyāḥ śṛṇuṣva vīravandite // MBhT_6.58
body.translated_text: This is the <s>dhyāna</s> of <s>Caṇḍikā</s> — hear it, O one praised by heroes. // MBhT_6.58

children.text: śṛṇu mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi trailokyeṣu ca durlabham /
children.translated_text: Hear, I shall declare the <s>mantra</s> that is rare to obtain in the three worlds.

children.text: vedādyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ māyāṃ kāmabījaṃ tataḥ param // MBhT_6.59
children.translated_text: The Vedic first syllable, <s>vāgbhava</s> (aiṃ), then <s>māyā</s> (hrīṃ), then the <s>kāmabīja</s> (klīṃ), // MBhT_6.59

children.text: sthiramāyāṃ mahāmāyāṃ kāmabījaṃ tato namaḥ /
children.translated_text: then <s>sthiramāyā</s>, <s>mahāmāyā</s>, then the <s>kāmabīja</s>, then "namaḥ" —

children.text: navākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ japed ādau śataṃ priye // MBhT_6.60
children.translated_text: this nine-syllabled great <s>mantra</s> one should first recite one hundred times, O beloved. // MBhT_6.60

children.text: viparītaṃ mahāmantraṃ pāṭhānte tu śataṃ japet /
children.translated_text: The great <s>mantra</s> in reverse order one should recite one hundred times at the end of the recitation.

children.text: śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi ṛṣicchandaḥ sudurlabham // MBhT_6.61
