children.translated_text: Hear, O <s>Devī</s>, I shall declare the <s>ṛṣi</s> (seer) and <s>chandas</s> (metre), which are most rare to obtain: // MBhT_6.61

body.text: oṃ saptaśatīmahāstotrasya medhātithiṛṣir gāyatryanuṣṭubbṛhatīpaṃktitriṣtubjagatyaś chandāṃsi mahākālīmahālakṣmīmahāsarasvīdevatāstavakaṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ bījāni kṣrauṃ śaktiḥ mamāmukakāmasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ // MBhT_6.62
body.translated_text: Oṃ — Of the great <s>stotra</s> of the <s>Saptaśatī</s>, the <s>ṛṣi</s> is <s>Medhātithi</s>; the <s>chandas</s> are <s>Gāyatrī</s>, <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, <s>Bṛhatī</s>, <s>Paṅkti</s>, <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, and <s>Jagatī</s>; the deities are <s>Mahākālī</s>, <s>Mahālakṣmī</s>, and <s>Mahāsarasvatī</s> along with their hymn-group; the <s>bījas</s> are aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ; the <s>śakti</s> is kṣrauṃ — the <s>viniyoga</s> (ritual dedication) is for the fulfillment of such-and-such desire of me, so-and-so. // MBhT_6.62

children.text: praṇavena maheśāni ṣaḍaṅganyāsam ācaret /
children.translated_text: With the <s>praṇava</s>, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one should perform the <s>ṣaḍaṅganyāsa</s> (six-limbed installation).

children.text: iti te kathitaṃ kānte caṇḍīpāṭhasya lakṣaṇam // MBhT_6.63
children.translated_text: Thus has been told to you, O beloved, the characteristics of the <s>Caṇḍī</s> recitation. // MBhT_6.63

body.text: sārvaṇiḥ sūrya ityādi sārvaṇir bhavitā manuḥ etanmātraṃ paṭhed devi kiṃcin nyūnādhikaṃ na hi // MBhT_6.64
body.translated_text: "<s>Sārvaṇiḥ</s> <s>Sūrya</s>" and so forth — "<s>Sārvaṇi</s> shall be the <s>manu</s>" — this much alone one should recite, O <s>Devī</s>, neither less nor more. // MBhT_6.64

body.text: vāratrayaṃ paṭhed devi saṃjapya tu dinatrayam // MBhT_6.65
body.translated_text: Three times one should recite, O <s>Devī</s>, having chanted for three days. // MBhT_6.65

children.text: mahāroge sahāduḥkhe rājapīḍādidāruṇe /
children.translated_text: In great illness, in difficult suffering, in terrible afflictions from royal persecution,

children.text: nānā vyādhigate vāpi rājyanāśe tathā bhaye // MBhT_6.66
children.translated_text: or when afflicted by various diseases, in loss of kingdom, or in fear, // MBhT_6.66

children.text: grahapīḍādisaṃjāte brahmahatyādipātake /
children.translated_text: when there arise afflictions from planetary influences, or in sins such as <s>brahmahatyā</s> (killing of a brāhmaṇa) —

children.text: evaṃ pāṭhena deveśi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_6.67
children.translated_text: by this recitation, O Goddess of gods, one is freed — there is no doubt in this. // MBhT_6.67

children.text: bahu kiṃ kathyate devi sarvaśāntiṃ labhen naraḥ /
children.translated_text: What more can be said, O <s>Devī</s>? A man obtains complete peace,

children.text: sarvaśaṅkāvinirmukto jāyate madanopamaḥ // MBhT_6.68
children.translated_text: freed from all doubts, he becomes like <s>Madana</s> (the god of love). // MBhT_6.68

children.text: evaṃ kṛte maheśāni yadi siddhir na jāyate /
children.translated_text: If having done thus, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, <s>siddhi</s> does not arise,

children.text: punas tenaiva kartavyaṃ tataḥ siddho bhaved dhruvam // MBhT_6.69
children.translated_text: one should perform it again by the same method — then <s>siddhi</s> will certainly come. // MBhT_6.69

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Seventh Chapter

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śiva</s> spoke:

children.text: athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi tripurāmantram uttamam /
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare the supreme <s>mantra</s> of <s>Tripurā</s>,

children.text: yasya vijñānamātreṇa punarjanma na vidyate // MBhT_7.1
children.translated_text: by the mere knowledge of which there is no rebirth. // MBhT_7.1

children.text: tripurā trividhā devi bālā proktā purā śive /
children.translated_text: <s>Tripurā</s> is threefold, O <s>Devī</s>: <s>Bālā</s> was taught previously, O <s>Śivā</s>,

children.text: tathaiva bhairavī devī nityātantre mayoditā /
children.translated_text: and likewise <s>Bhairavī</s>, the <s>Devī</s>, was expounded by me in the <s>Nityātantra</s>,

children.text: idānīṃ sundarīṃ devī śṛṇu pārvati sādaram // MBhT_7.2
children.translated_text: now hear about <s>Sundarī</s>, the <s>Devī</s>, O <s>Pārvatī</s>, with reverence. // MBhT_7.2

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Devī</s> spoke:

children.text: mahāmantraṃ śrutaṃ nātha vāmakeśvarayāmale /
children.translated_text: The great <s>mantra</s> was heard, O Lord, in the <s>Vāmakeśvarayāmala</s>,

children.text: prātaḥkṛtyādi deveśa ārādhanakramaṃ vada // MBhT_7.3
children.translated_text: O God of gods, tell the order of worship beginning with the morning rites. // MBhT_7.3

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śiva</s> spoke:

children.text: prātar utthāya mantrajñaḥ sahasrāre nijaṃ gurum /
children.translated_text: Rising in the morning, the knower of <s>mantras</s> should, in the <s>sahasrāra</s> (thousand-petalled lotus), visualize his own <s>guru</s>,

children.text: pūrvoktadhyānam uccārya pūjayed bahuyatnataḥ // MBhT_7.4
children.translated_text: and reciting the meditation previously described, should worship with great effort. // MBhT_7.4

children.text: tathā ca śrīguror dhyānaṃ guptasādhanatantrake /
children.translated_text: And likewise the <s>dhyāna</s> of the Śrī <s>Guru</s> in the <s>Guptasādhanatantra</s> —

children.text: kathitaṃ ca mayā pūrvaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu varānane // MBhT_7.5
children.translated_text: it was told by me previously; now hear the <s>mantra</s>, O beautiful-faced one. // MBhT_7.5

children.text: vāgbījaṃ ca mahāmāyāṃ viṣṇuśaktiṃ samuccaret /
children.translated_text: One should utter the <s>vāgbīja</s> (aiṃ), then <s>Mahāmāyā</s> (hrīṃ), then <s>Viṣṇuśakti</s> (śrīṃ),

children.text: hasakhaphreṃ tathānandabhairavasya manuṃ tataḥ // MBhT_7.6
children.translated_text: then "hasakhaphreṃ" — and then the <s>manu</s> of <s>Ānandabhairava</s>. // MBhT_7.6

children.text: tasya śakter manuṃ paścāt tataś caivaṃ hasauḥ smṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: After that, the <s>manu</s> of his <s>Śakti</s>, and then thus "hasauḥ" is declared —

children.text: śrīguroś ca tathā śakter mantram etat sureśvari // MBhT_7.7
children.translated_text: this is the <s>mantra</s> of the Śrī <s>Guru</s> and likewise of the <s>Śakti</s>, O Queen of the gods. // MBhT_7.7

children.text: śrīguror ānandanāthānte athātaḥ śaktir īritā /
children.translated_text: Of the Śrī <s>Guru</s>, ending with "<s>Ānandanātha</s>" — and then the <s>Śakti</s> is declared:

children.text: vāgbījādīn samuccārya amukānandanātha ca // MBhT_7.8
children.translated_text: uttering the <s>vāgbīja</s> and the rest, then "Amukā <s>Ānandanāthā</s>," // MBhT_7.8

children.text: śrīpādukāṃ samuccārya pūjayāmi namas tataḥ /
children.translated_text: uttering "Śrī <s>Pādukāṃ</s> (sacred sandals)," then "pūjayāmi namaḥ" (I worship, obeisance).

children.text: vāgbījaṃ ca śambhupatnīṃ taduttare haripriyām // MBhT_7.9
children.translated_text: The <s>vāgbīja</s>, then the consort of <s>Śambhu</s>, and after that the beloved of <s>Hari</s>, // MBhT_7.9

children.text: bhūtabījaṃ samuccārya pravadec ca tadātmakam /
children.translated_text: uttering the <s>bhūtabīja</s> (hauṃ), one should declare it as having that nature,

children.text: samarpayāmi deveśi pūjāvidhir iti priye // MBhT_7.10
children.translated_text: "I offer" — O Goddess of gods, this is the method of worship, O beloved. // MBhT_7.10

children.text: tataś cāṣṭākṣaraṃ mantram aṣṭottaraśataṃ japet /
children.translated_text: Then the eight-syllabled <s>mantra</s> one should recite one hundred and eight times,

children.text: japaṃ samarpayitvā tu named añjalinā priye // MBhT_7.11
children.translated_text: and having offered the <s>japa</s>, one should bow with joined palms, O beloved. // MBhT_7.11

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Devī</s> spoke:

children.text: stutiṃ ca kavacaṃ nātha śrotum icchāmi sāmpratam /
children.translated_text: I wish to hear now the hymn and the armor, O Lord —

children.text: śrīguroḥ kavacaṃ stotraṃ tvayā proktaṃ purā prabho // MBhT_7.12
children.translated_text: the <s>kavaca</s> (armor) and <s>stotra</s> (hymn) of the Śrī <s>Guru</s> were spoken by you before, O Lord. // MBhT_7.12

children.text: idānīṃ strīguroḥ stotraṃ kavacaṃ mayi kathyatām /
children.translated_text: Now tell me the <s>stotra</s> and <s>kavaca</s> of the female <s>guru</s>,

children.text: yasya vijñānamātreṇa punarjanma na vidyate // MBhT_7.13
children.translated_text: by the mere knowledge of which there is no rebirth. // MBhT_7.13

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śiva</s> spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi stotraṃ paramagopanam /
children.translated_text: Hear, O <s>Devī</s>, I shall declare the <s>stotra</s> that is supremely secret,

children.text: yasya śravaṇamātreṇa saṃsārān mucyate naraḥ // MBhT_7.14
children.translated_text: by the mere hearing of which a man is freed from <s>saṃsāra</s> (the cycle of rebirth). // MBhT_7.14

children.text: namas te devadeveśi namas te harapūjite /
children.translated_text: Salutations to you, O Goddess of the gods of gods, salutations to you, O one worshipped by <s>Hara</s>,

children.text: brahmavidyāsvarūpāyai tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ // MBhT_7.15
children.translated_text: to her whose form is <s>Brahmavidyā</s> (knowledge of the Absolute), to her eternal obeisance, again and again. // MBhT_7.15

children.text: ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā /
children.translated_text: For one blinded by the darkness of ignorance, with the collyrium-stick of knowledge,

children.text: yayā cakṣur unmīlitaṃ tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ // MBhT_7.16
children.translated_text: by whom the eyes were opened — to her eternal obeisance, again and again. // MBhT_7.16

children.text: bhavabandhanapārasya tāriṇī jananī parā /
children.translated_text: She who is the one who ferries across the ocean of worldly bondage, the supreme Mother,

children.text: jñānadā mokṣadā nityā tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ // MBhT_7.17
children.translated_text: the giver of knowledge, the giver of <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation), the eternal one — to her eternal obeisance, again and again. // MBhT_7.17

children.text: śrīnāthavāmabhāgasthā sadā yā surapūjitā /
children.translated_text: She who stands at the left side of the Śrī Lord, always worshipped by the gods,

children.text: sadā vijñānadātrī ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ // MBhT_7.18
children.translated_text: she who always bestows knowledge — to her eternal obeisance, again and again. // MBhT_7.18

children.text: sahasrāre mahāpadme sadānandasvarūpiṇī /
children.translated_text: In the great <s>sahasrāra</s> lotus, she whose nature is eternal bliss,

children.text: mahāmokṣapradā devī tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ // MBhT_7.19
children.translated_text: the <s>Devī</s> who grants great liberation — to her eternal obeisance, again and again. // MBhT_7.19

children.text: brahmaviṣṇusvarūpā ca mahārudrasvarūpiṇī /
children.translated_text: She whose form is <s>Brahmā</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, whose form is the great <s>Rudra</s>,

children.text: triguṇātmasvarūpā ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ // MBhT_7.20
children.translated_text: whose nature is the three <s>guṇas</s> — to her eternal obeisance, again and again. // MBhT_7.20

children.text: candrasūryāgnirūpā ca sadāghūrṇitalocanā /
children.translated_text: She whose form is the moon, the sun, and fire, whose eyes are always rolling in ecstasy,

children.text: svanāthaṃ ca samāliṅgya tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ // MBhT_7.21
children.translated_text: embracing her own Lord — to her eternal obeisance, again and again. // MBhT_7.21

children.text: brahmaviṣṇuśivatvādijīvanmuktipradāyinī /
children.translated_text: She who grants <s>jīvanmukti</s> (liberation while living), beginning with the state of <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Śiva</s>,

children.text: jñānavijñānadātrī ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ // MBhT_7.22
children.translated_text: the bestower of knowledge and realization — to her eternal obeisance, again and again. // MBhT_7.22

children.text: idaṃ stotraṃ maheśāni yaḥ paṭhed bhaktisaṃyutaḥ /
children.translated_text: This <s>stotra</s>, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, whoever recites it with devotion,

children.text: sa siddhiṃ labhate nityaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_7.23
children.translated_text: he obtains <s>siddhi</s> eternally — truly, truly, there is no doubt. // MBhT_7.23

children.text: prātaḥkāle paṭhed yas tu gurupūjāpuraḥsaram /
children.translated_text: Whoever recites it in the morning, preceded by <s>guru</s> worship,

children.text: sa eva dhanyo loke 'smin devīputra iva kṣitau // MBhT_7.24
children.translated_text: he alone is blessed in this world, like a son of the <s>Devī</s> upon the earth. // MBhT_7.24

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṅkara</s> spoke:

children.text: stotraṃ samāptaṃ deveśi kavacaṃ śṛṇu sādaram /
children.translated_text: The <s>stotra</s> is complete, O Goddess of gods; now hear the <s>kavaca</s> with reverence,

children.text: yasya śravaṇamātreṇa vāgīśasamatāṃ vrajet // MBhT_7.25
children.translated_text: by the mere hearing of which one attains equality with the Lord of Speech. // MBhT_7.25

children.text: strīguroḥ kavacasyāsya sadāśiva ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: Of this <s>kavaca</s> of the female <s>guru</s>, <s>Sadāśiva</s> is declared as the <s>ṛṣi</s>,

children.text: tadākhyā devatā proktā caturvargaphalapradā // MBhT_7.26
children.translated_text: the deity is declared to be she who is named thus, and it grants the fruit of the four aims of life. // MBhT_7.26

children.text: klīṃ bījaṃ me śiraḥ pātu tad ākhyātaṃ lalāṭakam /
children.translated_text: May the <s>bīja</s> klīṃ protect my head, and the same protect my forehead,

children.text: klīṃ bījaṃ cakṣuṣoḥ pātu sarvāṅgaṃ me sadāvatu // MBhT_7.27
children.translated_text: may the <s>bīja</s> klīṃ protect my eyes, and may it always protect all my limbs. // MBhT_7.27

children.text: aiṃ bījaṃ me mukhaṃ pātu hrīṃ jaṅghāṃ parirakṣatu /
children.translated_text: May the <s>bīja</s> aiṃ protect my mouth, may hrīṃ protect my shanks,

children.text: śrīṃ bījaṃ skandhadeśaṃ me vāgbhavaṃ me bhujadvayam // MBhT_7.28
children.translated_text: may the <s>bīja</s> śrīṃ protect my shoulder region, and <s>vāgbhava</s> protect my two arms. // MBhT_7.28

children.text: hakāraṃ me dakṣabhujaṃ kṣakāraṃ vāmahastakam /
children.translated_text: May the syllable ha protect my right arm, and the syllable kṣa my left hand,

children.text: kṣamaṇau tadadhaḥ pātu lakāraṃ hṛdayaṃ mama // MBhT_7.29
children.translated_text: may kṣa-ma-ṇa protect below that, and the syllable la protect my heart. // MBhT_7.29

children.text: rakāraṃ pṛṣṭhadeśaṃ ca rakāraṃ dakṣapārśvakam /
children.translated_text: May the syllable ra protect my back, and the syllable ra my right side,

children.text: jūṅkāraṃ vāmapārśve tu sakāraṃ merum eva tu // MBhT_7.30
children.translated_text: may the syllable jūṅ protect my left side, and the syllable sa the spine itself. // MBhT_7.30

children.text: makāraṃ cāṅgulīḥ pātu lakāraṃ me nakhopari /
children.translated_text: May the syllable ma protect my fingers, and the syllable la the tops of my nails,

children.text: vakāraṃ me nitambaṃ ca rakāraṃ jānuyugmakam // MBhT_7.31
children.translated_text: may the syllable va protect my buttocks, and the syllable ra my pair of knees. // MBhT_7.31

children.text: yīḥkāraṃ pādayugalaṃ hasauḥ sarvāṅgam eva tu /
children.translated_text: May the syllable yīḥ protect my pair of feet, and hasauḥ all my limbs indeed,

children.text: hasaur liṅgaṃ ca lomaṃ ca keśaṃ ca parirakṣatu // MBhT_7.32
children.translated_text: may hasauḥ protect the private parts, the body hair, and the head hair. // MBhT_7.32

children.text: aiṃ bījaṃ pātu pūrve tu hrīṃ bījaṃ dakṣiṇe 'vatu /
children.translated_text: May the <s>bīja</s> aiṃ protect in the east, may the <s>bīja</s> hrīṃ protect in the south,

children.text: śrīṃ bījaṃ paścime pātu uttare bhūtasambhavam // MBhT_7.33
children.translated_text: may the <s>bīja</s> śrīṃ protect in the west, and in the north the <s>bhūtabīja</s> (hauṃ). // MBhT_7.33

children.text: śrīṃ pātu cāgnikoṇe ca tadākhyāṃ nairṛte 'vatu /
children.translated_text: May śrīṃ protect in the southeast, and she who is named thus protect in the southwest,

children.text: devy ambā pātu vāyavyāṃ śambhoḥ śrīpādukāṃ tathā // MBhT_7.34
children.translated_text: may the <s>Devī</s> Mother protect in the northwest, and the sacred sandals of <s>Śambhu</s> likewise. // MBhT_7.34

children.text: pūjayāmi tathā cordhvaṃ namaś cādhaḥ sadāvatu /
children.translated_text: "I worship" — may that protect above, and "namaḥ" always protect below.

children.text: iti te kathitaṃ kānte kavacaṃ paramādbhutam // MBhT_7.35
children.translated_text: Thus has been told to you, O beloved, the <s>kavaca</s>, supremely wondrous. // MBhT_7.35

children.text: gurumantraṃ japitvā tu kavacaṃ prapaṭhed yadi /
children.translated_text: If, having recited the <s>guru</s> <s>mantra</s>, one recites the <s>kavaca</s>,

children.text: sa siddhaḥ sagaṇaḥ so 'pi śivaḥ sākṣān na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_7.36
children.translated_text: he becomes a <s>siddha</s> (perfected one), and he with his retinue becomes <s>Śiva</s> himself — there is no doubt. // MBhT_7.36

children.text: pūjākāle paṭhed yas tu kavacaṃ mantravigraham /
children.translated_text: Whoever recites the <s>kavaca</s>, the embodiment of <s>mantra</s>, at the time of worship,

children.text: pūjāphalaṃ bhavet tasya satyaṃ satyaṃ sureśvari // MBhT_7.37
children.translated_text: The fruit of <s>pūjā</s> (worship) shall be his, truly, truly, O <s>Sureśvarī</s> (Queen of the Gods).

body.text: trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhed devi sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_7.38
body.translated_text: One who recites this at the three <s>saṃdhyās</s> (twilight junctions), O <s>Devī</s>, becomes a <s>siddha</s> (perfected one) — there is no doubt in this.

children.text: bhūrje vilikhya guṭikāṃ svarṇasthā dhārayed yadi /
children.translated_text: Having written it on birch bark and formed it into an amulet, if one wears it set in gold,

children.text: tasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhāṃ gatāḥ // MBhT_7.39
children.translated_text: by the mere sight of him, debaters are rendered powerless.

children.text: vivāde jayam āpnoti raṇe ca nirṛtir iva /
children.translated_text: In disputes he attains victory, and in battle he is like <s>Nirṛti</s> (the goddess of destruction) herself;

children.text: sabhāyāṃ jayam āpnoti mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_7.40
children.translated_text: in assemblies he attains victory, becoming equal to Me — there is no doubt.

children.text: sahasrāre bhāvayaṃ stāṃ trisandhyaṃ prapaṭhed yadi /
children.translated_text: If one meditates upon her in the <s>sahasrāra</s> (thousand-petaled lotus) and recites this at the three <s>saṃdhyās</s> (twilight junctions),

children.text: sa eva siddho lokeśo nirvāṇapadam īhate // MBhT_7.41
children.translated_text: he himself becomes a <s>siddha</s> (perfected one), a lord of the worlds, and attains the state of <s>nirvāṇa</s> (liberation).

children.text: samastamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam /
children.translated_text: This <s>kavaca</s> (protective armor) named 'Samastamaṅgala' (All-Auspicious) is supremely wondrous;

children.text: yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācana // MBhT_7.42
children.translated_text: it should not be given to just anyone, nor should it ever be revealed.

children.text: deyaṃ śiṣyāya śāntāya cānyathā patanaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: It should be given only to a disciple who is peaceful; otherwise, downfall shall occur.

children.text: abhaktebhyo 'pi deveśi putrebhyo 'pi na darśayet // MBhT_7.43
children.translated_text: Even to the faithless, O <s>Deveśī</s> (Goddess of Gods), and even to one's own sons, it should not be shown.

children.text: idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā daśavidyāṃ ca yo japet /
children.translated_text: Without knowing this <s>kavaca</s> (protective armor), whoever recites the <s>Daśavidyā</s> (Ten Great Wisdoms),

children.text: sa nāpnoti phalaṃ tasya pare ca narakaṃ vrajet // MBhT_7.44
children.translated_text: he does not obtain its fruit, and in the hereafter he goes to hell.

children.text: samāptaṃ kavacaṃ devi kim anyac chrotum icchasi /
children.translated_text: The <s>kavaca</s> (protective armor) is now complete, O <s>Devī</s>; what else do you wish to hear?

children.text: tava snehānubandhena kiṃ mayā na prakāśitam // MBhT_7.45
children.translated_text: Out of affectionate attachment to you, what has not been revealed by Me?

children.text: kūrcabījaṃ samuccārya prāṇamantraṃ tataḥ priye /
children.translated_text: Having uttered the <s>kūrca-bīja</s> (seed syllable 'hūṃ'), then the <s>prāṇa-mantra</s> (life-breath mantra), O beloved,

children.text: anena vāyuyogena kuṇḍalīcakraṃ saṃcaret // MBhT_7.46
children.translated_text: by this <s>vāyu-yoga</s> (breath-union practice), one should set the <s>kuṇḍalī-cakra</s> (coiled energy wheel) into motion.

children.text: aṣṭottaraśataṃ mūlamantraṃ japtvā namet sudhīḥ /
children.translated_text: Having recited the <s>mūla-mantra</s> (root mantra) one hundred and eight times, the wise one should bow;

children.text: snānakarma tataḥ kṛtvā saṃdhyāṃ kuryāt puroditām // MBhT_7.47
children.translated_text: then, having performed the bathing rites, one should perform the <s>saṃdhyā</s> (twilight worship) as previously described.

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> said:

children.text: saṃdhyāyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ dhyānaṃ vada me parameśvara /
children.translated_text: What is the nature of the meditation for the <s>saṃdhyā</s> (twilight worship)? Tell me, O <s>Parameśvara</s> (Supreme Lord).

children.text: śrīvidyāviṣaye nātha viśeṣo mayi kathyatām // MBhT_7.48
children.translated_text: Regarding the domain of <s>Śrīvidyā</s> (the Auspicious Knowledge), O Lord, tell me what is distinctive.

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śiva</s> said:

children.text: dhyāyec ca sundarīṃ devīṃ trividhāṃ bījarūpiṇīm /
children.translated_text: One should meditate upon the beautiful <s>Devī</s> (Goddess), threefold in form, embodying the <s>bījas</s> (seed syllables):

children.text: prabhāte vāgbhavāṃ devī madhyāhne madanātmikām // MBhT_7.49
children.translated_text: at dawn, the <s>Devī</s> as <s>Vāgbhavā</s> (embodiment of speech); at midday, as the essence of <s>Madana</s> (desire);

children.text: sāyāhne śaktirūpāṃ ca trividhāṃ bindurūpiṇīm /
children.translated_text: at evening, in the form of <s>Śakti</s> (power) — threefold, embodying the <s>bindu</s> (point of concentrated energy);

children.text: pūjākāle mahādevīṃ dhyānānurūpiṇīṃ śivām // MBhT_7.50
children.translated_text: at the time of <s>pūjā</s> (worship), one should meditate upon the <s>Mahādevī</s> (Great Goddess), auspicious, in the form corresponding to the meditation.

children.text: vāgbhavenendusadṛśāṃ śuklavarṇāṃ vicintayet /
children.translated_text: Through <s>Vāgbhava</s> (the speech-seed), one should visualize her as resembling the moon, of white complexion;

children.text: śaktibījaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ raktavarṇāṃ vibhāvayet // MBhT_7.51
children.translated_text: the <s>Śakti-bīja</s> (power seed syllable) is golden-colored — one should visualize her as red-complexioned.

children.text: prabhāte śuklavarṇābhāṃ madhyāhne nīlasaṃnibhām /
children.translated_text: At dawn, she is of white radiance; at midday, of dark blue appearance;

children.text: sāyāhne raktavarṇābhāṃ bhāvayet sādhakottamaḥ // MBhT_7.52
children.translated_text: at evening, of red radiance — thus should the best of <s>sādhakas</s> (practitioners) meditate.

children.text: evaṃ dhyātvā maheśāni saṃdhyāṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having meditated thus, O <s>Maheśānī</s> (Consort of the Great Lord), the discerning one should perform the <s>saṃdhyā</s> (twilight worship);

children.text: śivapūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjayet paradevatām // MBhT_7.53
children.translated_text: then, having performed the worship of <s>Śiva</s>, one should worship the Supreme Deity.

children.text: tatas tu pūjayed devīṃ tripurāṃ mokṣadāyinīm /
children.translated_text: Thereafter one should worship <s>Devī Tripurā</s>, the bestower of <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation).

children.text: tripurā paramā vidyā mahāvidyā pativratā // MBhT_7.54
children.translated_text: <s>Tripurā</s> is the supreme <s>vidyā</s> (knowledge), the great <s>vidyā</s>, the devoted wife.

children.text: patipūjāṃ vinā pūjāṃ na gṛhṇāti kadācana /
children.translated_text: Without the worship of her husband, she never accepts worship;

children.text: ata eva maheśāni ādau liṅgaṃ prapūjayet // MBhT_7.55
children.translated_text: therefore, O <s>Maheśānī</s> (Consort of the Great Lord), one should first worship the <s>liṅga</s> (sacred emblem of Śiva).

children.text: pañcākṣaraṃ pañcavaktraṃ pūjayed bahuyatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: One should worship with great effort the <s>Pañcākṣara</s> (five-syllabled mantra) and the <s>Pañcavaktra</s> (five-faced form of Śiva);

children.text: tatas tu pūjayed devīṃ tripurāṃ mokṣadāyinīm // MBhT_7.56
children.translated_text: thereafter one should worship <s>Devī Tripurā</s>, the bestower of <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation).

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> said:

children.text: kimādhāre yajec chambhuṃ kṛpayā vada śaṃkara /
children.translated_text: Upon what support should one worship <s>Śambhu</s>? Tell me with compassion, O <s>Śaṃkara</s>.

children.text: ādhārabhede deveśa sādhakaḥ phalabhāg bhavet // MBhT_7.57
children.translated_text: According to the differences in support, O <s>Deveśa</s> (Lord of the Gods), the practitioner obtains different fruits.

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṃkara</s> said:

children.text: pūjayet pārthive liṅge pāṣāṇe liṅgake tathā /
children.translated_text: One should worship an earthen <s>liṅga</s>, or a stone <s>liṅga</s>,

children.text: svarṇaliṅge 'thavā devi raupye tāmre ca kāṃsyake // MBhT_7.58
children.translated_text: or a golden <s>liṅga</s>, O <s>Devī</s>, or one of silver, copper, or bell-metal;

children.text: pārade vātha gaṅgāyāṃ sphāṭike mārakate 'pi vā /
children.translated_text: or one of <s>pārada</s> (mercury), or from the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, or of crystal, or of emerald;

children.text: kāryabhede lauhaliṅge bhasmanirmāṇaliṅgake // MBhT_7.59
children.translated_text: according to the purpose, an iron <s>liṅga</s>, or a <s>liṅga</s> made of <s>bhasma</s> (sacred ash);

children.text: vālukānirmite liṅge gomaye vātha pūjayet /
children.translated_text: or a <s>liṅga</s> fashioned from sand, or one of cow-dung — one may worship.

children.text: pārthive pūjanaṃ devi toḍalākhye mayoditam // MBhT_7.60
children.translated_text: Regarding the worship of earthen <s>liṅgas</s>, O <s>Devī</s>, I have spoken of it in the <s>Toḍala</s> (text).

children.text: saṃskāreṇa vinā devi pāṣāṇādau na pūjayet /
children.translated_text: Without consecration, O <s>Devī</s>, one should not worship a stone <s>liṅga</s> and so forth;

children.text: saṃskāraṃ ca pravakṣyāmi viśeṣa iha yad bhavet // MBhT_7.61
children.translated_text: I shall now describe the consecration and what is distinctive here.

children.text: raupyaṃ ca svarṇaliṅgaṃ ca svarṇapātre nidhāya ca /
children.translated_text: A silver or golden <s>liṅga</s> should be placed in a golden vessel,

children.text: tasmād uttolya taṃ liṅgaṃ dugdhamadhye dinatrayam // MBhT_7.62
children.translated_text: then, lifting that <s>liṅga</s> out, it should be immersed in milk for three days.

children.text: tryambakeṇa sthāpayitvā kālarudraṃ prapūjayet /
children.translated_text: Having installed it with the <s>Tryambaka</s> (three-eyed Śiva) mantra, one should worship <s>Kālarudra</s> (the fierce time-form of Rudra)

children.text: ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa vedyān tu pārvatīṃ yajet // MBhT_7.63
children.translated_text: with the sixteen <s>upacāras</s> (ritual offerings), and upon the altar one should worship <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: tasmād uttolya taṃ liṅgaṃ gaṅgātoye dinatrayam /
children.translated_text: Then, lifting that <s>liṅga</s> out, it should be immersed in <s>Gaṅgā</s> water for three days;

children.text: tato vedoktavidhinā saṃskāram ācaret sudhīḥ // MBhT_7.64
children.translated_text: thereafter, the wise one should perform the consecration according to the Vedic procedure.

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Caṇḍikā</s> said:

children.text: liṅgapramāṇaṃ deveśa kathayasva mayi prabho /
children.translated_text: O <s>Deveśa</s> (Lord of the Gods), tell me the measurements of the <s>liṅga</s>, O Lord,

children.text: pārthive ca śilādau ca viśeṣo yadi vā bhavet // MBhT_7.65
children.translated_text: and whether there is any distinction between earthen and stone ones.

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śiva</s> said:

children.text: mṛttikātolakaṃ grāhyam athavā tolakadvayam /
children.translated_text: One should take one <s>tolaka</s> (a unit of weight) of clay, or else two <s>tolakas</s>;

children.text: etadanyaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācid api pārvati // MBhT_7.66
children.translated_text: no other amount should ever be used, O <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: śilādau parameśāni sthūlaṃ ca phaladāyakam /
children.translated_text: For stone and other materials, O <s>Parameśānī</s> (Supreme Goddess), a larger one is fruit-bestowing —

children.text: aṅguṣṭhamānaṃ deveśi yad vā hemādrimānakam // MBhT_7.67
children.translated_text: the measure of a thumb, O <s>Deveśī</s>, or the measure of a golden mountain.

children.text: evaṃ krameṇa deveśi phalaṃ bahuvidhaṃ labhet /
children.translated_text: In this manner, O <s>Deveśī</s>, one obtains fruits of many kinds;

children.text: sthūlāt sthūlataraṃ liṅgaṃ rudrākṣaṃ parameśvari // MBhT_7.68
children.translated_text: a <s>liṅga</s> progressively larger and larger, O <s>Parameśvarī</s> (Supreme Goddess), along with <s>rudrākṣa</s> (beads sacred to Rudra) —

body.text: pūjanād dhāraṇād devi phalaṃ bahuvidhaṃ smṛtam // MBhT_7.69
body.translated_text: from worship and from wearing them, O <s>Devī</s>, fruits of many kinds are declared.

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Eighth Chapter.

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> said:

children.text: śṛṇu nātha parānanda parāparakulātmaka /
children.translated_text: Listen, O Lord, supreme bliss, essence of the <s>Parā</s> and <s>Aparā</s> lineages —

children.text: tvāṃ vinā trāṇakartā ca mama jñāne na vartate // MBhT_8.1
children.translated_text: apart from You, there is no protector; in my understanding, none else exists.

children.text: pūrṇaliṅgaṃ maheśāna śivabījaṃ na cānyathā /
children.translated_text: The complete <s>liṅga</s>, O <s>Maheśāna</s> (Great Lord), is the seed of <s>Śiva</s> and nothing else;

children.text: śilāmadhye tathā cakraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ param // MBhT_8.2
children.translated_text: within stone likewise is the <s>cakra</s> (disc), the supreme <s>Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: pāradasya śatāṃśaikaṃ mama jñāne na vartate /
children.translated_text: Even a hundredth part of <s>pārada</s> (mercury) — this is beyond my understanding.

children.text: śivabījaṃ mahādeva śivarūpaṃ na cānyathā /
children.translated_text: The seed of <s>Śiva</s>, O <s>Mahādeva</s> (Great God), is the very form of <s>Śiva</s> and nothing else;

children.text: liṅgarūpaṃ kathaṃ deva tad vadasva mayi prabho // MBhT_8.3
children.translated_text: how does it take the form of a <s>liṅga</s>, O God? Tell me this, O Lord.

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śiva</s> said:

children.text: yathā jyotirmayaṃ liṅgaṃ kailāsaśikhare mama /
children.translated_text: Just as the luminous <s>liṅga</s> stands upon the peak of <s>Kailāsa</s>, My abode,

children.text: tasyaiva ṣoḍaśāṃśaikaḥ kāśyāṃ viśveśvaraḥ sthitaḥ // MBhT_8.4
children.translated_text: a sixteenth part of that very <s>liṅga</s> is <s>Viśveśvara</s> (Lord of All), established in <s>Kāśī</s> (Varanasi).

children.text: pūrṇaliṅgaṃ maheśāni śivabījaṃ na cānyathā /
children.translated_text: The complete <s>liṅga</s>, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, is the seed of <s>Śiva</s> and nothing else;

children.text: śilāmadhye tathā cakraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ param // MBhT_8.5
children.translated_text: within stone likewise is the <s>cakra</s> (disc), the supreme <s>Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: pāradasya śatāṃśaikaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ na hi /
children.translated_text: A hundredth part of <s>pārada</s> (mercury) is not merely <s>Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa</s> —

children.text: pakāraṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ ca ākāraṃ kālikā tathā // MBhT_8.6
children.translated_text: the syllable 'pa' is the form of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the syllable 'ā' is <s>Kālikā</s>,

children.text: rephaṃ śivaṃ dakāraṃ ca brahmarūpaṃ na cānyathā /
children.translated_text: the syllable 'ra' is <s>Śiva</s>, and the syllable 'da' is the form of <s>Brahmā</s> — nothing else.

children.text: pāradaṃ parameśāni brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam // MBhT_8.7
children.translated_text: <s>Pārada</s> (mercury), O <s>Parameśānī</s> (Supreme Goddess), is the essence of <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: yo yajet pāradaṃ liṅgaṃ sa eva śambhur avyayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Whoever worships a <s>pārada-liṅga</s> (mercury liṅga), he is verily the imperishable <s>Śambhu</s> himself;

children.text: sa eva dhanyo deveśi sa jñānī sa tu tattvavit // MBhT_8.8
children.translated_text: he alone is blessed, O <s>Deveśī</s>, he is the knower, he is the one who knows the truth.

children.text: sa brahmavettā sa dhanī sa rājā bhuvi pūjitaḥ /
children.translated_text: He is the knower of <s>Brahman</s>, he is wealthy, he is a king, worshipped upon the earth;

children.text: aṇimādivibhūtīnām īśvaraḥ sādhakottamaḥ // MBhT_8.9
children.translated_text: he is the lord of the supernatural powers beginning with <s>aṇimā</s> (the power of becoming infinitely small) — the best of <s>sādhakas</s> (practitioners).

children.text: striyaḥ svabhāvacapalā gopituṃ na hi śakyate /
children.translated_text: Women are fickle by nature and cannot keep secrets;

children.text: ata eva hi deveśi viratā bhava pārvati // MBhT_8.10
children.translated_text: therefore, O <s>Deveśī</s>, desist, O <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> said:

children.text: kathayasva kṛpānātha karuṇā yadi vartate /
children.translated_text: Tell me, O compassionate Lord, if mercy abides in You;

children.text: tava vākyaṃ vinā deva kva muktiḥ kva ca sādhutā // MBhT_8.11
children.translated_text: without Your word, O God, where is liberation and where is virtue?

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śiva</s> said:

children.text: pāradaṃ śivabījaṃ hi tāḍanaṃ na hi kārayet /
children.translated_text: <s>Pārada</s> (mercury) is the seed of <s>Śiva</s>; one must not cause it to be struck.

children.text: tāḍanād vittanāśaḥ syāt tāḍanāt sutahīnatā /
children.translated_text: From striking comes loss of wealth; from striking comes childlessness;

children.text: tāḍanād rogayuktaḥ syāt tāḍanān maraṇaṃ bhavet // MBhT_8.12
children.translated_text: from striking comes affliction with disease; from striking comes death.

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Devī</s> said:

children.text: etad vighnādikaṃ nātha satyam eva na saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: These obstacles and such, O Lord, are indeed true, without doubt;

children.text: vighnādirahitaṃ nātha kathayasva dayānidhe // MBhT_8.13
children.translated_text: tell me, O Lord, O treasure of compassion, the method free from obstacles.

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śiva</s> said:

children.text: pārade śivanirmāṇe nānāvighnaṃ yataḥ śive /
children.translated_text: In the preparation of <s>Śiva</s> from <s>pārada</s> (mercury), since there are various obstacles, O <s>Śivā</s> (auspicious one),

children.text: ata eva hi tatrādau śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret // MBhT_8.14
children.translated_text: therefore, at the very beginning, one should perform a <s>śānti-svastyayana</s> (pacification and auspicious ceremony).

children.text: dvādaśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgam upacāraiś ca ṣoḍaśaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Twelve earthen <s>liṅgas</s> should be worshipped with the sixteen <s>upacāras</s> (ritual offerings);

children.text: paṭṭādisūtranirmāṇaṃ racitaṃ śuklam eva vā // MBhT_8.15
children.translated_text: a garment woven of silk and thread, either fashioned or plain white —

children.text: puruṣasya yathāyogyaṃ yugmavastraṃ nivedayet /
children.translated_text: a pair of garments appropriate for the person should be offered;

children.text: bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ sureśvari // MBhT_8.16
children.translated_text: items suitable for enjoyment should be given, along with <s>madhuparka</s> (a honey mixture offering), O <s>Sureśvarī</s>.

children.text: alaṃkāraṃ yathāśakti dadyāt kalyāṇahetave /
children.translated_text: Ornaments should be given according to one's ability, for the sake of auspiciousness;

children.text: pūjayed bahuyatnena bilvapattreṇa pārvati // MBhT_8.17
children.translated_text: one should worship with great effort using <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple) leaves, O <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: toḍaloktena vidhinā pratyekenāyutaṃ japet /
children.translated_text: According to the procedure stated in the <s>Toḍala</s> (text), one should recite ten thousand times for each;

children.text: ādau pañcākṣaraṃ mantram aṣṭottaraśataṃ japet // MBhT_8.18
children.translated_text: first, one should recite the <s>Pañcākṣara</s> (five-syllabled) mantra one hundred and eight times.

children.text: pūjānte prajapet paścāt prāsādākhyaṃ mahāmanum /
children.translated_text: At the end of the <s>pūjā</s> (worship), one should then recite the great mantra called <s>Prāsāda</s>;

children.text: dakṣiṇāntaṃ samācarya haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ // MBhT_8.19
children.translated_text: concluding with <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual gift), one should eat only <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificial food) and be master of one's senses.

children.text: tāmbūlaṃ ca tathā matsyaṃ varjayen na kadācana /
children.translated_text: <s>Tāmbūla</s> (betel) and fish should never be avoided;

children.text: asmiṃs tantre haviṣyānnaṃ tāmbūlaṃ mīnam uttamam // MBhT_8.20
children.translated_text: in this <s>tantra</s>, <s>haviṣyānna</s> (sacrificial food), <s>tāmbūla</s> (betel), and fish are considered excellent.

children.text: homayet parameśāni daśāṃśaṃ vā śatāṃśam /
children.translated_text: One should perform <s>homa</s> (fire oblation), O <s>Parameśānī</s>, of a tenth or a hundredth portion;

children.text: homasya dakṣiṇā kāryā tadā vighnair na lipyate // MBhT_8.21
children.translated_text: the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual gift) for the <s>homa</s> must be given — then one is not touched by obstacles.

children.text: tataḥ parasmin divase pāradam ānayed budhaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, on the following day, the wise one should bring <s>pārada</s> (mercury);

children.text: tasyopari japen mantraṃ sarvavandyanavātmakam // MBhT_8.22
children.translated_text: over it, one should recite the mantra whose essence is all-venerable and ninefold.

children.text: vyomabījaṃ śivāntaṃ ca vargādyaṃ bindumastakam /
children.translated_text: The <s>vyoma-bīja</s> (space seed syllable) ending with <s>Śiva</s>, beginning with the first of the letter-groups, crowned with <s>bindu</s> (nasal dot),

children.text: vāyubījaṃ ca tritayaṃ tritayaṃ tryambakaṃ priye // MBhT_8.23
children.translated_text: the <s>vāyu-bīja</s> (wind seed syllable) — three times each, thrice, the <s>Tryambaka</s> (three-eyed Śiva mantra), O beloved.

children.text: imaṃ mantraṃ maheśāni prajaped auṣadhopari /
children.translated_text: This mantra, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one should recite over the medicinal substances;

children.text: pārade prajapen mantram aṣṭottaraśataṃ yadi // MBhT_8.24
children.translated_text: if one recites the mantra over <s>pārada</s> (mercury) one hundred and eight times,

body.text: tad evauṣadhayogena baddho bhavati nānyathā // MBhT_8.25
body.translated_text: then by that very combination with medicinal substances, it becomes bound — not otherwise.

children.text: tataḥ parasmin divase śṛṇu matprāṇavallabhe /
children.translated_text: Then, on the following day, listen, O beloved of my life —

children.text: varayet karmakartāraṃ yathoktavibhavāvadhi // MBhT_8.26
children.translated_text: one should select the craftsman according to the prescribed means and resources.

children.text: suvarṇaṃ campakākāraṃ karṇayugme nivedayet /
children.translated_text: Gold ornaments in the shape of <s>campaka</s> (flowers) should be offered for the pair of ears;

children.text: catuṣkoṇayutaṃ svarṇaṃ grīvāyāṃ sumanoharam // MBhT_8.27
children.translated_text: a four-cornered gold ornament, beautiful, should be given for the neck.

children.text: hastadvaye maheśāni dadyād valayayugmakam /
children.translated_text: On both hands, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one should give a pair of bracelets;

children.text: valayaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ ca aṅgarīyaṃ tathaiva ca // MBhT_8.28
children.translated_text: bracelets of white color, and finger-rings as well.

children.text: ūrmiṃ dadyāt pītavastraṃ kṣaumavastrayugaṃ śive /
children.translated_text: One should give a wave-patterned ornament, a yellow garment, and a pair of silk garments, O <s>Śivā</s> (auspicious one).

children.text: evaṃ kṛtvā maheśāni śivarūpaṃ vicintayet // MBhT_8.29
children.translated_text: Having done thus, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one should meditate upon the form of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi vidhānaṃ śṛṇu pārvati /
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe the procedure — listen, O <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: prastare caiva saṃsthāpya jhiṇṭīpattrarasena ca /
children.translated_text: Having placed it upon a stone slab, with the juice of <s>jhiṇṭī</s> (a medicinal plant),

children.text: prastareṇa samāloḍya kuryāt kardamavat priye // MBhT_8.30
children.translated_text: mixing it upon the slab, one should make it into a paste, O beloved.

children.text: nirmāṇayogyaṃ tatraiva yadi syāt surasundari /
children.translated_text: If it becomes suitable for fashioning right there, O <s>Surasundarī</s> (Beauty among the Gods),

children.text: tadā nirmāya taṃ liṅgaṃ punar dṛḍhataraṃ caret // MBhT_8.31
children.translated_text: then, having fashioned that <s>liṅga</s>, one should proceed to make it even firmer.

children.text: svapuṣpasaṃyute vastre aṅgāre ca karīṣake /
children.translated_text: In a cloth infused with its own flower-substances, over embers of cow-dung cakes,

children.text: kiṃcid uṣṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ yato dṛḍhataro bhavet // MBhT_8.32
children.translated_text: it should be made slightly warm, so that it becomes firmer.

children.text: tato nirmāya taṃ liṅgaṃ punar dṛḍhataraṃ caret /
children.translated_text: Then, having fashioned that <s>liṅga</s>, one should again proceed to make it firmer;

children.text: svapuṣpasaṃyute vastre sthāpayet pārthive punaḥ // MBhT_8.33
children.translated_text: in a cloth infused with its own flower-substances, one should place it upon an earthen base again.

children.text: kiṃcid uṣṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ yāvad dṛḍhataro bhavet /
children.translated_text: It should be made slightly warm until it becomes firm;

children.text: vinā hy auṣadhayogena bhasma bhavati nānyathā // MBhT_8.34
children.translated_text: without the combination with medicinal substances, it turns to ash — there is no other way.

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, navamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Ninth Chapter.

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śiva</s> said:

children.text: bhasmaprakāraṃ deveśi śṛṇu matprāṇavallabhe /
children.translated_text: Listen to the method of preparing <s>bhasma</s> (sacred ash/calcined substance), O <s>Deveśī</s>, O beloved of my life.

children.text: kartāraṃ varayed ādau yathoktavibhavāvadhi // MBhT_9.1
children.translated_text: First, one should select the craftsman according to the prescribed means and resources.

children.text: suvarṇaṃ mauktikayutaṃ karṇayugme nivedayet /
children.translated_text: Gold ornaments set with pearls should be offered for the pair of ears;

children.text: hastayugme ca valayam aṅgurīyaṃ tathaiva ca // MBhT_9.2
children.translated_text: bracelets for both hands, and finger-rings as well.

children.text: toḍhadvayaṃ bāhuyugme śuddhakāñcananirmitam /
children.translated_text: Two armlets for both upper arms, made of pure gold;

children.text: grīvāyāṃ dāpayet svarṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ manoramam // MBhT_9.3
children.translated_text: for the neck, one should give a four-cornered gold ornament, beautiful.

children.text: vastrayugmaṃ paṭṭasūtranirmitaṃ ca suśobhanam /
children.translated_text: A pair of garments woven of silk thread, resplendent,

children.text: uṣṇīṣaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ ca uṣṇīṣaṃ pītavāsasam // MBhT_9.4
children.translated_text: a turban of white color, and a turban of yellow cloth.

children.text: evaṃ hi varayed devi karmayogyaṃ vicintayet /
children.translated_text: Having thus selected, O <s>Devī</s>, one should consider him fit for the task;

children.text: cintayec chivarūpaṃ ca cintayet triguṇātmakam // MBhT_9.5
children.translated_text: one should meditate upon the form of <s>Śiva</s>, and contemplate the threefold nature.

children.text: tataḥ parasmin divase śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: Then, on the following day, one should perform the <s>śānti-svastyayana</s> (pacification and auspicious ceremony);

children.text: nirmitaṃ śuddhasvarṇena bilvapattreṇa sundari // MBhT_9.6
children.translated_text: fashioned of pure gold, with <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple) leaves, O beautiful one,

children.text: sahasrasaṅkhyayā devi pārthivaṃ dvādaśaṃ yajet /
children.translated_text: one should worship twelve earthen <s>liṅgas</s> in the number of one thousand, O <s>Devī</s>,

children.text: ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa paṭṭavastrayugena ca // MBhT_9.7
children.translated_text: with the sixteen <s>upacāras</s> (ritual offerings) and a pair of silk garments,

children.text: alaṃkāravicitraiś ca pūjayet parameśvaram /
children.translated_text: and with various ornaments, one should worship <s>Parameśvara</s> (the Supreme Lord).

children.text: bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ nivedayet // MBhT_9.8
children.translated_text: Items suitable for enjoyment should be given; <s>madhuparka</s> (honey mixture offering) should be offered.

children.text: svarṇāsanena saṃsthāpya pratyekaṃ pūjanaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: Having installed it upon a golden seat, one should perform worship for each individually;

children.text: pūjānte prajapen mantram aṣṭottaraśataṃ sudhīḥ // MBhT_9.9
children.translated_text: at the end of the <s>pūjā</s> (worship), the wise one should recite the mantra one hundred and eight times.

children.text: ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ prāsādākhyaṃ manuṃ tataḥ /
children.translated_text: The six-syllabled great mantra, then the mantra called <s>Prāsāda</s>;

children.text: diksahasraṃ japen mantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunet priye // MBhT_9.10
children.translated_text: one should recite the mantra ten thousand times, and perform <s>homa</s> (fire oblation) of a tenth of that, O beloved.

children.text: homasya dravyaṃ deveśi śṛṇu matprāṇavallabhe /
children.translated_text: The materials for the <s>homa</s> (fire oblation), O <s>Deveśī</s>, listen, O beloved of my life:

children.text: vālukānirmite vāpi kuṇḍe vā parameśvari // MBhT_9.11
children.translated_text: in a fire-pit made of sand or in a proper <s>kuṇḍa</s> (fire-pit), O <s>Parameśvarī</s> (Supreme Goddess),

children.text: dvātriṃśadaṅgulimānaṃ vistṛtaṃ tatsamaṃ priye /
children.translated_text: measuring thirty-two finger-widths in breadth, equally proportioned, O beloved,

children.text: ṣoḍaśāṅgulimānaṃ hi kuṇḍaṃ kuryāt sulakṣaṇam // MBhT_9.12
children.translated_text: or a <s>kuṇḍa</s> (fire-pit) measuring sixteen finger-widths, one should construct it with auspicious features.

children.text: tadūrdhve parameśāni vedanetrāṅguliṃ śive /
children.translated_text: Above that, O <s>Parameśānī</s>, four and three finger-widths (of the Veda-and-eye number), O <s>Śivā</s>;

children.text: eva hi svarṇakumbhaṃ ca tāmrakumbhāsamarthinā // MBhT_9.13
children.translated_text: thus a golden pot — or for one unable to afford that, a copper pot —

children.text: etad anyataraṃ kumbhaṃ sthāpayed vedikopari /
children.translated_text: one of these pots should be placed upon the altar,

children.text: paṭṭavastreṇa yugmena saṃveṣṭya bahuyatnataḥ // MBhT_9.14
children.translated_text: wrapped with a pair of silk garments with great care.

children.text: homayed bilvapattreṇa yathoktena sureśvari /
children.translated_text: One should perform <s>homa</s> (fire oblation) with <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple) leaves as prescribed, O <s>Sureśvarī</s>,

children.text: trimadhvaktena vidhinā tataḥ siddho bhaved dhruvam // MBhT_9.15
children.translated_text: with the procedure involving the three sweet substances — then success is assured.

children.text: tatas tu dakṣiṇā kāryā yathoktavibhavāvadhi /
children.translated_text: Then <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual gift) should be given according to the prescribed means and resources;

children.text: sarvadravyamayaṃ mūlyaṃ dviguṇaṃ vā pradāpayet // MBhT_9.16
children.translated_text: the value of all the materials, or double that, should be given.

children.text: dakṣiṇāvihīnā yajñāḥ siddhidā na ca mokṣadāḥ /
children.translated_text: Sacrifices without <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual gift) bestow neither <s>siddhi</s> (supernatural accomplishment) nor <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation);

children.text: ata eva maheśāni dakṣiṇā vibhavāvadhi // MBhT_9.17
children.translated_text: therefore, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> should be according to one's means.

children.text: varāhavat samānīya janmamātre 'pi sundari /
children.translated_text: Having obtained it just as one obtains a boar, even at the moment of its birth, O beautiful one,

children.text: pāradaṃ tolakaṃ mānaṃ bhakṣayed bahuyatnataḥ // MBhT_9.18
children.translated_text: one should consume <s>pārada</s> (mercury) in the measure of one <s>tolaka</s> (unit of weight) with great effort;

children.text: punas tolakamānaṃ hi mātṛdugdhaṃ tataḥ param /
children.translated_text: then again, in the measure of one <s>tolaka</s>, mother's milk thereafter,

children.text: punaś ca bhakṣayed dhīmāṃs tato dugdhaṃ tu bhakṣayet // MBhT_9.19
children.translated_text: The wise one should again consume it, and then consume milk. // MBhT_9.19

children.text: tataś ca vatsam ānīya navadvāraṃ prayatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, bringing a calf, with great effort through the nine openings,

children.text: sūtrayogeṇa deveśi baddhaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ // MBhT_9.20
children.translated_text: O Mistress of the Gods, one should bind it carefully by means of a thread-device. // MBhT_9.20

children.text: tataś ca helakīmantram aṣṭottaraśataṃ japet /
children.translated_text: Then one should recite the <s>Helakī</s> mantra one hundred and eight times.

children.text: gajapramāṇaṃ deveśi dīrghaprasthaṃ tu khātakam // MBhT_9.21
children.translated_text: O Mistress of the Gods, a pit the size of an elephant, long and broad, should be dug. // MBhT_9.21

children.text: karīṣakeṇa deveśi pūrṇaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: O Mistress of the Gods, the discerning one should fill it with cow dung.

children.text: tanmadhye sthāpayed vatsaṃ saṃdahed bahuyatnataḥ // MBhT_9.22
children.translated_text: In its middle one should place the calf and burn it with great effort. // MBhT_9.22

children.text: vahnisthite maheśāni na spṛśet kuṇḍam uttamam /
children.translated_text: O Great Goddess, while the fire is blazing, one should not touch the excellent pit.

children.text: kuṇḍe suśītale jāta utthāpya bahuyatnataḥ // MBhT_9.23
children.translated_text: When the pit has become fully cool, one should raise it out with great effort. // MBhT_9.23

children.text: sarvaprakāśakaṃ mantram aṣṭottaraśataṃ japet /
children.translated_text: One should recite the <s>Sarvaprakāśaka</s> (all-illuminating) mantra one hundred and eight times.

children.text: viśveśvaraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati sādaram // MBhT_9.24
children.translated_text: I shall declare the <s>Viśveśvara</s> (Lord of All) procedure — listen, O <s>Pārvatī</s>, with respect. // MBhT_9.24

children.text: pāradaṃ tolakaṃ mānaṃ tāmrapātre tu lepayet /
children.translated_text: One should smear mercury, one <s>tolaka</s> (a unit of weight) in measure, upon a copper vessel.

children.text: cūrṇaṃ kuryān maheśāni gandhakaṃ sārdhaṃ tolakam // MBhT_9.25
children.translated_text: O Great Goddess, one should powder sulphur, one and a half <s>tolakas</s> in measure. // MBhT_9.25

children.text: samācchādya prayatnena cūrṇena parameśvari /
children.translated_text: Covering it carefully with the powder, O Supreme Goddess,

children.text: saṃdahed bahuyatnena mandamandena vahninā // MBhT_9.26
children.translated_text: one should heat it with great care over a gentle, slow fire. // MBhT_9.26

children.text: kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ reṇuyutaṃ dṛṣṭvā utthāpya sundari /
children.translated_text: Seeing it become black-colored and mixed with powder, O Beautiful One, one should remove it.

children.text: rattipramāṇaṃ tad dravyaṃ bhakṣayed yadi sundari // MBhT_9.27
children.translated_text: If one consumes that substance in the measure of one <s>ratti</s> (a small unit of weight), O Beautiful One, // MBhT_9.27

children.text: satyaṃ satyaṃ sarvakuṣṭhaṃ bhakṣaṇān nāśam āpnuyāt /
children.translated_text: truly, truly, all leprosy is destroyed by consuming it.

children.text: anupānam uṣṇatoyaṃ matsyādīn parivarjayet // MBhT_9.28
children.translated_text: The accompanying drink should be warm water; one should avoid fish and similar foods. // MBhT_9.28

children.text: evaṃ prayogaṃ deveśi na kuryāt putravān gṛhī /
children.translated_text: O Mistress of the Gods, a householder who has sons should not perform this procedure,

children.text: prathame divase putrān dvitīye divase dhanam // MBhT_9.29
children.translated_text: for on the first day sons are lost, on the second day wealth is lost, // MBhT_9.29

children.text: tṛtīye divase śaktiṃ caturthe divase gṛham /
children.translated_text: on the third day strength is lost, on the fourth day the home is lost,

children.text: pañcame divase rogaṃ nāśaṃ tu jāyate dhruvam // MBhT_9.30
children.translated_text: and on the fifth day disease is certainly destroyed. // MBhT_9.30

children.text: ata eva maheśāni ātmasvastyayanaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: Therefore, O Great Goddess, one should perform the rite for one's own well-being.

children.text: pūrvoktavidhinā mantrī caturguṇaṃ samācaret // MBhT_9.31
children.translated_text: The <s>mantrī</s> (practitioner) should perform it four times following the previously stated procedure. // MBhT_9.31

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Chapter Ten

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious Goddess said:

children.text: narākṛtiṃ guruṃ nātha mantraṃ varṇātmakaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: O Lord, the <s>guru</s> has a human form, the <s>mantra</s> consists of syllables,

children.text: dhyānānurūpiṇaṃ devam ekatvaṃ vā kathaṃ vada // MBhT_10.1
children.translated_text: and the deity conforms to meditation — how can their unity be? Please explain. // MBhT_10.1

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: guruvaktrān mahāmantro labhyate sādhakottamaiḥ /
children.translated_text: The great <s>mantra</s> is obtained from the mouth of the <s>guru</s> by the best of practitioners.

children.text: yady eko jāyate vīryas tasya mūrtir bhaved dhruvam // MBhT_10.2
children.translated_text: When its power becomes manifest, its form is certainly established. // MBhT_10.2

children.text: devatāyāḥ śarīraṃ ca bījād utpadyate priye /
children.translated_text: The body of the deity arises from the <s>bīja</s> (seed syllable), O Beloved.

children.text: guror ājñānusāreṇa cānyamūrtis tu jāyate // MBhT_10.3
children.translated_text: By following the <s>guru's</s> command, another form also manifests. // MBhT_10.3

children.text: gurvādibhāvanād devi bhāvasiddhiḥ prajāyate /
children.translated_text: O Goddess, through contemplation of the <s>guru</s> and the rest, perfection of realization arises.

children.text: ata eva maheśāni caikatvaṃ parikathyate // MBhT_10.4
children.translated_text: Therefore, O Great Goddess, their unity is proclaimed. // MBhT_10.4

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious Goddess said:

children.text: yac cākṣuṣaṃ mahādeva tadākaraṃ vicintayet /
children.translated_text: O <s>Mahādeva</s>, that which is visible — one may contemplate its form.

children.text: acākṣuṣe mahādeva dhyānaṃ vā kīdṛśaṃ bhavet // MBhT_10.5
children.translated_text: But for that which is invisible, O <s>Mahādeva</s>, what kind of meditation would there be? // MBhT_10.5

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: śabdabrahmamayaṃ devi mama vaktrād vinirgatam /
children.translated_text: O Goddess, it is of the nature of <s>Śabdabrahman</s> (the Absolute as Sound), having issued forth from my mouth.

children.text: ākārarahite devi yathā dhyānādikaṃ bhavet // MBhT_10.6
children.translated_text: O Goddess, for that which is devoid of form, meditation and the rest arise as follows: // MBhT_10.6

children.text: tathaivoccāraṇenaiva bhaktiyuktena cetasā /
children.translated_text: Through utterance itself, with a mind endowed with devotion,

children.text: satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśāni pratyakṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_10.7
children.translated_text: truly, truly, O Great Goddess, it becomes directly perceptible — there is no doubt in this. // MBhT_10.7

children.text: śrīdevy uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious Goddess said:

children.text: paśupradāne vākyaṃ tu kīdṛśaṃ vada śaṃkara /
children.translated_text: What words should be spoken when offering an animal? Tell me, O <s>Śaṅkara</s> —

children.text: yena vākyena deveśa devī tuṣṭā bhavaty api // MBhT_10.8
children.translated_text: by which words, O Lord of the Gods, the Goddess becomes pleased. // MBhT_10.8

children.text: śrīśiva uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: mṛge mahiṣe coṣṭre ca paśuśabdaṃ na yojayet /
children.translated_text: For a deer, a buffalo, or a camel, one should not use the word <s>paśu</s> (sacrificial animal).

children.text: chāgale ca tathā siṃhe vyāghre ca parameśvari // MBhT_10.9
children.translated_text: But for a goat, and likewise for a lion or tiger, O Supreme Goddess, // MBhT_10.9

children.text: paśuśabdaṃ yojayitvā mahādevyai nivedayet /
children.translated_text: having applied the word <s>paśu</s>, one should offer it to the Great Goddess.

children.text: paśubhāvasthito mantrī mahiṣo dīyate yadi // MBhT_10.10
children.translated_text: If a <s>mantrī</s> (practitioner) who remains in the state of a <s>paśu</s> (bound soul) offers a buffalo, // MBhT_10.10

children.text: balidānaṃ prakartavyaṃ na māṃsaṃ bhakṣayen naraḥ /
children.translated_text: the offering of <s>bali</s> (sacrifice) should be performed, but one should not eat the flesh.

children.text: samyak phalaṃ na labhate daśāṃśaṃ labhate priye // MBhT_10.11
children.translated_text: One does not obtain the full fruit — only a tenth is obtained, O Beloved. // MBhT_10.11

children.text: mahiṣādi pradātavyaṃ divyavīramate sthitaḥ /
children.translated_text: A buffalo and the like should be offered by one established in the <s>divyavīra</s> (divine heroic) state.

children.text: sa eva siddhim āpnoti phalaṃ samyak priyaṃvade // MBhT_10.12
children.translated_text: He alone attains <s>siddhi</s> (perfection) and the full fruit, O Sweet-spoken One. // MBhT_10.12

children.text: paśudānaṃ vinā devi pūjayen na kadācana /
children.translated_text: O Goddess, without the offering of an animal, one should never worship.

children.text: tathā ca nityapūjāyāṃ yadi śakto bhaven naraḥ // MBhT_10.13
children.translated_text: Likewise in daily worship, if a person is capable, // MBhT_10.13

children.text: kevalaṃ balidānena siddho bhavati nānyathā /
children.translated_text: by the offering of <s>bali</s> alone does one become perfected, not otherwise.

children.text: nirdhanaḥ parameśāni yadi pūjādikaṃ caret // MBhT_10.14
children.translated_text: O Supreme Goddess, if a destitute person performs worship and the like, // MBhT_10.14

children.text: vatsarānte pradātavyaṃ balim ekaṃ sureśvari /
children.translated_text: he should offer at least one <s>bali</s> at the end of the year, O Queen of the Gods.

children.text: anyathā naiva siddhiḥ syād ājanma pūjanād api // MBhT_10.15
children.translated_text: Otherwise there is no <s>siddhi</s> (perfection), even from a lifetime of worship. // MBhT_10.15

children.text: balidānaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kalikāle ca caṇḍike /
children.translated_text: The offering of <s>bali</s> is the great sacrifice in the <s>Kali</s> age, O <s>Caṇḍikā</s>.

children.text: aśvamedhādikaṃ yajñaṃ kalau nāsti sureśvari // MBhT_10.16
children.translated_text: Sacrifices such as the <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice) do not exist in the <s>Kali</s> age, O Queen of the Gods. // MBhT_10.16

children.text: kevalaṃ balidānena cāśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: By the offering of <s>bali</s> alone, the fruit of the <s>Aśvamedha</s> is obtained.

children.text: yajñāvaśeṣaṃ yad dravyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ na cānyathā // MBhT_10.17
children.translated_text: The remainder of the sacrifice — that substance should be eaten, and not otherwise. // MBhT_10.17

children.text: yajñāvaśeṣabhogena sa yajñī nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: By consuming the remainder of the sacrifice, one is a true sacrificer — there is no doubt in this.

children.text: na bhakṣed yadi mohena na yajñaphalabhāg bhavet // MBhT_10.18
children.translated_text: If one does not eat it out of delusion, one does not share in the fruit of the sacrifice. // MBhT_10.18

children.text: tyājyaṃ dravyaṃ kathaṃ devi mahādevyai nivedayet /
children.translated_text: O Goddess, how should one offer to the Great Goddess that which is to be renounced?

children.text: brahmarūpaṃ mahātantraṃ mama vaktrād vinirgatam // MBhT_10.19
children.translated_text: This great <s>tantra</s>, of the nature of <s>Brahman</s>, has issued forth from my mouth. // MBhT_10.19

children.text: sa pūtaḥ sarvapāpebhyo yadi caikākṣaraṃ śrutam /
children.translated_text: One is purified of all sins if even a single syllable is heard.

children.text: mahābhaktiyuto bhūtvā śṛṇoti paṭalaṃ yadi // MBhT_10.20
children.translated_text: If one endowed with great devotion hears even one chapter, // MBhT_10.20

children.text: kiṃ tasya dhyānapūjāyāṃ tīrthasnānena tasya kim /
children.translated_text: what need has he of meditation and worship? What need of bathing at sacred places?

children.text: śabdabrahmamayaṃ jñātvā samastaṃ yadi caṇḍike // MBhT_10.21
children.translated_text: If one has known all of this as <s>Śabdabrahman</s> (the Absolute as Sound), O <s>Caṇḍikā</s>, // MBhT_10.21

children.text: kevalaṃ śravaṇenaiva sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: by mere hearing alone one is perfected — there is no doubt in this.

children.text: aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ śravaṇenaiva yat phalam // MBhT_10.22
children.translated_text: The fruit obtained by hearing all eighteen <s>Purāṇas</s>, // MBhT_10.22

children.text: caturvedena sāṅgena śravaṇenaiva yataḥ phalam /
children.translated_text: and the fruit obtained by hearing the four <s>Vedas</s> with their auxiliary sciences —

children.text: asya tantrasya deveśi kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm // MBhT_10.23
children.translated_text: O Mistress of the Gods, they do not equal even one-sixteenth of this <s>tantra</s>. // MBhT_10.23

body.text: brahmarūpam idaṃ tantraṃ sārāt sāraṃ parāt param // MBhT_10.24
body.translated_text: This <s>tantra</s> is of the nature of <s>Brahman</s>, the essence of essences, the supreme beyond the supreme. // MBhT_10.24

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Chapter Eleven

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious <s>Caṇḍikā</s> said:

children.text: prāsādaṃ maṇḍapaṃ vāpi yadi devyai nivedayet /
children.translated_text: If one should dedicate a temple or a pavilion to the Goddess,

children.text: vidhānaṃ tasya māhātmyaṃ vada me parameśvara // MBhT_11.1
children.translated_text: tell me the procedure and its greatness, O Supreme Lord. // MBhT_11.1

children.text: kūpādikaṃ mahādeva yadi devyai nivedayet /
children.translated_text: O <s>Mahādeva</s>, if one should dedicate a well or the like to the Goddess,

children.text: vidhānaṃ tasya māhātmyaṃ vada me parameśvara // MBhT_11.2
children.translated_text: tell me the procedure and its greatness, O Supreme Lord. // MBhT_11.2

children.text: śrīśaṅkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yena prāsādam utsṛjet /
children.translated_text: Listen, O Goddess, I shall declare by what means one should dedicate a temple.

children.text: tasyaiva paścime bhāge vedikāṃ caturasrakām // MBhT_11.3
children.translated_text: On its western side, a square altar // MBhT_11.3

children.text: prakuryād bahuyatnena vastreṇa veṣṭanaṃ careta /
children.translated_text: should be constructed with great care, and it should be wrapped with cloth.

children.text: tadabhāve maheśāni tṛṇenainaṃ ca veṣṭayet // MBhT_11.4
children.translated_text: In its absence, O Great Goddess, one should wrap it with grass. // MBhT_11.4

children.text: kumbhayugmaṃ sthāpayitvā kṣaumavastreṇa veṣṭayet /
children.translated_text: Having placed a pair of water pots, one should wrap them with silk cloth.

children.text: yugmaṃ yugmaṃ kṣaumavastraṃ kumbhayugme niyojayet // MBhT_11.5
children.translated_text: A pair of silk cloths should be applied to each pair of pots. // MBhT_11.5

children.text: īśakumbhe yajed devīm āgneyām agnidaivatam /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Īśa</s> (northeastern) pot one should worship the Goddess; in the southeastern direction, the fire deity.

children.text: catuḥṣaṣṭyupacāreṇa pūjayed iṣṭadevatām // MBhT_11.6
children.translated_text: One should worship the chosen deity with the sixty-four <s>upacāras</s> (offerings). // MBhT_11.6

children.text: abhāve pūjayed devīṃ tadardhena prayatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: In their absence, one should worship the Goddess with half that number, with care.

children.text: athavā parameśāni yathāśaktyupacārataḥ // MBhT_11.7
children.translated_text: Or else, O Supreme Goddess, with offerings according to one's capacity. // MBhT_11.7

children.text: pūjayed bahuyatnena tato homādikaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: One should worship with great effort, then perform the <s>homa</s> (fire ritual) and the rest.

children.text: āgamoktena vidhinā kuryāt tatra kuśaṇḍikām // MBhT_11.8
children.translated_text: According to the procedure stated in the <s>Āgama</s>, one should perform the <s>kuśaṇḍikā</s> (preliminary fire rite) there. // MBhT_11.8

children.text: trimadhvaktena deveśi bilvapatreṇa homayet /
children.translated_text: O Mistress of the Gods, one should offer oblations with <s>bilva</s> leaves anointed with the three sweets (honey, ghee, and sugar).

children.text: sahasraṃ homayen mantrī śatanyūnaṃ na kārayet // MBhT_11.9
children.translated_text: The <s>mantrī</s> (practitioner) should offer one thousand oblations; he should not make it less than a hundred. // MBhT_11.9

children.text: pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dattvā tato vākyaṃ samācaret /
children.translated_text: Then, having given the <s>pūrṇāhuti</s> (final complete oblation), one should recite the dedicatory words.

children.text: adyetyādi samuccāryaṃ sauramāsaṃ samuccaret // MBhT_11.10
children.translated_text: One should pronounce the words beginning with 'On this day,' and state the solar month. // MBhT_11.10

children.text: tithigotraṃ cāmuko 'haṃ dharmārthakāmam eva vā /
children.translated_text: The <s>tithi</s> (lunar day), <s>gotra</s> (lineage), 'I, so-and-so,' for the attainment of <s>dharma</s>, <s>artha</s>, and <s>kāma</s>,

children.text: prāptaye parameśāni tato mūlaṃ samuccaret // MBhT_11.11
children.translated_text: O Supreme Goddess — then one should pronounce the root <s>mantra</s>. // MBhT_11.11

children.text: devatāyai namaḥ paścād dakṣiṇāṃ dāpayed gurau /
children.translated_text: 'To the deity, <s>namaḥ</s>' — after this, one should give the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (honorarium) to the <s>guru</s>.

children.text: kumbhatoyena deveśi snāpayed yajamānakam // MBhT_11.12
children.translated_text: O Mistress of the Gods, one should bathe the patron of the sacrifice with water from the pot. // MBhT_11.12

children.text: surās tv ādīn samuccārya śāntiṃ kuryāt tato guruḥ /
children.translated_text: Having pronounced the invocations to the gods and the rest, the <s>guru</s> should then perform the benediction.

children.text: sarvādau gurudevasya varaṇaṃ kārayet sudhīḥ // MBhT_11.13
children.translated_text: Before everything else, the wise one should perform the selection of the <s>guru</s>. // MBhT_11.13

children.text: suvarṇaṃ campakākāraṃ karṇayugme nivedayet /
children.translated_text: Gold ornaments shaped like <s>campaka</s> flowers should be offered for the pair of ears.

children.text: catuṣkoṇayutaṃ svarṇaṃ grīvāyāṃ pariyojayet // MBhT_11.14
children.translated_text: A four-cornered gold ornament should be placed upon the neck. // MBhT_11.14

children.text: uṣṇīṣaṃ ca tato dadyāt kaṇṭhe mālāṃ niyojayet /
children.translated_text: Then a turban should be given, and a garland placed around the neck.

children.text: tāḍayugmaṃ tato bāhau valayaṃ maṇibandhake // MBhT_11.15
children.translated_text: A pair of <s>tāḍa</s> (armlets) on the arms, and bracelets on the wrists. // MBhT_11.15

children.text: aṅgulyām aṅgurī deyā divyavastraṃ niyojayet /
children.translated_text: A ring should be given for the finger, and divine garments should be bestowed.

children.text: evaṃ hi varaṇaṃ kṛtvā karmayogyaṃ vicintayet // MBhT_11.16
children.translated_text: Having thus performed the selection, one should consider the fitness for the ritual. // MBhT_11.16

children.text: guruṃ vā guruputraṃ vā varayed yatnataḥ sudhīḥ /
children.translated_text: The wise one should carefully select the <s>guru</s> or the <s>guru's</s> son.

children.text: sadasyaṃ na hi kartavyaṃ tantradhāraṃ na tatra vai // MBhT_11.17
children.translated_text: No assembly member should be appointed, nor a mere bearer of the <s>tantra</s> tradition. // MBhT_11.17

children.text: brahmāṇaṃ na hi kartavyaṃ kevalaṃ varayed gurum /
children.translated_text: A <s>brahmā</s> priest should not be appointed — one should select only the <s>guru</s>.

children.text: guror bhṛtyo maheśāni bhairavo nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_11.18
children.translated_text: O Great Goddess, the servant of the <s>guru</s> is <s>Bhairava</s> himself — there is no doubt in this. // MBhT_11.18

children.text: svīyena paridhānena vāsasā toṣayet svayam /
children.translated_text: One should please him with one's own garments and clothing.

children.text: svayaṃ hotā bhaved vipro guror ājñānusārataḥ // MBhT_11.19
children.translated_text: The <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> himself should serve as the <s>hotā</s> (chief priest), following the <s>guru's</s> command. // MBhT_11.19

children.text: māyābījaṃ samuccārya ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having uttered the <s>Māyā bīja</s> (the seed syllable of Māyā): 'To <s>Ādhāraśakti</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>' —

children.text: anena manunā devi vedisaṃskāram ācaret // MBhT_11.20
children.translated_text: O Goddess, by this <s>mantra</s> one should consecrate the altar. // MBhT_11.20

children.text: bhūrasītyādimantreṇa ghaṭayugmābhimantritam /
children.translated_text: With the mantra beginning with '<s>bhūr asi</s>' (You are the earth), the pair of pots should be consecrated.

children.text: astrāntenaiva mūlena uṣṇīṣaṃ pariyojayet // MBhT_11.21
children.translated_text: With the root <s>mantra</s> ending with the <s>astra</s> (weapon syllable), the turban should be fastened. // MBhT_11.21

children.text: vedoktaṃ caiva smṛtyuktaṃ mantraṃ na yojayet sudhīḥ /
children.translated_text: The wise one should not employ mantras prescribed by the <s>Vedas</s> or the <s>Smṛtis</s>.

children.text: evaṃ kūpādidāneṣu kartavyaṃ parameśvari // MBhT_11.22
children.translated_text: O Supreme Goddess, the same procedure should be followed for the dedication of wells and the like. // MBhT_11.22

children.text: anyat sarvaṃ samānaṃ hi prāsādādisthale punaḥ /
children.translated_text: Everything else is the same as in the case of temples and similar structures.

children.text: kūpādiyojanaṃ kuryāt yaṣṭiprotanam ācaret // MBhT_11.23
children.translated_text: For the dedication of wells and the like, the planting of a staff should be performed. // MBhT_11.23

children.text: caturhastapramāṇaṃ ca madhyabhāge tu protanam /
children.translated_text: The staff should be four cubits in measure, with the planting at its middle portion.

children.text: mūlamantraṃ samuccārya tato vahnivadhūṃ nyaset // MBhT_11.24
children.translated_text: Having uttered the root <s>mantra</s>, one should then place <s>Vahnivadhū</s> (the Fire's consort, i.e., <s>Svāhā</s>). // MBhT_11.24

children.text: tato yaṣṭiṃ samuccārya potayāmi vadet sudhīḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, uttering over the staff, the wise one should say 'I plant.'

children.text: tatra saṃtaraṇaṃ dhenuṃ naiva kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ // MBhT_11.25
children.translated_text: The discerning one should not perform the <s>saṃtaraṇa</s> (crossing) rite with a cow there. // MBhT_11.25

children.text: dhenusaṃtaraṇenaiva phalahāniḥ prajāyate /
children.translated_text: By performing the crossing rite with a cow, loss of merit occurs.

children.text: svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ pravālaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ pariyojayeta // MBhT_11.26
children.translated_text: Gold, silver, and coral should be given as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (honorarium). // MBhT_11.26

body.text: snāpayitvā kumbhatoyaiḥ śāntiṃ kuryāt tato guruḥ // MBhT_11.27
body.translated_text: Having bathed the patron with water from the pots, the <s>guru</s> should then perform the benediction. // MBhT_11.27

children.text: anenaiva vidhānena kūpādyutsargam ācaret /
children.translated_text: By this very procedure one should perform the dedication of wells and the like.

children.text: vāpīkūpataḍāgādi hy anenotsargam ācaret // MBhT_11.28
children.translated_text: Step-wells, wells, and tanks — by this method their dedication should be performed. // MBhT_11.28

children.text: dīrghikāṃ ca puṣkariṇīṃ hy anenaiva jalāśayam /
children.translated_text: Reservoirs, lotus ponds, and all water bodies —

children.text: utsṛjya parayā bhaktyā mahādevyai prayatnataḥ // MBhT_11.29
children.translated_text: having dedicated them with supreme devotion to the Great Goddess, with great care, // MBhT_11.29

children.text: puruṣaṃ saptamaṃ kānte pitṛvaṃśe ca mātari /
children.translated_text: seven generations on the paternal side, O Beloved, and on the maternal side,

children.text: saptamaṃ puruṣaṃ kānte mātṛvaṃśe samaṃ priye // MBhT_11.30
children.translated_text: seven generations equally, O Beloved, on the maternal lineage as well, // MBhT_11.30

children.text: kailāse nivasen nityaṃ devyā varaprasādataḥ /
children.translated_text: shall dwell eternally in <s>Kailāsa</s>, by the gracious boon of the Goddess.

children.text: svayaṃ devasvarūpaś ca jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_11.31
children.translated_text: One becomes of the very nature of God, liberated while living — there is no doubt. // MBhT_11.31

children.text: aśvamedhasahasreṇa vājapeyaśatena ca /
children.translated_text: The fruit obtained from a thousand <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse) sacrifices and a hundred <s>Vājapeya</s> sacrifices —

children.text: yat phalaṃ labhate devi tasmāl lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet // MBhT_11.32
children.translated_text: O Goddess, the merit from this is a hundred thousand times greater than that. // MBhT_11.32

children.text: merutulyaṃ suvarṇaṃ tu brāhmaṇe vedapārage /
children.translated_text: If one gives gold equal in weight to Mount <s>Meru</s> to a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> learned in the <s>Vedas</s>,

children.text: dattvā yat phalam āpnoti tasmāl lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet // MBhT_11.33
children.translated_text: the fruit obtained from this is a hundred thousand times greater than that. // MBhT_11.33

children.text: pūrṇaśasyena deveśi saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām /
children.translated_text: O Mistress of the Gods, if one gives the earth of seven continents, full of grain,

children.text: pradadyād bahuyatnena brāhmaṇe vedapārage // MBhT_11.34
children.translated_text: with great effort to a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> learned in the <s>Vedas</s>, // MBhT_11.34

body.text: tasmāl lakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyam anena parameśvari // MBhT_11.35
body.translated_text: the merit from this is a hundred thousand times greater than that, O Supreme Goddess. // MBhT_11.35

children.text: sadakṣiṇaṃ vrataṃ sarvaṃ dānaṃ yad vedasaṃmatam /
children.translated_text: All <s>vratas</s> (vows) with their <s>dakṣiṇās</s> (honoraria), and all gifts sanctioned by the <s>Vedas</s> —

children.text: tasmāl lakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyam anena parameśvari // MBhT_11.36
children.translated_text: the merit from this is a hundred thousand times greater than those, O Supreme Goddess. // MBhT_11.36

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious <s>Caṇḍikā</s> said:

children.text: yajñasūtradhāraṇena bhūpūjyo nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: By wearing the sacred thread, one becomes worthy of worship on earth — there is no doubt.

children.text: idānīṃ yajñasūtrasya vidhānaṃ mayi kathyatām // MBhT_11.37
children.translated_text: Now tell me the rules regarding the sacred thread. // MBhT_11.37

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: yajñasūtrasya yan mānaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva varānane /
children.translated_text: Hear the measurement of the sacred thread, O Beautiful-faced One.

children.text: ṛgvedī dhārayet sūtraṃ nābher ūrdhvaṃ stanād adhaḥ // MBhT_11.38
children.translated_text: A follower of the <s>Ṛgveda</s> should wear the thread from above the navel to below the chest. // MBhT_11.38

children.text: yajuṣāṃ sūtramānaṃ hi āścaryaṃ śailaje param /
children.translated_text: The measurement of the thread for followers of the <s>Yajurveda</s> is indeed wondrous, O Daughter of the Mountain.

children.text: bāhumūlapramāṇena yajñasūtraṃ dvijātibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: The sacred thread, measured from the root of the arm,

children.text: dhāraṇīyaṃ prayatnena nānyad dairghyaṃ kadācana // MBhT_11.39
children.translated_text: should be worn carefully by the twice-born — never any other length. // MBhT_11.39

children.text: sāmagasya yajñasūtraṃ trividhaṃ varavarṇini /
children.translated_text: The sacred thread for a follower of the <s>Sāmaveda</s> is of three kinds, O Lady of Beautiful Complexion.

children.text: brahmarandhrān nābhideśaparyantaṃ yajñasūtrakam // MBhT_11.40
children.translated_text: The sacred thread extends from the <s>Brahmarandhra</s> (crown aperture) to the region of the navel. // MBhT_11.40
