children.text: athavāpi ca grīvāyām āropya nābhiṃ saṃspṛśet /
children.translated_text: Or alternatively, placing it upon the neck, it should touch the navel.

children.text: tasmāt pṛṣṭhān merudaṇḍaparyantaṃ yajñasūtrakam // MBhT_11.41
children.translated_text: From there, along the back to the <s>Merudaṇḍa</s> (spinal column) — that is the measure of the sacred thread. // MBhT_11.41

children.text: athavā parameśāni prakārāntarakaṃ śṛṇu /
children.translated_text: Or, O Supreme Goddess, hear another method:

children.text: grīvāyā dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaparyantaṃ yajñasūtrakam // MBhT_11.42
children.translated_text: the sacred thread extends from the neck to the right thumb. // MBhT_11.42

children.text: athavā dhārayet sūtraṃ yatnena yajuṣāṃ matam /
children.translated_text: Or one may wear the thread carefully according to the <s>Yajurveda</s> measurement,

children.text: athavā dhārayet sūtraṃ sāmagasya pramāṇataḥ // MBhT_11.43
children.translated_text: or one may wear the thread according to the <s>Sāmaveda</s> measurement. // MBhT_11.43

children.text: atharvī dhārayed yajñasūtraṃ paramamohanam /
children.translated_text: A follower of the <s>Atharvaveda</s> should wear the supremely enchanting sacred thread.

children.text: ājñācakrān nābhideśaparyantaṃ yajñasūtrakam // MBhT_11.44
children.translated_text: The sacred thread extends from the <s>Ājñā cakra</s> (command center, between the eyebrows) to the region of the navel. // MBhT_11.44

children.text: etat saṃketam ajñātvā yaḥ kuryāt sūtradhāraṇam /
children.translated_text: One who performs the wearing of the thread without knowing this convention,

children.text: sa caṇḍālasamo devi yadi vyāsasamo bhavet // MBhT_11.45
children.translated_text: O Goddess, is equal to a <s>Caṇḍāla</s> (outcaste), even if he be equal to <s>Vyāsa</s>. // MBhT_11.45

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Chapter Twelve

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: The Glorious <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi pūjādhāraṃ sudurlabham // MBhT_12.1
children.translated_text: Now I shall declare the supports of worship, which are very rare to obtain. // MBhT_12.1

body.text: śālagrāme maṇau yantre pratimāyāṃ ghaṭe jale // MBhT_12.2
body.translated_text: In a <s>Śālagrāma</s> stone, in a jewel, in a <s>yantra</s> (mystical diagram), in an image, in a pot, in water, // MBhT_12.2

children.text: pustikāyāṃ ca gaṅgāyāṃ śivaliṅge prasūnake /
children.translated_text: in a book, in the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, in a <s>Śivaliṅga</s>, or in a flower —

children.text: śālagrāme śataguṇaṃ maṇau tadvat phalaṃ labhet // MBhT_12.3
children.translated_text: in a <s>Śālagrāma</s> the merit is a hundredfold; in a jewel one obtains the same fruit. // MBhT_12.3

children.text: yantre lakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ mūrtau lakṣaṃ sulocane /
children.translated_text: In a <s>yantra</s> the merit is a hundred-thousandfold; in an image, a hundred thousand, O Beautiful-eyed One.

children.text: ghaṭe caikaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ jale caikaguṇaṃ priye // MBhT_12.4
children.translated_text: In a pot the merit is single; in water the merit is also single, O Beloved. // MBhT_12.4

children.text: pustikāyāṃ sahasraṃ tu gaṅgāyāṃ tatsamaṃ phalam /
children.translated_text: In a book, it is a thousandfold; in the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, the fruit is equal to that.

children.text: śivaliṅge hy anantaṃ hi vinā pārthivaliṅgake // MBhT_12.5
children.translated_text: In the <s>Śivaliṅga</s>, [the fruit is] infinite, except in the case of an earthen <s>liṅga</s>. // MBhT_12.5

children.text: puṣpayantre maheśāni pūjanāt sarvasiddhibhāk /
children.translated_text: By worshipping with a flower-<s>yantra</s>, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one obtains all <s>siddhis</s> (supernatural attainments).

children.text: śālagrāme ca pūjāyāṃ na likhed yantram uttamam // MBhT_12.6
children.translated_text: In the worship of a <s>Śālagrāma</s>, one should not draw the supreme <s>yantra</s>. // MBhT_12.6

children.text: maṇau sthite maheśāni na likhed yantram uttamam /
children.translated_text: When a jewel is installed, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one should not draw the supreme <s>yantra</s>.

children.text: pratimāyāṃ ca pūjāyāṃ na likhed yantram uttamam // MBhT_12.7
children.translated_text: In the worship of an image, one should not draw the supreme <s>yantra</s>. // MBhT_12.7

children.text: pratimāyāś ca purato ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: Before the image, one should carefully establish a pot (<s>ghaṭa</s>),

children.text: parivārān yajet tatra ghaṭe tu parameśvari // MBhT_12.8
children.translated_text: and there in the pot one should worship the attendant deities, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>. // MBhT_12.8

children.text: yantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevāṃś ca ghaṭe yantre prapūjayet /
children.translated_text: The presiding deities of the <s>yantra</s> should be worshipped in the pot or in the <s>yantra</s>.

children.text: samastadevatārūpaṃ ghaṭaṃ tu paricintayet /
children.translated_text: One should meditate upon the pot as the form of all deities;

children.text: suradrumasvarūpo 'yaṃ ghaṭo hi parameśvari // MBhT_12.9
children.translated_text: this pot is of the nature of the wish-fulfilling tree (<s>Suradrumasvarūpa</s>), O <s>Parameśvarī</s>. // MBhT_12.9

children.text: janmasthānaṃ mahāyantraṃ yadi kuryāt tu sādhakaḥ /
children.translated_text: If a <s>sādhaka</s> (practitioner) should make a great <s>yantra</s> at his birth-place,

children.text: tatra mūrtiṃ na kuryāt tu kadācid api mohataḥ // MBhT_12.10
children.translated_text: he should never, out of delusion, place an image there. // MBhT_12.10

children.text: yadi mūrtiṃ prakuryāt tu tatra yantraṃ na kārayet /
children.translated_text: If he should place an image, then he should not install a <s>yantra</s> there.

children.text: yadi kuryāt tu mohena yajed vāradvayaṃ priye // MBhT_12.11
children.translated_text: If out of delusion he does both, he should worship twice, O beloved. // MBhT_12.11

children.text: dviguṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tatra dviguṇaṃ balidānakam /
children.translated_text: The worship there should be doubled, the offering of <s>bali</s> (ritual offering) doubled,

children.text: dviguṇaṃ prajapen mantraṃ dviguṇaṃ homayet sudhīḥ // MBhT_12.12
children.translated_text: the <s>mantra</s> <s>japa</s> (recitation) doubled, and the wise one should perform double <s>homa</s> (fire oblation). // MBhT_12.12

children.text: anyathā viphalā pūjā viphalaṃ balidānakam /
children.translated_text: Otherwise the worship is fruitless, the offering of <s>bali</s> is fruitless,

children.text: sarvaṃ hi viphalaṃ yasmāt tasmād yantraṃ na kārayet // MBhT_12.13
children.translated_text: everything indeed becomes fruitless; therefore one should not install a <s>yantra</s> [alongside an image]. // MBhT_12.13

body.text: iti te kathitaṃ kānte pūjādhāraṃ sudurlabham // MBhT_12.14
body.translated_text: Thus I have told you, O beloved, the rare basis of worship. // MBhT_12.14

children.text: athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi śivaliṅgasya lakṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe the characteristics of the <s>Śivaliṅga</s>.

children.text: pārthive śivapūjāyāṃ sarvasiddhiyuto bhavet // MBhT_12.15
children.translated_text: By worshipping <s>Śiva</s> in an earthen [<s>liṅga</s>], one becomes endowed with all <s>siddhis</s>. // MBhT_12.15

children.text: pāṣāṇe śivapūjāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ phalam īritam /
children.translated_text: By worshipping <s>Śiva</s> in a stone [<s>liṅga</s>], the fruit is said to be twofold.

children.text: svarṇaliṅge ca pūjāyāṃ śatrūṇāṃ nāśanaṃ matam // MBhT_12.16
children.translated_text: By worshipping in a golden <s>liṅga</s>, the destruction of enemies is declared. // MBhT_12.16

children.text: sarvasiddhīśvaro raupye phalaṃ tasmāc caturguṇam /
children.translated_text: In a silver [<s>liṅga</s>], one becomes lord of all <s>siddhis</s>, and the fruit is fourfold.

children.text: tāmre puṣṭiṃ vijānīyāt kāṃsye ca dhanasaṃcayam // MBhT_12.17
children.translated_text: In a copper [<s>liṅga</s>], one should know there is nourishment; in a bronze one, accumulation of wealth. // MBhT_12.17

children.text: pāradasya ca māhātmyaṃ puraiva kathitaṃ mayā /
children.translated_text: The greatness of mercury (<s>pārada</s>) has been told by me previously.

children.text: gaṅgāyāṃ ca lakṣaguṇaṃ lākṣāyāṃ rogavān bhavet // MBhT_12.18
children.translated_text: In a [<s>liṅga</s> made from] <s>Gaṅgā</s> [clay], the merit is a hundred-thousand-fold; in one of lac, one becomes diseased. // MBhT_12.18

children.text: sphāṭike sarvasiddhiḥ syāt tathā mārakate priye /
children.translated_text: In crystal, all <s>siddhis</s> are obtained, and likewise in emerald, O beloved.

children.text: lauhaliṅge ripor nāśaṃ kāmadaṃ bhasmaliṅgake // MBhT_12.19
children.translated_text: In an iron <s>liṅga</s>, destruction of enemies; in an ash <s>liṅga</s>, it grants desires. // MBhT_12.19

children.text: vālukāyāṃ kāmyasiddhir gomaye ṛtuhiṃsanam /
children.translated_text: In sand, fulfillment of desires; in cow-dung, destruction of seasonal afflictions.

children.text: sarvaliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣadam // MBhT_12.20
children.translated_text: The greatness of all [types of] <s>liṅgas</s> bestows <s>dharma</s> (righteousness), <s>artha</s> (wealth), <s>kāma</s> (desire), and <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation). // MBhT_12.20

children.text: ādhārabhede yat puṇyaṃ cādhikaṃ kathitaṃ tu te /
children.translated_text: The merit arising from differences in the base has been told to you as additional,

children.text: atiriktaphalāny etaddhārasya sulocane // MBhT_12.21
children.translated_text: these are the extra fruits of [different] bases, O beautiful-eyed one. // MBhT_12.21

children.text: śivasya pūjanād devi caturvargādhipo bhavet /
children.translated_text: By worshipping <s>Śiva</s>, O <s>Devī</s>, one becomes master of the four aims of life (<s>caturvarga</s>).

children.text: aṣṭaiśvaryayuto martyaḥ śambhunāthasya pūjanāt // MBhT_12.22
children.translated_text: A mortal becomes endowed with the eight sovereignties (<s>aṣṭaiśvarya</s>) through worship of Lord <s>Śambhu</s>. // MBhT_12.22

children.text: svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prokto yadi śambhuṃ prapūjayet /
children.translated_text: <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> himself is said [to have attained his status] if he worships <s>Śambhu</s>.

children.text: svarge martye ca pātāle ye devāḥ saṃsthitāḥ sadā /
children.translated_text: In heaven, on earth, and in the netherworld, all the gods who ever abide,

children.text: teṣāṃ pūjā bhaved devi śambhunāthasya pūjanāt // MBhT_12.23
children.translated_text: their worship is accomplished, O <s>Devī</s>, through the worship of Lord <s>Śambhu</s>. // MBhT_12.23

children.text: svarṇapuṣpasahasreṇa yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥ /
children.translated_text: Whatever fruit a man obtains by [offering] a thousand golden flowers,

children.text: tasmāl lakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bhagnaikabilvapattrake // MBhT_12.24
children.translated_text: a hundred-thousand times greater is the merit of [offering] a single broken <s>bilva</s> leaf. // MBhT_12.24

children.text: bhagnaikabilvapattrasya sahasrakena bhāgataḥ /
children.translated_text: By [offering] a thousand broken <s>bilva</s> leaves in portions,

children.text: merutulyasuvarṇena tatphalaṃ na hi labhyate // MBhT_12.25
children.translated_text: even with gold equal to Mount <s>Meru</s>, that fruit cannot be obtained. // MBhT_12.25

children.text: śuddhāśuddhavicāro 'pi nāsti tac chivapūjane /
children.translated_text: There is no consideration of pure and impure in the worship of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: yena tena prakāreṇa bilvapattraiḥ prapūjanāt /
children.translated_text: By any means whatsoever, through worship with <s>bilva</s> leaves,

children.text: sarvasiddhiyuto bhūtvā sa naraḥ siddho hi // MBhT_12.26
children.translated_text: that man, having become endowed with all <s>siddhis</s>, is indeed perfected. // MBhT_12.26

children.text: brahmāṇḍamadhye ye devās tadbāhye yāś ca devatāḥ /
children.translated_text: All the gods within the <s>Brahmāṇḍa</s> (cosmic egg) and the deities beyond it,

children.text: te sarve tṛptim āyānti kevalaṃ śivapūjanāt // MBhT_12.27
children.translated_text: they all attain satisfaction solely through the worship of <s>Śiva</s>. // MBhT_12.27

children.text: puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ jalaṃ dravyaṃ liṅgopari niyojayet /
children.translated_text: One should place flowers, sandalwood paste, water, and offerings upon the <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: liṅgamadhye mahāvahniḥ saiva rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ // MBhT_12.28
children.translated_text: Within the <s>liṅga</s> is the great fire; that itself is proclaimed as <s>Rudra</s>. // MBhT_12.28

body.text: rudropari kṣiped yat tu tad eva bhasmatāṃ gataḥ // MBhT_12.29
body.translated_text: Whatever is cast upon <s>Rudra</s>, that indeed is reduced to ash. // MBhT_12.29

children.text: sākṣād dhomo maheśāni śivasya pūjanād bhavet /
children.translated_text: A direct <s>homa</s> (fire oblation), O <s>Maheśānī</s>, is accomplished through the worship of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: mahāyajñeśvaro martyaḥ śivasya pūjanād bhavet // MBhT_12.30
children.translated_text: A mortal becomes the lord of the great sacrifice (<s>mahāyajña</s>) through the worship of <s>Śiva</s>. // MBhT_12.30

children.text: kuśāgramānaṃ yat toyaṃ tat toyena yajed yadi /
children.translated_text: If one worships with water [even] the measure of a blade of <s>kuśa</s> grass,

children.text: satyaṃ satyaṃ hi girije taj jalaṃ sāgaropamam // MBhT_12.31
children.translated_text: truly, truly, O daughter of the mountain (<s>Girija</s>), that water becomes equal to an ocean. // MBhT_12.31

children.text: puṣpaṃ ca merusadṛśaṃ liṅgopari niyojanāt /
children.translated_text: A flower placed upon the <s>liṅga</s> becomes equal to Mount <s>Meru</s>.

children.text: liṅgasya mastake devi yad annaṃ paritiṣṭhati // MBhT_12.32
children.translated_text: O <s>Devī</s>, whatever food rests upon the head of the <s>liṅga</s>, // MBhT_12.32

body.text: tadannasya ca dānena kṣitidānaphalaṃ labhet // MBhT_12.33
body.translated_text: by donating that food, one obtains the fruit of donating land. // MBhT_12.33

children.text: ekena taṇḍulenaiva yadi liṅgaṃ prapūjayet /
children.translated_text: If one worships the <s>liṅga</s> with even a single grain of rice,

children.text: brahmāṇḍapātrasampūrṇam annadānaphalaṃ labhet // MBhT_12.34
children.translated_text: one obtains the fruit of donating food sufficient to fill the vessel of the <s>Brahmāṇḍa</s> (entire universe). // MBhT_12.34

children.text: ekayā dūrvayā vāpi yo 'rcayec chivaliṅgakam /
children.translated_text: One who worships the <s>Śivaliṅga</s> with even a single blade of <s>dūrvā</s> grass,

children.text: sarvadevasya śīrṣe tu cārdhadānaphalaṃ labhet // MBhT_12.35
children.translated_text: upon the heads of all the gods, obtains the fruit of half a donation. // MBhT_12.35

children.text: sāmānyatoyam ānīya yadi snāyān maheśvaram /
children.translated_text: If one bathes Lord <s>Maheśvara</s> by bringing ordinary water,

children.text: sārdhatrikoṭitīrthasya snānasya phalabhāg bhavet // MBhT_12.36
children.translated_text: one obtains the fruit of bathing at three and a half <s>koṭi</s> (thirty-five million) <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred sites). // MBhT_12.36

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: tāriṇī brahmaṇaḥ śaktis tripurā vaiṣṇavī parā /
children.translated_text: <s>Tāriṇī</s> is the <s>śakti</s> (power) of <s>Brahmā</s>; <s>Tripurā</s> is the supreme <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>.

children.text: kathaṃ śākambharī tārā tripurā śāmbhavī katham // MBhT_12.37
children.translated_text: How is <s>Śākambharī</s> [the same as] <s>Tārā</s>? How is <s>Tripurā</s> [the same as] <s>Śāmbhavī</s>? // MBhT_12.37

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: kālī dehād yadā jātā sāvitrī vedamātṛkā /
children.translated_text: When <s>Kālī</s> was born from the body, [she became] <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the mother of the <s>Vedas</s> (<s>Vedamātṛkā</s>).

children.text: trivargadātrī sā devī brahmaṇaḥ śaktir eva ca // MBhT_12.38
children.translated_text: That <s>Devī</s>, the giver of the three aims (<s>trivarga</s>), is indeed the <s>śakti</s> of <s>Brahmā</s>. // MBhT_12.38

children.text: guptarūpā mahāvidyā śaivī saikajaṭā parā /
children.translated_text: The great <s>Mahāvidyā</s> (supreme knowledge) of hidden form is <s>Śaivī</s>, the supreme <s>Ekajaṭā</s>.

children.text: tasmāl lakṣmīr vaiṣṇavī yā trivargadāyinī śivā // MBhT_12.39
children.translated_text: Therefore <s>Lakṣmī</s>, who is <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>, the auspicious giver of the three aims, // MBhT_12.39

children.text: guptarūpā mahāvidyā śrīmattripurasundarī /
children.translated_text: the <s>Mahāvidyā</s> of hidden form, is the glorious <s>Tripurasundarī</s>.

children.text: śāmbhavī paramā māyā tripurā mokṣadāyinī // MBhT_12.40
children.translated_text: <s>Śāmbhavī</s>, the supreme <s>Māyā</s>, is <s>Tripurā</s>, the bestower of liberation. // MBhT_12.40

children.text: ekaiva hi mahāvidyā nāmamātraṃ pṛthak pṛthak /
children.translated_text: There is indeed only one <s>Mahāvidyā</s>; the different [names] are merely names.

children.text: tathaiva puruṣaś caiko nāmamātravibhedakaḥ // MBhT_12.41
children.translated_text: Likewise, the <s>Puruṣa</s> (Supreme Person) is one; the distinctions are merely in name. // MBhT_12.41

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: mantradhāraṇamātreṇa tadātmā tanmayo bhavet /
children.translated_text: By merely holding a <s>mantra</s>, one becomes identified with it, absorbed in it.

children.text: kathaṃ vā vātulaḥ so 'pi kathaṃ vā rogavān bhavet // MBhT_12.42
children.translated_text: How then does one become mad (<s>vātula</s>)? And how does one become diseased? // MBhT_12.42

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: mantracchannād vātulatvaṃ rogo dehe na jāyate /
children.translated_text: Madness arises from <s>mantracchanna</s> (mantra corruption); disease in the body does not arise [from the mantra itself].

children.text: mantracchannaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāhitā // MBhT_12.43
children.translated_text: I shall describe <s>mantracchanna</s> (mantra corruption); listen attentively, O <s>Devī</s>. // MBhT_12.43

children.text: abhaktiś cākṣare bhrāntir luptiś channas tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: Lack of devotion, error in syllables, omission, concealment,

children.text: hrasvo dīrghaś ca kathanaṃ svapne tu cāṣṭadhā smṛtaḥ // MBhT_12.44
children.translated_text: shortening [of long vowels], lengthening [of short vowels], telling [to the unworthy], and [hearing it in] a dream — thus it is remembered as eightfold. // MBhT_12.44

children.text: abhaktyā naiva siddhiḥ syāt kalpakoṭiśatair api /
children.translated_text: Without devotion there is no <s>siddhi</s> even in hundreds of <s>koṭis</s> of <s>kalpas</s> (aeons).

children.text: evaṃ mantraś cānyathā vā ceti bhrāntyā ca vātulaḥ // MBhT_12.45
children.translated_text: Thus, [thinking] 'the <s>mantra</s> may be this way or that' — from such doubt, one becomes mad. // MBhT_12.45

children.text: luptavarṇe buddhināśaś chinne nāśo bhavet kila /
children.translated_text: From omitted syllables, destruction of intellect; from a broken [<s>mantra</s>], destruction indeed occurs.

children.text: hrasvoccāre vyādhiyukto dīrghajāpe vasukṣayaḥ // MBhT_12.46
children.translated_text: From short pronunciation, one becomes afflicted with disease; from prolonged <s>japa</s>, loss of resources. // MBhT_12.46

children.text: kathane mṛtyum āpnoti svapne 'pi śṛṇu śailaje /
children.translated_text: From telling [the <s>mantra</s> to the unworthy], one meets death. Hear also about [receiving it in] a dream, O daughter of the mountain (<s>Śailajā</s>):

children.text: kālikāyāś ca tārāyā mantro 'pi jvaladagnivat // MBhT_12.47
children.translated_text: the <s>mantra</s> of <s>Kālikā</s> and <s>Tārā</s> is like blazing fire. // MBhT_12.47

children.text: viprarūpeṇa devena premabhāvena cetasā /
children.translated_text: If a god in the form of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, with a mind full of love,

children.text: yadi mantraṃ hared devi śṛṇu sādhakalakṣaṇam // MBhT_12.48
children.translated_text: should steal away the <s>mantra</s>, O <s>Devī</s>, hear the characteristics of [what happens to] the <s>sādhaka</s>: // MBhT_12.48

children.text: sarvāṅge vai bhavej jvālā dehamadhye viśeṣataḥ /
children.translated_text: flames arise throughout the entire body, especially within the body.

children.text: toye śaityaṃ na jāyeta tathaivauṣadhasevane // MBhT_12.49
children.translated_text: Coolness does not arise from water, nor from the use of medicines. // MBhT_12.49

children.text: sadā vātulavat sarvaṃ pratyakṣe svapnavad bhavet /
children.translated_text: Always like a madman in all things, the manifest world appears as if a dream.

children.text: varṣamadhye trivarṣe vā mṛtyus tasya na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_12.50
children.translated_text: Within a year or three years, death comes to him — there is no doubt. // MBhT_12.50

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: mantracchannaṃ cāṣṭavidhaṃ tava vaktrāc chrutaṃ mayā /
children.translated_text: The eightfold <s>mantracchanna</s> (mantra corruption) has been heard by me from your mouth.

children.text: yadi daivād bhaved deva tasyopāyaṃ vadasva me // MBhT_12.51
children.translated_text: If by fate such [corruption] should occur, O Lord, tell me the remedy. // MBhT_12.51

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: bahujāpāt tathā homāt kāyakleśādivistarāt /
children.translated_text: Through abundant <s>japa</s>, <s>homa</s>, and extensive bodily austerities,

children.text: yadi bhaktir bhaved devi tasya siddhir adūrataḥ // MBhT_12.52
children.translated_text: if devotion arises, O <s>Devī</s>, <s>siddhi</s> is not far from that one. // MBhT_12.52

children.text: guruṇā tatsutenaiva sādhakena varānane /
children.translated_text: By the <s>guru</s>, by his son, or by a [qualified] <s>sādhaka</s>, O beautiful-faced one,

children.text: akṣare dūṣaṇaṃ hitvā punar mantraṃ prakāśayet // MBhT_12.53
children.translated_text: having removed the defect in the syllables, one should reveal the <s>mantra</s> again. // MBhT_12.53

children.text: guruṇā tatsutenaiva sādhakena samāhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: By the <s>guru</s>, by his son, or by a <s>sādhaka</s>, with focused mind,

children.text: luptavarṇaṃ samutthāpya punar mantraṃ prakāśayet // MBhT_12.54
children.translated_text: having restored the omitted syllables, one should reveal the <s>mantra</s> again. // MBhT_12.54

children.text: cakrabhedena ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tathaiva yonimudrayā /
children.translated_text: By means of the <s>cakra</s> division, the hexagonal [<s>yantra</s>], and likewise the <s>yonimudrā</s>,

children.text: ekoccāre japen mantraṃ lakṣam ekaṃ varānane /
children.translated_text: one should recite the <s>mantra</s> in a single breath, one <s>lakṣa</s> (hundred thousand times), O beautiful-faced one.

children.text: gurvādinā maheśāni chinnadoṣanikṛntanam // MBhT_12.55
children.translated_text: Through the <s>guru</s> and others, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, the defect of severance is cut away. // MBhT_12.55

children.text: guruṇā lakṣajāpena tan mantraṃ śrāvayet tridhā /
children.translated_text: Through a <s>lakṣa</s> of <s>japa</s> by the <s>guru</s>, that <s>mantra</s> should be recited [to the disciple] three times.

children.text: dūṣaṇaṃ hrasvadīrghasya śāntiś cātra na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_12.56
children.translated_text: The defect of shortening and lengthening is pacified — there is no doubt in this. // MBhT_12.56

children.text: guruṇā tatsutenaiva sādhakenaiva śailaje /
children.translated_text: By the <s>guru</s>, by his son, or by a <s>sādhaka</s> himself, O daughter of the mountain (<s>Śailajā</s>),

children.text: uktamārgeṇa deveśi japel lakṣacatuṣṭayam // MBhT_12.57
children.translated_text: by the method described, O Goddess of gods, one should recite four <s>lakṣas</s> (four hundred thousand times). // MBhT_12.57

body.text: taddaśāṃśaṃ hunet paścāt tarpaṇādi samācaret // MBhT_12.58
body.translated_text: One should then offer <s>homa</s> of one-tenth of that, and perform <s>tarpaṇa</s> (libation) and the rest. // MBhT_12.58

children.text: tato 'pi yadi naivābhūt sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ /
children.translated_text: If even after that [the corruption is] not [removed], the <s>sādhaka</s> should remain firm in mind.

children.text: caturguṇaṃ hi kartavyaṃ śiṣyasya muktihetave // MBhT_12.59
children.translated_text: It should be done fourfold, for the sake of the disciple's liberation. // MBhT_12.59

children.text: yadi mṛtyur bhavet tasya tathāpi muktibhāg bhavet /
children.translated_text: If death should come to him, even then he obtains liberation.

children.text: kathanasya doṣaśāntir bhavaty eva na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_12.60
children.translated_text: The pacification of the defect of telling [the <s>mantra</s>] certainly occurs — there is no doubt. // MBhT_12.60

children.text: svapne 'pi mantrakathane śmaśāne caiva śailaje /
children.translated_text: For [the corruption through] telling the <s>mantra</s> in a dream as well, [one should go to] the cremation ground, O daughter of the mountain.

children.text: uktamārgeṇa deveśi japel lakṣaṃ catuṣṭayam // MBhT_12.61
children.translated_text: By the method described, O Goddess of gods, one should recite four <s>lakṣas</s>. // MBhT_12.61

children.text: taddaśāṃśaṃ hunet paścāt tarpaṇādi samācaret /
children.translated_text: One should then offer <s>homa</s> of one-tenth of that, and perform <s>tarpaṇa</s> and the rest.

children.text: tato 'pi yadi naivābhūt sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ // MBhT_12.62
children.translated_text: If even after that [the corruption is] not [removed], the <s>sādhaka</s> should remain firm in mind. // MBhT_12.62

children.text: caturguṇaṃ hi kartavyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ pūjanaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: It should be done fourfold; one should perform the worship as previously described.

children.text: kuje vā śanivāre vā prathame gamanaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: On Tuesday or Saturday, one should make the first visit.

children.text: saptāhaṃ vā yajed devīṃ turīyaṃ vādinaṃ yajet // MBhT_12.63
children.translated_text: For seven days one should worship the <s>Devī</s>, or worship on the fourth [day]. // MBhT_12.63

children.text: śmaśānasādhanaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu caikāgracetasā /
children.translated_text: I shall describe the cremation ground <s>sādhana</s> (practice); listen with one-pointed mind.

children.text: svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ tathā vastraṃ dattvā varaṇam ācaret // MBhT_12.64
children.translated_text: Having given gold, silver, and cloth, one should perform the ritual invitation (<s>varaṇa</s>). // MBhT_12.64

children.text: svarṇapīṭhaṃ pradātavyaṃ caturaṅgulivistṛtam /
children.translated_text: A golden seat (<s>pīṭha</s>) should be given, four fingers in width.

children.text: bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ yathoditam // MBhT_12.65
children.translated_text: Enjoyable offerings should be given, along with <s>madhuparka</s> (honey mixture) as prescribed. // MBhT_12.65

children.text: rājapatnī yena tuṣṭā toṣayet tena vāsasā /
children.translated_text: With such garments as would please a queen, one should please [the deity].

children.text: alaṃkāraṃ yathāyogyaṃ tatra tatra niyojayet // MBhT_12.66
children.translated_text: Ornaments should be arranged appropriately in each place. // MBhT_12.66

children.text: naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ ramyaṃ nānādravyasamanvitam /
children.translated_text: Various delightful food offerings (<s>naivedya</s>) endowed with diverse substances,

children.text: sāmiṣānnaṃ guḍaṃ chāgaṃ surāpiṣṭakapāyasam // MBhT_12.67
children.translated_text: food with meat (<s>sāmiṣānna</s>), jaggery, goat, liquor, cakes, and <s>pāyasa</s> (milk-rice pudding). // MBhT_12.67

children.text: bhogyadravyaṃ jale dadyād yadi bhoktā na tiṣṭhati /
children.translated_text: If there is no one to consume [the offerings], one should place the enjoyable substances in water.

children.text: evaṃ pūjāṃ samāpyādau śivapūjāṃ samācaret // MBhT_12.68
children.translated_text: Having thus completed the worship, one should first perform the worship of <s>Śiva</s>. // MBhT_12.68

children.text: ṣoḍaśair upacāraiś ca liṅgānāṃ caikaviṃśatim /
children.translated_text: With the sixteen <s>upacāras</s> (ritual services) and twenty-one <s>liṅgas</s>,

children.text: aṣṭottaraśatenaiva bilvapattraiḥ sacandanaiḥ // MBhT_12.69
children.translated_text: with one hundred and eight <s>bilva</s> leaves smeared with sandalwood paste, // MBhT_12.69

children.text: pratyekaṃ pūjayen mantraṃ gajāntakasahasrakam /
children.translated_text: one should worship each [<s>liṅga</s>] with the <s>mantra</s> one thousand times with the <s>Gajānta</s> [<s>mantra</s>],

children.text: sahasraṃ homayet paścād bilvapattrair varānane // MBhT_12.70
children.translated_text: then offer one thousand <s>homa</s> oblations with <s>bilva</s> leaves, O beautiful-faced one. // MBhT_12.70

body.text: evaṃ kṛte labhec chāntiṃ dīrghāyur nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_12.71
body.translated_text: When done thus, one obtains peace and long life — there is no doubt in this. // MBhT_12.71

body.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu nātha parānanda parāparajagatpate /
children.translated_text: Listen, O Lord, [who art] supreme bliss, master of the transcendent and immanent worlds!

children.text: idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi mālāyāḥ kīdṛśo japaḥ /
children.translated_text: Now I wish to hear: what kind of <s>japa</s> [is done] with a <s>mālā</s> (rosary)?

children.text: kā mālā kasya devasya tad vadasva samāhitaḥ // MBhT_13.1
children.translated_text: Which <s>mālā</s> for which deity? Tell me this attentively. // MBhT_13.1

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: vaiṣṇave tulasīmālā gajadantair gaṇeśvare /
children.translated_text: For <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> [worship], a <s>tulasī</s> (holy basil) rosary; for <s>Gaṇeśvara</s> (<s>Gaṇeśa</s>), elephant ivory [beads].

children.text: kālikāyā mahāmantraṃ japed rudrākṣamālayā // MBhT_13.2
children.translated_text: The great <s>mantra</s> of <s>Kālikā</s> should be recited with a <s>rudrākṣa</s> rosary. // MBhT_13.2

children.text: tārāyāś ca japen mantrī mahāśaṅkhākhyamālayā /
children.translated_text: The <s>mantrī</s> (practitioner) should recite the <s>mantra</s> of <s>Tārā</s> with the rosary called <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> (great conch).

children.text: mahāśaṅkhākhyamālāyāṃ sarvāṃ vidyāṃ japet sudhīḥ // MBhT_13.3
children.translated_text: With the <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> rosary, the wise one should recite all <s>vidyās</s> (sacred knowledge-mantras). // MBhT_13.3

children.text: akasmād vai mahāsiddhir mahāśaṅkhākhyamālayā /
children.translated_text: Spontaneous great <s>siddhi</s> [comes] with the <s>Mahāśaṅkha</s> rosary.

children.text: tathaiva sakalā vidyā mahāśaṅkhe vaset sadā // MBhT_13.4
children.translated_text: Likewise, all <s>vidyās</s> always reside in the great conch [rosary]. // MBhT_13.4

children.text: sphāṭikī sarvadevasya pravālaiḥ sakalāṃ japet /
children.translated_text: A crystal [rosary] is for all deities; with coral, one should recite all [<s>mantras</s>].

children.text: svarṇaraupyasamudbhūtāṃ sarvadeveṣu yojitām // MBhT_13.5
children.translated_text: A [rosary] made of gold and silver is suitable for all deities. // MBhT_13.5

children.text: kālikāyāś ca sundaryā rudrākṣaiḥ prajapet sadā /
children.translated_text: For <s>Kālikā</s> and <s>Sundarī</s> (<s>Tripurasundarī</s>), one should always recite with <s>rudrākṣa</s> [beads].

children.text: bhairavyāḥ prajapen mantrī śaṅkhapadmākhyayā priye // MBhT_13.6
children.translated_text: For <s>Bhairavī</s>, the <s>mantrī</s> should recite with [a rosary] called <s>Śaṅkhapadma</s> (conch-lotus), O beloved. // MBhT_13.6

children.text: śmaśāne dhusturair mālā japed dhūmāvatīvidhau /
children.translated_text: In the cremation ground, a rosary of <s>dhustūra</s> (thorn-apple) [seeds] should be used for <s>Dhūmāvatī</s> worship.

children.text: iti te kathitaṃ kānte mahāmālāvinirṇayam // MBhT_13.7
children.translated_text: Thus I have told you, O beloved, the determination of the great rosaries. // MBhT_13.7

children.text: atha granthiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kānte samāhitā /
children.translated_text: Now I shall describe the knot (<s>granthi</s>); listen attentively, O beloved.

children.text: yena mālā susiddhā ca nṇāṃ sarvaphalapradā // MBhT_13.8
children.translated_text: By which the rosary becomes well-perfected and grants all fruits to people. // MBhT_13.8

children.text: mālāyāś cādhikā kānte granthiś caikā phalapradā /
children.translated_text: In addition to the rosary [beads], O beloved, a single knot is fruit-bestowing,

children.text: ekapañcāśikāyāṃ ca mālāyāṃ parameśvari // MBhT_13.9
children.translated_text: in a rosary of fifty-one [beads], O <s>Parameśvarī</s>. // MBhT_13.9

children.text: brahmagranthiyutāṃ mālāṃ sārdhadvitayaveṣṭitām /
children.translated_text: A rosary endowed with a <s>Brahmagranthi</s> (Brahmā-knot), wrapped two and a half times,

children.text: sapādaveṣṭanaṃ devi nāgapāśaṃ manoharam // MBhT_13.10
children.translated_text: with a quarter-wrapping, O <s>Devī</s>, [forms] the beautiful <s>Nāgapāśa</s> (serpent-noose). // MBhT_13.10

children.text: sarvadevasya mālāyāṃ sarvatra parameśvari /
children.translated_text: In the rosary of all deities, everywhere, O <s>Parameśvarī</s>,

children.text: brahmagranthiṃ vidhāyetthaṃ nāgapāśam athāpi vā // MBhT_13.11
children.translated_text: one should make the <s>Brahmagranthi</s> in this manner, or alternatively the <s>Nāgapāśa</s>. // MBhT_13.11

children.text: mālāyāṃ tv adhikāṃ devi caikāṃ granthiṃ pradāpayet /
children.translated_text: In the rosary, O <s>Devī</s>, one should add one additional knot.

children.text: mūlena grathitaṃ kuryāt praṇavenāthavā priye // MBhT_13.12
children.translated_text: One should tie it with the root <s>mantra</s> (<s>mūla</s>), or with <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), O beloved. // MBhT_13.12

children.text: granthimadhye ca guṭikāṃ kuryād atimanoharām /
children.translated_text: Within the knot, one should make a very beautiful bead (<s>guṭikā</s>).

children.text: sūtradvayaṃ maheśāni milanaṃ kārayet tataḥ // MBhT_13.13
children.translated_text: Two threads, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, should then be joined together. // MBhT_13.13

children.text: meruṃ ca grathanaṃ kuryāt tadūrdhve granthisaṃyutam /
children.translated_text: One should tie the <s>Meru</s> [bead], and above it [place] a knot.

children.text: evaṃ mālāṃ vinirmāya gopayed bahuyatnataḥ // MBhT_13.14
children.translated_text: Having thus constructed the rosary, one should guard it with great care. // MBhT_13.14

children.text: kampanaṃ dhūnanaṃ śabdaṃ naiva tatra prakāśayet /
children.translated_text: One should never allow shaking, swinging, or sound [from the rosary].

children.text: karabhraṣṭaṃ tathā chinnaṃ mahāvighnasya kāraṇam // MBhT_13.15
children.translated_text: Dropping it from the hand or breaking it causes great obstacles. // MBhT_13.15

children.text: kampane siddhihāniḥ syād dhūnanaṃ bahuduḥkhadam /
children.translated_text: From shaking, loss of <s>siddhi</s>; swinging causes much suffering.

children.text: śabde jāte bhaved rogaḥ karabhraṣṭād vināśakṛt // MBhT_13.16
children.translated_text: When sound occurs, disease arises; dropping from the hand causes destruction. // MBhT_13.16

children.text: chinnasūtre bhaven mṛtyus tasmād yatnaparo bhavet /
children.translated_text: From a broken thread, death occurs; therefore one should be most careful.

children.text: evaṃ jñātvā maheśāni śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret // MBhT_13.17
children.translated_text: Having known this, O <s>Maheśānī</s>, one should perform the rite of peace and benediction (<s>śānti-svastyayana</s>). // MBhT_13.17

children.text: kampane yo japen mantraṃ yadi siddhiṃ prayacchati /
children.translated_text: If one recites the <s>mantra</s> during trembling and it bestows <s>siddhi</s> (accomplishment),

children.text: yatnena gurum ānīya dvāviṃśadupacārataḥ // MBhT_13.18
children.translated_text: one should bring the <s>guru</s> with effort and with twenty-two offerings, // MBhT_13.18

children.text: kumbhasthāpanakaṃ kṛtvā pūjayed iṣṭadevatām /
children.translated_text: having established the water-pot (<s>kumbhasthāpana</s>), one should worship the chosen deity (<s>iṣṭadevatā</s>);

children.text: tato huned bilvapattrair aṣṭottaraśatāhutim // MBhT_13.19
children.translated_text: then one should offer oblations with <s>bilva</s> leaves — one hundred and eight oblations. // MBhT_13.19

children.text: trimadhvaktena vidhinā dhūnane 'pi ca sundari /
children.translated_text: With the procedure of the three sweets (<s>trimadhva</s>), also during the shaking, O beautiful one,

children.text: saśabde japane caṇḍi hy evaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ // MBhT_13.20
children.translated_text: during audible recitation, O <s>Caṇḍī</s>, thus should the wise one perform. // MBhT_13.20

children.text: karabhraṣṭe tathā chinne puraścaraṇam ācaret /
children.translated_text: When [the rosary] slips from the hand or is broken, one should perform <s>puraścaraṇa</s> (preliminary practice);

children.text: japādyante yajed devīṃ ṣoḍaśair upacārakaiḥ // MBhT_13.21
children.translated_text: at the end of recitation, one should worship the Goddess with sixteen offerings. // MBhT_13.21

children.text: pratyahaṃ prajapen mantraṃ pratyahaṃ balidānakam /
children.translated_text: Every day one should recite the <s>mantra</s>; every day one should offer <s>bali</s> (oblations);

children.text: pañcāṅgasya pramāṇena sarvakarma samāpayet // MBhT_13.22
children.translated_text: by the standard of the five limbs (<s>pañcāṅga</s>), one should complete all ritual actions. // MBhT_13.22

children.text: daridraḥ parameśāni yadi vighnaparāyaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: O Supreme Goddess, if one is poor and beset by obstacles,

children.text: ādyante mahatīṃ pūjāṃ diksahasraṃ japen manum // MBhT_13.23
children.translated_text: at the beginning and end one should perform a great worship and recite the <s>mantra</s> a thousand times in each direction. // MBhT_13.23

children.text: sahasraikaṃ hunet paścāt sarvavighnasya śāntaye /
children.translated_text: Afterward, one should offer one thousand oblations for the pacification of all obstacles;

children.text: kumbhatoyaiḥ snāpayitvā punar mālāṃ pradāpayet // MBhT_13.24
children.translated_text: having bathed [the rosary] with the water of the pot, one should again place the rosary. // MBhT_13.24

children.text: anenaiva vidhānena vighnajālair na lipyate // MBhT_13.25
children.translated_text: By this very procedure, one is not tainted by the nets of obstacles. // MBhT_13.25

body.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Thirteenth Chapter (<s>Paṭala</s>)

children.text: Mātṛkābhedatantra, caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātṛkābhedatantra</s>, Fourteenth Chapter

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: mantradhāraṇamātreṇa tatkṣaṇe tanmayo bhavet /
children.translated_text: By the mere holding of the <s>mantra</s>, at that very instant one becomes identical with it;

children.text: jīvātmā kuṇḍalīmadhye pradīpakalikā yathā // MBhT_14.1
children.translated_text: the individual soul (<s>jīvātman</s>), within the <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s>, is like the bud of a lamp. // MBhT_14.1

children.text: nijeṣṭadevatārūpā dehasaṃsthā ca kuṇḍalī /
children.translated_text: The <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s>, situated in the body, has the form of one's own chosen deity (<s>iṣṭadevatā</s>);

children.text: bhujyate saiva dehasthā kā cintā sādhakasya ca /
children.translated_text: she herself, abiding in the body, is enjoyed — what worry then for the practitioner (<s>sādhaka</s>)?

children.text: tan me brūhi mahādeva yady ahaṃ tava vallabhā // MBhT_14.2
children.translated_text: Tell me that, O great God, if I am dear to you. // MBhT_14.2

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: bhogas tu trividho devi divyavīrapaśukramāt /
children.translated_text: Enjoyment (<s>bhoga</s>) is threefold, O Goddess — in the sequence of <s>divya</s> (divine), <s>vīra</s> (heroic), and <s>paśu</s> (bound);

children.text: nirlipto divyabhāvasthaḥ kuṇḍalī bhujyate yadi // MBhT_14.3
children.translated_text: if one established in the <s>divya</s> (divine) state enjoys the <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s> without attachment, // MBhT_14.3

children.text: ajihvāntā kuṇḍalinī vīrasya vīravandite /
children.translated_text: [then] the <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s> [extends] up to the tip of the tongue for the <s>vīra</s> (hero), O one venerated by heroes;

children.text: mahādevyāḥ prītaye ca prasādaṃ bhujyate paśuḥ // MBhT_14.4
children.translated_text: and for the pleasure of the Great Goddess, the <s>paśu</s> (bound one) partakes of <s>prasāda</s> (consecrated offering). // MBhT_14.4

children.text: dvijāter divyabhāvaś ca sadā nirvāṇadāyakaḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>divya</s> (divine) state for the twice-born always bestows <s>nirvāṇa</s> (liberation);

children.text: vipro vīraś ca nirvāṇī bhavaty eva na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_14.5
children.translated_text: the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> and the <s>vīra</s> (hero) certainly attain <s>nirvāṇa</s>, without doubt. // MBhT_14.5

children.text: sāyujyādi mahāmokṣaṃ niyuktaṃ kṣatriyādiṣu /
children.translated_text: The great liberation beginning with <s>sāyujya</s> (union) is ordained for <s>kṣatriyas</s> and others;

children.text: paśunā bhaktiyuktena prasādaṃ bhujyate yadi // MBhT_14.6
children.translated_text: if the <s>paśu</s> (bound one), endowed with devotion, partakes of <s>prasāda</s>, // MBhT_14.6

children.text: svargabhogī bhavaty eva maraṇe nādhikāritā /
children.translated_text: he certainly becomes an enjoyer of heavenly pleasures; at death there is no further qualification;

children.text: janmāntaram avāpnoti mahādevyāḥ prasādataḥ // MBhT_14.7
children.translated_text: he obtains another birth by the grace of the Great Goddess. // MBhT_14.7

children.text: divyavīramate dṛṣṭir jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: In the <s>divya</s>-<s>vīra</s> path, vision arises — there is no doubt about this;

children.text: divyavīraprasādena nirvāṇī nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_14.8
children.translated_text: by the grace of the <s>divya</s>-<s>vīra</s> [path], one attains <s>nirvāṇa</s> — there is no doubt. // MBhT_14.8

children.text: prasādabhogī yo devi sa paśur nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: One who merely enjoys <s>prasāda</s>, O Goddess, is a <s>paśu</s> (bound one) — there is no doubt;

children.text: maraṇe nādhikāro 'sti paśubhāvasthitasya ca // MBhT_14.9
children.translated_text: for one established in the <s>paśu</s> state, there is no qualification at death. // MBhT_14.9

body.text: naiva muktir bhavet tasya janma cāpnoti niścitam // MBhT_14.10
body.translated_text: Liberation certainly does not come to him; he assuredly obtains [another] birth. // MBhT_14.10

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: vada me parameśāna divyavīrasya lakṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: Tell me, O Supreme Lord, the characteristics of the <s>divya</s>-<s>vīra</s> (divine-heroic practitioner),

children.text: yat kṛte divyavīrasya mahāmuktir bhaviṣyati // MBhT_14.11
children.translated_text: by which the great liberation of the <s>divya</s>-<s>vīra</s> will be attained. // MBhT_14.11

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: sākṣād brahmamayī devī cābhiśaptā ca vāruṇī /
children.translated_text: The Goddess herself, who is directly the embodiment of <s>Brahman</s>, was cursed to become <s>Vāruṇī</s> (liquor);

children.text: śāpamocanamātreṇa brahmarūpā sudhā parā // MBhT_14.12
children.translated_text: by the mere lifting of the curse, she becomes the supreme nectar (<s>sudhā</s>) in the form of <s>Brahman</s>. // MBhT_14.12

children.text: nivedanān mahādevyai tat tad devī bhavet kila /
children.translated_text: By offering to the Great Goddess, it becomes that very Goddess indeed;

children.text: mūlādhārāt kuṇḍalinīm ājihvāntāṃ vibhāvayet // MBhT_14.13
children.translated_text: one should visualize the <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s> from the <s>mūlādhāra</s> up to the tip of the tongue. // MBhT_14.13

children.text: tanmukhe dānamātreṇa jñānavān sādhako bhavet /
children.translated_text: By the mere offering into her mouth, the practitioner (<s>sādhaka</s>) becomes a knower;

children.text: yathaiva kuṇḍalī devī dehamadhye vyavasthitā // MBhT_14.14
children.translated_text: just as the <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s> Goddess is established in the middle of the body, // MBhT_14.14

children.text: tathaiva vāruṇīṃ dhyāyet kalāṅge sveṣṭadevatām /
children.translated_text: so one should meditate upon <s>Vāruṇī</s> as the chosen deity in the body of <s>kalā</s>;

children.text: kuṇḍalyā samabhāvena śaktivaktre pradāpayet // MBhT_14.15
children.translated_text: with equanimity toward the <s>Kuṇḍalinī</s>, one should offer it into the mouth of <s>Śakti</s>. // MBhT_14.15

children.text: ātmocchiṣṭaṃ mahāpūtaṃ tanmukhāt paramāmṛtam /
children.translated_text: What has been tasted by the Self is supremely pure; from her mouth [comes] the supreme nectar;

children.text: avaśyam eva gṛhṇīyāt tādātmyena varānane // MBhT_14.16
children.translated_text: one should certainly accept it with identity [of self and deity], O beautiful-faced one. // MBhT_14.16

children.text: utsṛṣṭādivicāro 'pi kadācin nāsti brahmaṇi /
children.translated_text: The consideration of 'leftover' or the like never applies to <s>Brahman</s>;

children.text: gaṅgātoyaṃ paraṃ brahma prasādaṃ kasya tad vada // MBhT_14.17
children.translated_text: the water of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> is the supreme <s>Brahman</s> — tell me, whose leftover is that? // MBhT_14.17

children.text: gaṅgāsāgaratoyaṃ vā prasādaṃ kasya vā bhavet /
children.translated_text: The water of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> and the ocean — whose leftover would that be?

children.text: śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tajjale snānamātrataḥ // MBhT_14.18
children.translated_text: Listen, O Goddess, I shall declare — merely by bathing in that water, // MBhT_14.18

children.text: muktibhāgī bhaven martyaḥ snānāvagāhanāt kila /
children.translated_text: a mortal becomes a partaker of liberation; indeed by immersion in bathing,

children.text: pādādimastakāntaṃ vai snānakāle pramajjati // MBhT_14.19
children.translated_text: from the feet to the top of the head, one is submerged at the time of bathing. // MBhT_14.19

children.text: pādasparśo na doṣāya parabrahmaṇi śailaje /
children.translated_text: The touch of the feet is no fault with respect to the supreme <s>Brahman</s>, O Daughter of the Mountain;

children.text: paramātmani līne ca tathaiva parameśvari // MBhT_14.20
children.translated_text: [when one is] dissolved in the supreme Self, likewise, O Supreme Goddess. // MBhT_14.20

children.text: iti te kathitaṃ devi divyavīrasya lakṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: Thus has been told to you, O Goddess, the characteristics of the <s>divya</s>-<s>vīra</s> (divine-heroic practitioner);

children.text: vīratantre ca kathitaṃ māhātmyaṃ prāṇavallabhe // MBhT_14.21
children.translated_text: its greatness has been told in the <s>Vīratantra</s>, O life's beloved. // MBhT_14.21

children.text: śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sādhikāyāś ca lakṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: Listen, O Goddess, I shall declare the characteristics of the <s>sādhikā</s> (female practitioner);

children.text: divyaśaktir vīraśaktir guruśaktis tathā parā // MBhT_14.22
children.translated_text: <s>divya-śakti</s> (divine power), <s>vīra-śakti</s> (heroic power), <s>guru-śakti</s> (power of the teacher) — and the supreme, // MBhT_14.22

children.text: kulaśaktiḥ kāminī ca navaśaktiḥ kumārikā /
children.translated_text: <s>kula-śakti</s> (clan power), <s>kāminī</s> (beloved), <s>nava-śakti</s> (nine-fold power), and <s>kumārikā</s> (maiden);

children.text: śrīguruṃ pūjayed bhaktyā svadehadānapūrvakam // MBhT_14.23
children.translated_text: one should worship the blessed <s>guru</s> with devotion, preceded by the offering of one's own body. // MBhT_14.23

children.text: anyathā tu svadehasya nigraho jāyate dhruvam /
children.translated_text: Otherwise, restraint of one's own body will certainly arise;

children.text: saptajanmani sā devī pukkasī pativarjitā // MBhT_14.24
children.translated_text: for seven births she [who fails] becomes a <s>Pukkasī</s> (outcaste woman), deprived of a husband. // MBhT_14.24

children.text: śivaṃ matvā svakāntaṃ ca pūjāsādhanam ācaret /
children.translated_text: Regarding one's own husband as <s>Śiva</s>, one should perform the practice of worship;

children.text: kadācin na yajec cānyaṃ puruṣaṃ parameśvari // MBhT_14.25
children.translated_text: one should never worship another man, O Supreme Goddess. // MBhT_14.25

children.text: anyasya yajanāc caṇḍi sarvanāśo bhaved dhruvam /
children.translated_text: From worshipping another, O <s>Caṇḍī</s>, total destruction certainly occurs;

children.text: kāntasyāyurvihīnatvaṃ vipatiṃ ca pade pade // MBhT_14.26
children.translated_text: the husband's life is diminished, and misfortune arises at every step. // MBhT_14.26

children.text: dhananāśo bhaven nityaṃ devyāḥ krodhaś ca jāyate /
children.translated_text: Loss of wealth occurs constantly, and the wrath of the Goddess arises;

children.text: avaśyaṃ pūjayen nityaṃ gurudevaṃ sanātanam // MBhT_14.27
children.translated_text: one should always worship without fail the eternal <s>guru</s>-deity. // MBhT_14.27

children.text: bhadrābhadravicāraṃ ca yā karoti gurusthale /
children.translated_text: She who makes considerations of good and bad at the place of the <s>guru</s>,

children.text: tasyā mantraṃ krodhayuktaṃ vipattiś ca pade pade // MBhT_14.28
children.translated_text: her <s>mantra</s> becomes afflicted with wrath, and misfortune [befalls her] at every step. // MBhT_14.28

children.text: varaṃ janamukhān nindā varaṃ prāṇān parityajet /
children.translated_text: Better to be censured by the public; better to abandon one's very life —

children.text: tathāpi pūjayed devaṃ sākṣān nirvāṇadāyakam // MBhT_14.29
children.translated_text: but still one should worship the God who directly bestows <s>nirvāṇa</s>. // MBhT_14.29

body.text: sadā bhayaṃ ca kāpaṭyaṃ varjayed gurupūjane // MBhT_14.30
body.translated_text: One should always avoid fear and deceit in the worship of the <s>guru</s>. // MBhT_14.30

children.text: śrīguros tejasaṃ bhaktyā yadi dhāraṇam ācaret /
children.translated_text: If one, with devotion, retains the radiance of the blessed <s>guru</s>,

children.text: satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kāśī sā nātra saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_14.31
children.translated_text: truly, truly, again truly — that [place] is <s>Kāśī</s> itself, without doubt. // MBhT_14.31

children.text: abhaktyā parameśāni yadi dhāraṇam ācaret /
children.translated_text: O Supreme Goddess, if one retains [it] without devotion,

children.text: japapūjādikaṃ tasyāḥ saṃdahet tena tejasā // MBhT_14.32
children.translated_text: her <s>japa</s>, worship, and other practices are burnt up by that radiance. // MBhT_14.32

children.text: śrīcaṇḍikovāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Caṇḍikā</s> spoke:

children.text: sapatnīkaṃ yajed devaṃ guruṃ nirvāṇadāyakam /
children.translated_text: One should worship the God along with his consort — the <s>guru</s> who bestows <s>nirvāṇa</s>;

children.text: tasya saṅgaṃ parityajya katham ātmaniyojanam // MBhT_14.33
children.translated_text: having abandoned his company, how is self-engagement [possible]? // MBhT_14.33

children.text: śrīśaṃkara uvāca /
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śaṃkara</s> spoke:

children.text: śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi guror ājñānusārataḥ /
children.translated_text: Listen, O Goddess, I shall declare — in accordance with the <s>guru</s>'s command,

children.text: dhārayet tejasaṃ bhaktyā svayaṃ lipsāvivarjitā // MBhT_14.34
children.translated_text: one should retain the radiance with devotion, oneself free from desire. // MBhT_14.34

children.text: gurupatnyāś cātmajaś ca śrīguror ātmajo yataḥ /
children.translated_text: The son of the <s>guru</s>'s wife is the son of the blessed <s>guru</s> himself;

children.text: gurupatnī guruḥ sākṣād guruputro na saṃśayaḥ // MBhT_14.35
children.translated_text: the <s>guru</s>'s wife is directly the <s>guru</s>, and the <s>guru</s>'s son — there is no doubt. // MBhT_14.35

children.text: ekasya pūjanāt kānta ubhayoḥ pūjanaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: By worshipping one, O beloved, the worship of both is accomplished;

children.text: guruputro gaṇeśaś ca guruputraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ // MBhT_14.36
children.translated_text: the <s>guru</s>'s son is <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, and the <s>guru</s>'s son is <s>Ṣaḍānana</s> (<s>Skanda</s>). // MBhT_14.36

children.text: ekaṃ gurusutaṃ kānte pūjane yā sadā ratā /
children.translated_text: One <s>guru</s>'s son, O beloved — she who is always devoted to his worship —

children.text: anyaṃ gurusutaṃ kānte pūjayen na kadācana // MBhT_14.37
children.translated_text: another <s>guru</s>'s son, O beloved, she should never worship. // MBhT_14.37

children.text: vīraṃ vā divyamūrtiṃ vā kadācin na hi pūjayet /
children.translated_text: Neither a <s>vīra</s> (hero) nor a <s>divya</s> (divine) form should she ever worship [instead];

children.text: ekasya pūjanād devi mahāsiddhīśvaro bhavet // MBhT_14.38
children.translated_text: by worship of one alone, O Goddess, one becomes a lord of great <s>siddhis</s>. // MBhT_14.38

children.text: ubhayos trīṇi catvāri yā nārī pūjanaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: A woman who worships two, three, or four —

children.text: tasyāḥ samastaṃ viphalaṃ dhyānādijapapūjanam // MBhT_14.39
children.translated_text: all her meditation, recitation, and worship become fruitless. // MBhT_14.39

children.text: yadi bhāgyavaśād devi ekaṃ gurusutaṃ labhet /
children.translated_text: If by the power of fortune, O Goddess, one obtains a single <s>guru</s>'s son,

children.text: manojñaṃ śāstravettāraṃ nigrahānugrahe ratam // MBhT_14.40
children.translated_text: pleasing, a knower of the scriptures, devoted to restraint and grace, // MBhT_14.40

children.text: sundaraṃ yauvanonmattaṃ gurutulyaṃ jitendriyam /
children.translated_text: handsome, intoxicated with youth, equal to the <s>guru</s>, with senses conquered —

children.text: prāṇānte 'pi ca kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mokṣadāyakam // MBhT_14.41
children.translated_text: even unto death, worship should be performed — [for it is] bestower of liberation. // MBhT_14.41

body.text: no yajed yadi mohena saiva pāpamayī bhavet // MBhT_14.42
body.translated_text: If she does not worship due to delusion, she herself becomes full of sin. // MBhT_14.42
